steps.text: Whisk the honey, soy sauce, rice vinegar, tomato purée, garlic and sesame oil in a jug. Whisk in 1 tsp of the cornflour and 3 tbsp water until smooth. Set it by the hob, as everything moves fast once the chicken is fried.

steps.title: Coat the chicken
steps.text: Toss the chicken through the beaten egg. Lift it into a bowl with the remaining cornflour and a pinch of salt and toss until every piece is coated.

steps.title: Fry the chicken
steps.text: Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the chicken in one layer for 6–8 min, turning, until golden, crisp and cooked through. Lift onto kitchen paper.

steps.title: Cook the broccoli
steps.text: While the chicken fries, cook the broccoli in a pan of boiling water for 3 min until just tender. Drain and cover with the pan lid to keep warm.

steps.title: Glaze and serve
steps.text: Pour off and discard most of the oil, leaving a thin film in the wok. Add the sauce and bubble for 1 min until thick and sticky, then toss in the chicken. Serve over the rice with the broccoli, spring onions and chilli flakes (both optional).

photo.alt: Glazed sesame chicken over rice

recipes.title: Panko Halloumi Katsu Curry with Rice & Sesame Slaw
recipes.airFryer: Spray the crumbed halloumi with oil and air-fry at 200°C for 8–10 min, turning halfway, until golden.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Finely chop the onion and one carrot, grate the other carrot and crush the garlic. Shred the lettuce and beat the egg. Pat the halloumi slices dry with kitchen paper.

steps.title: Soften the veg
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a saucepan over a medium heat. Cook the onion and chopped carrot for 6–8 min, stirring, until soft and golden.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.text: Stir in the garlic, ginger paste, curry powder and 1 tbsp of the flour for 1 min. Gradually whisk in 350ml boiling water with the stock cube crumbled in. Add the honey and 2 tsp of the soy sauce, then simmer for 10–12 min until it coats a spoon.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: While the sauce simmers, rinse the rice and tip it into a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave it covered for 5 min until fluffy.

steps.title: Crumb the halloumi
steps.text: Set out three plates: the remaining flour, the beaten egg and the panko. Coat each halloumi slice in flour, then egg, then press firmly into the panko on both sides.

steps.title: Fry the halloumi
steps.text: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Fry the halloumi for 2–3 min each side until deep golden and soft inside. Drain on kitchen paper.

steps.title: Toss the slaw and serve
steps.text: Toss the lettuce and grated carrot with the rice vinegar, sesame oil and the last 1 tsp soy sauce. Serve the halloumi on the rice with the katsu sauce alongside and the slaw next to it.

recipes.title: Crispy Hoisin Pork Wraps with Cucumber & Spring Onion

ingredients.swap: Leave the chilli flakes out of the pan and sprinkle them into one person's wraps only.
Add the spring onions to one person's wraps only and give the others extra cucumber.

steps.title: Prep the fillings
steps.text: Cut the cucumber into thin matchsticks. Cut the spring onions into fine 6cm strips and shred the lettuce. Crush the garlic and set everything out on a board.

steps.title: Crisp the pork
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a high heat. Add the pork mince, flatten it into one layer and leave for 4–5 min until a deep brown crust forms. Break it up and fry for 5 min more until crisp and the fat has rendered out.

steps.title: Season the pork
steps.text: Stir in the cinnamon, chilli flakes (both optional), garlic and ginger paste for 1 min. Add 3 tbsp of the hoisin, the soy sauce and honey. Toss for 2 min until dark, sticky and clumped into crunchy clusters.

steps.title: Warm the wraps
steps.text: Warm the wraps one at a time in a dry frying pan for 20 seconds each side. Stack them in a clean tea towel so they stay soft while you build.

steps.title: Roll them up
steps.text: Spread each wrap with a little of the remaining hoisin. Pile on lettuce, crispy pork, cucumber and spring onions. Roll up tightly, cut in half and eat straight away.

source.title: Hoisin Pork Wraps with Cucumber and Sweet Potato Fries

recipes.title: Kung Pao Chicken with Peppers, Peanuts & Rice

ingredients.swap: Leave the chilli flakes out of the pan and sprinkle them over one plate only at the end.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Cut the chicken and pepper into 2cm pieces and slice the garlic. Cut the spring onions into 3cm lengths, keeping the white and green parts separate. Toss the chicken with 1 tbsp soy sauce and the cornflour.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice and tip it into a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave it covered for 5 min until fluffy.

steps.title: Mix the sauce
steps.text: Stir the remaining soy sauce, the rice vinegar, honey, sesame oil and 3 tbsp water together in a small jug. It should taste salty, sharp and just sweet.

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.text: Heat 1½ tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over a high heat. Add the chicken in one layer and leave for 2 min to brown. Stir-fry for 3–4 min more until golden and cooked through, then tip onto a plate.

steps.title: Fry the aromatics
steps.text: Lower the heat to medium and add the last ½ tbsp oil, the chilli flakes, garlic and ginger paste. Sizzle for 30 seconds until fragrant but not burnt. Turn the heat up, add the pepper and white spring onions and stir-fry for 2 min.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.text: Return the chicken and pour in the sauce. Bubble for 1 min until it thickens into a glossy glaze. Toss through the peanuts and green spring onions and serve over the rice.

photo.alt: Kung pao chicken in a white bowl

recipes.title: Chicken Chow Mein with Beansprouts & Mushrooms

ingredients.swap: Stir-fry the mushrooms in a separate small pan with a drop of oil and a splash of soy until golden, then spoon them over one portion only.
Leave the beansprouts out of the wok, stir-fry them in a small pan for 1 min and pile them onto one portion only.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Thinly slice the chicken and toss it with the cornflour and 1 tbsp soy sauce. Cut the carrot into matchsticks, slice the mushrooms and finely chop the garlic. Cut the spring onions into 4cm lengths.

steps.title: Cook the noodles
steps.text: Cook the noodles in a pan of boiling water for 3–4 min until just tender. Drain, rinse under cold water and toss with 1 tsp of the sesame oil so they don't stick.

steps.title: Mix the sauce
steps.text: Stir the oyster sauce, remaining soy sauce and sesame oil, the honey and 2 tbsp water together in a small bowl. Keep it by the hob, as the stir-fry is quick.

steps.title: Cook the chicken
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over a high heat. Stir-fry the chicken for 4–5 min until golden and cooked through, then tip onto a plate.

steps.title: Fry the veg
steps.text: Add the remaining oil with the garlic, ginger paste, carrot and mushrooms. Stir-fry for 2–3 min until the mushrooms are golden. Add the beansprouts and spring onions for 1 min so they stay crunchy.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.text: Add the noodles, chicken and sauce. Toss over a high heat for 2 min, lifting with tongs, until glossy and piping hot. Serve straight away.

photo.alt: Stir-fried noodles with chicken and vegetables

recipes.title: Black Bean Beef with Peppers, Onion & Steamed Rice

ingredients.swap: Scatter the spring onions over one plate only.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Toss the beef strips with the soy sauce and 1 tsp of the cornflour. Cut the peppers and onion into 2–3cm chunks so they cook at the same speed. Slice the garlic and spring onions.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice and tip it into a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave it covered for 5 min until fluffy.

steps.title: Mix the sauce
steps.text: Stir the black bean sauce, honey, remaining cornflour and 4 tbsp water together in a jug. Stir again just before using, as the cornflour settles.

steps.title: Sear the beef
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over a high heat until smoking. Add the beef in one layer and leave for 1 min to char. Stir-fry for 1–2 min more until browned but still a little pink, then tip onto a plate.

steps.title: Fry the veg
steps.text: Add the last 1 tbsp oil and stir-fry the peppers and onion over a high heat for 3 min. They should be scorched at the edges but still crisp. Add the garlic and ginger paste for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Sauce and serve
steps.text: Pour in the sauce and bubble for 1 min until thick and glossy. Return the beef and its juices and toss for 30 seconds to heat through. Serve over the rice, scattered with the spring onions (optional).

photo.alt: Beef in black bean sauce in a white bowl

recipes.title: Garlicky Beef & Broccoli in Oyster Sauce with Steamed Rice

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Toss the beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp of the cornflour. Cut the broccoli into small florets and finely chop the garlic.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice and tip it into a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave it covered for 5 min until fluffy.

steps.title: Mix the sauce
steps.text: Whisk the oyster sauce, remaining soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, remaining cornflour and 5 tbsp water in a jug. Stir again just before using, as the cornflour settles.

steps.title: Steam-fry the broccoli
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over a high heat and stir-fry the broccoli for 1 min. Add 3 tbsp water, cover and cook for 2 min until bright green and just tender. Tip onto a plate.

steps.title: Sear the beef
steps.text: Add the last 1 tbsp oil to the wok and get it smoking hot. Fry the beef in one layer for 1 min without moving, then stir-fry for 1 min more until browned. Add the garlic and ginger paste for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Sauce and serve
steps.text: Return the broccoli and pour in the sauce. Toss for 1 min until it thickens and clings to everything. Serve over the rice.

photo.alt: Beef and broccoli with white rice

recipes.title: Dan Dan Pork Noodles with Peanut Chilli Sauce & Pak Choi

ingredients.swap: Stir the chilli flakes into one bowl's sauce only, or serve them at the table.
Scatter the spring onions over one plate only.

ingredients.t: a small handful, chopped, to serve

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Halve the pak choi lengthways, crush the garlic and slice the spring onions. Roughly chop the peanuts.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: In each of two serving bowls, mix half the peanut butter with 2 tsp soy sauce. Add half the rice vinegar, sesame oil, chilli flakes and honey to each bowl. Stir in 2 tbsp hot water from the kettle until smooth and pourable.

steps.title: Crisp the pork
steps.text: Heat the oil in a frying pan over a high heat. Fry the pork mince for 6–8 min, breaking it up, until well browned and crispy at the edges. Stir in the garlic, ginger paste, hoisin and remaining soy sauce for 1 min until sticky.

steps.title: Cook the noodles and greens
steps.text: While the pork crisps, cook the noodles in a large pan of boiling water for 4 min. Add the pak choi for the final 1½ min, until the stems are just soft. Scoop out a mugful of the cooking water, then drain.

steps.title: Build the bowls
steps.text: Lift the noodles and pak choi into the bowls with a splash of the cooking water and toss through the sauce. Top with the crispy pork. Scatter with the peanuts and spring onions (both optional).

photo.alt: Sichuan dan dan noodles with chilli oil and sesame

recipes.title: Crispy Sticky Sesame Tofu with Garlic Greens & Rice

ingredients.swap: Scatter the spring onions over one plate only.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Wrap the tofu in a clean tea towel and press under a heavy pan for 5 min. Meanwhile, cut the broccoli into florets, halve the pak choi, finely chop the garlic and slice the spring onions. Mix the soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, ginger paste, sesame oil and half the garlic for the glaze.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice and tip it into a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave it covered for 5 min until fluffy.

steps.title: Fry the tofu
steps.text: Cut the tofu into 2cm cubes and toss with the cornflour and a pinch of salt. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the tofu for 8–10 min, turning often, until golden and crisp all over, then lift onto a plate.

steps.title: Cook the greens
steps.text: Add the last 1 tbsp oil, the broccoli and 3 tbsp water to the pan. Cover and cook for 2 min. Add the pak choi and the rest of the garlic and stir-fry for 2 min until tender-crisp, then season with a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Glaze and serve
steps.text: Push the greens to one side, pour in the glaze and bubble for 1 min until syrupy. Return the tofu and toss until coated and sticky. Serve over the rice, scattered with the spring onions (optional).

source.title: Sticky Soy and Sesame Tofu with Broccoli Rice
source.author: Sarah Akhurst

photo.alt: Crispy fried tofu cubes with spring onions

recipes.title: Thai Green Chicken Curry with Courgette, Spinach & Basil

ingredients.t: ½ pack, leaves picked, to serve
ingredients.swap: Scatter the basil over one bowl only.
Scatter the sliced chilli over one plate only.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Slice the chicken and pepper and cut the courgette into half-moons. Slice the green chilli, pick the basil leaves and cut the lime in half.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice and tip it into a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave it covered for 5 min until fluffy.

steps.title: Fry the paste
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large saucepan or deep frying pan over a medium heat. Add the green curry paste and 3 tbsp of the thick cream from the top of the coconut milk tin. Fry for 2 min, stirring, until fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer the curry
steps.text: Add the chicken and stir for 2 min to coat. Pour in the rest of the coconut milk and add the courgette. Simmer gently for 10 min until the chicken is cooked through.

steps.title: Season the curry
steps.text: Add the pepper and simmer for 2 min more, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Season with the fish sauce, honey and juice of half the lime. Taste it: it should be salty, a little sweet and fresh.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Ladle the curry over the rice. Top with the basil and sliced chilli (both optional). Cut the remaining lime half into wedges for squeezing.

photo.credit: B R A Y D E N on Unsplash
photo.alt: Thai green curry in a blue bowl

recipes.title: Thai Red Prawn & Coconut Curry with Pak Choi & Lime

ingredients.swap: Scatter the coriander over one plate only, or serve it in a little bowl on the side.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Slice the red onion and pepper, halve the cherry tomatoes and quarter the pak choi. Chop the coriander and cut the lime in half. Pat the defrosted prawns dry with kitchen paper.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice and tip it into a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave it covered for 5 min until fluffy.

steps.title: Soften the veg
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Fry the red onion and pepper for 4–5 min until softened. Stir in the red curry paste for 1 min until fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.text: Pour in the coconut milk and add the cherry tomatoes. Simmer for 5 min until the tomatoes start to collapse and the sauce turns a rich orange. Season with the fish sauce, honey and juice of half the lime.

steps.title: Cook the prawns
steps.text: Add the prawns and pak choi and simmer for 3 min until the prawns are pink all the way through. Don't overcook them or they turn rubbery.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Spoon the curry over the rice and scatter with the coriander (optional). Cut the remaining lime into wedges to squeeze over at the table.

photo.alt: Prawns in red curry sauce with vegetables, lime and basil

recipes.title: Massaman Chicken Curry with Potatoes, Peanuts & Cinnamon

ingredients.swap: Scatter the coriander over one plate only, or serve it in a little bowl on the side.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Cut the chicken into large chunks, the potatoes into 3cm chunks and the onion into wedges. Chop the peanuts and coriander and cut the lime in half. Mix the red curry paste with the curry powder and cinnamon to mimic a massaman paste.

steps.title: Brown the chicken
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large lidded saucepan over a medium-high heat. Brown the chicken for 4–5 min until coloured all over. Add the onion and spice paste and fry for 2 min, stirring, until fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer the curry
steps.text: Stir in the coconut milk, peanut butter and 150ml water, then add the potatoes. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook for 20 min, stirring now and then, until the potatoes are tender.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: When the curry has 15 min left, boil the kettle. Rinse the rice and tip it into a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave it covered for 5 min until fluffy.

steps.title: Season and serve
steps.text: Uncover the curry and bubble for 3–4 min until thick enough to coat the potatoes. Season with the fish sauce, honey and juice of half the lime. Serve over the rice with the peanuts, coriander (both optional) and lime wedges.

source.title: Massaman Chicken Curry with Potatoes, Peanuts & Cinnamon
source.author: Nagi Maehashi

recipes.title: Chicken & Prawn Pad Thai-Style Noodles with Peanuts & Lime

ingredients.swap: Toss the beansprouts through one portion only, or scatter them raw over one plate.
Serve the chilli flakes on the side rather than in the pan.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Thinly slice the chicken, finely chop the garlic and cut the spring onions into 4cm lengths. Beat the eggs, chop the peanuts and pat the prawns dry.

steps.title: Soak the noodles
steps.text: Pour boiling water over the rice noodles in a bowl and soak for 6–8 min until pliable but still a little firm. Drain and rinse under cold water. They finish cooking in the pan.

steps.title: Mix the sauce
steps.text: While the noodles soak, stir the fish sauce, soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, tomato purée and juice of half the lime together. It should taste tangy, salty and sweet all at once.

steps.title: Cook the chicken and prawns
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over a high heat. Stir-fry the chicken for 3–4 min until cooked through. Add the garlic and prawns for 1–2 min until pink, then push everything to one side.

steps.title: Scramble the eggs
steps.text: Add the remaining oil to the empty side and pour in the eggs. Scramble for 30 seconds until just set, then break them up through the chicken.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.text: Add the noodles and sauce and toss with tongs for 2 min until the noodles soak it up. Add the beansprouts and spring onions for 30 seconds. Serve with the peanuts, chilli flakes (both optional) and the remaining lime in wedges.

source.title: Chicken & Prawn Pad Thai-Style Noodles with Peanuts & Lime
source.author: Nagi Maehashi

photo.alt: Pad thai on a wooden table

recipes.title: Zingy Thai Chicken Larb Lettuce Cups with Rice

ingredients.swap: Add the chilli flakes to one portion only.
Scatter the coriander over one plate only, or serve it in a little bowl on the side.
Stir the basil into one portion only, or serve it on the side.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Very finely chop the chicken thighs into a coarse mince, or pulse in short bursts in a food processor. Thinly slice the red onion and soak it in the lime juice. Crush the garlic, slice the spring onions, chop the coriander and tear the basil.

steps.title: Toast the rice
steps.text: Toast 1 tbsp of the uncooked rice in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 4–5 min until golden. Crush it with a rolling pin. This toasted rice powder gives larb its crunch.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rest of the rice and tip it into a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave it covered for 5 min until fluffy.

steps.title: Cook the chicken
steps.text: Heat the oil in the frying pan over a high heat. Fry the chicken for 5–6 min, breaking it up, until cooked through with no pink left. Add the garlic for 1 min.

steps.title: Dress the larb
steps.text: Take the pan off the heat. Stir in the fish sauce, honey, chilli flakes (optional) and the red onion with all its lime juice. Fold through the spring onions, coriander and basil (both optional) and most of the toasted rice. Taste it: it should be punchy, salty and sour.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Separate the lettuce leaves and cut the cucumber into batons. Spoon the larb into the lettuce cups and sprinkle with the remaining toasted rice. Serve with the rice and cucumber on the side.

source.title: Zingy Thai Chicken Larb Lettuce Cups with Rice
source.author: Nagi Maehashi

photo.alt: Thai chicken larb salad on a wooden table

recipes.title: Grilled Chicken Satay with Peanut Sauce & Smashed Cucumber
recipes.airFryer: Air-fry the marinated chicken at 200°C for 10–12 min, turning halfway, until charred and cooked through.

ingredients.swap: Scatter the coriander over one plate only, or serve it in a little bowl on the side.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Heat the grill to high and line a tray with foil. Put the kettle on. Cut the chicken into long strips, crush the garlic and cut the lime in half.

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.text: Mix the yogurt, curry powder, turmeric (optional), 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp honey and half the garlic. Coat the chicken strips in it. Thread them onto skewers if you have them, or leave them loose.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice and tip it into a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave it covered for 5 min until fluffy.

steps.title: Grill the chicken
steps.text: Lay the chicken on the tray and grill for 10–12 min, turning halfway, until charred at the edges and cooked through. Brush with any marinade left in the bowl when you turn it.

steps.title: Make the peanut sauce
steps.text: While the chicken grills, put the peanut butter, coconut milk, red curry paste, remaining garlic, soy sauce and honey in a small saucepan. Stir over a low heat for 3–4 min until smooth and thick enough to coat a spoon. Add a squeeze of lime, plus a splash of water if it's too thick.

steps.title: Smash the cucumber
steps.text: Bash the cucumber with a rolling pin until it splits, then tear it into chunks. Toss with the rice vinegar and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Serve the satay with the rice, a bowl of peanut sauce for dipping and the cucumber salad. Scatter with the coriander (optional) and serve the remaining lime in wedges.

source.title: Grilled Chicken Satay with Peanut Sauce & Smashed Cucumber
source.author: Nagi Maehashi

photo.alt: Chicken satay skewers with peanut sauce and salad

recipes.title: Thai Basil Pork (Pad Kra Pao) with Crispy Fried Egg & Rice

ingredients.swap: Leave the chilli out of the pan and serve it sliced on the side so each plate can be as hot as you like.
Spoon one portion onto a plate before stirring in the basil, then stir it through the rest.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Finely chop the garlic and green chilli, and slice the red onion and pepper. Pick the basil leaves. Mix the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, honey and 2 tbsp water in a small bowl.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice and tip it into a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave it covered for 5 min until fluffy.

steps.title: Fry the eggs
steps.text: Heat the oil in a wok or frying pan over a medium-high heat until shimmering. Crack in the eggs and fry for 2–3 min, spooning the hot oil over the whites. Lift out when the edges are lacy and crisp but the yolks are runny.

steps.title: Cook the pork
steps.text: Pour off all but 1 tbsp of the oil and turn the heat up high. Fry the garlic and chilli for 20 seconds. Add the pork mince and fry for 5–6 min, breaking it up, until browned and slightly crispy.

steps.title: Add the veg and sauce
steps.text: Add the red onion and pepper and stir-fry for 2 min. Pour in the sauce and toss for 1 min until the pork looks glossy. Take off the heat and stir through the basil until just wilted.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Spoon the pork over the rice and top each plate with a crispy fried egg. Break the yolk into the rice as you eat.

source.title: Thai Basil Pork (Pad Kra Pao) with Crispy Fried Egg & Rice

photo.alt: Thai basil stir-fry with rice and a fried egg

recipes.title: Thai Red Curry with Crispy Tofu, Sweet Potato & Spinach

ingredients.swap: Scatter the coriander over one plate only, or serve it in a little bowl on the side.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Pat the tofu dry, cut it into cubes and toss with the cornflour and a pinch of salt. Peel the sweet potato and cut it into 2cm cubes. Slice the red onion and cut the lime in half.

steps.title: Crisp the tofu
steps.text: Heat 1½ tbsp oil in a large deep frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the tofu for 8 min, turning, until golden and crisp on all sides. Lift onto a plate.

steps.title: Fry the paste
steps.text: Add the remaining oil and the red onion to the pan and fry for 3 min until softening. Stir in the red curry paste for 1 min.

steps.title: Simmer the curry
steps.text: Pour in the coconut milk and 100ml water and add the sweet potato. Simmer for 12–15 min until the sweet potato is tender and the sauce has thickened.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: While the curry simmers, boil the kettle. Rinse the rice and tip it into a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave it covered for 5 min until fluffy.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Stir the spinach into the curry until wilted. Season with the soy sauce, honey and juice of half the lime. Ladle over the rice and top with the tofu so it stays crunchy. Scatter with the coriander (optional) and serve with lime wedges.

source.title: Thai Red Curry with Crispy Tofu, Sweet Potato & Spinach

photo.alt: Thai red curry served with white rice

recipes.title: Sticky Honey Garlic Chicken with Sesame Broccoli & Rice

ingredients.swap: Scatter the spring onions over one plate only.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Pat the chicken dry, season with salt and black pepper and dust with the cornflour. Cut the broccoli into florets, finely chop the garlic and slice the spring onions. Mix the honey, soy sauce, rice vinegar and 2 tbsp water for the glaze.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice and tip it into a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave it covered for 5 min until fluffy.

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Lay the thighs in smooth-side down and fry for 5–6 min without moving until deep golden. Turn and cook for 4–5 min more until cooked through.

steps.title: Cook the broccoli
steps.text: While the chicken cooks, cook the broccoli in a pan of boiling water for 3 min until just tender. Drain and toss with the sesame oil and a pinch of salt. Cover with the pan lid to keep warm.

steps.title: Glaze the chicken
steps.text: Turn the heat to medium and add the garlic to the chicken pan for 30 seconds. Pour in the glaze and bubble for 1–2 min, turning the chicken, until thick and shiny.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Slice the chicken and serve over the rice with the broccoli. Spoon over the garlicky glaze and scatter with the spring onions (optional).

source.title: Sticky Honey Garlic Chicken with Sesame Broccoli & Rice
source.author: Nagi Maehashi

photo.alt: Glazed chicken with rice on a white plate

recipes.title: Glossy Teriyaki Salmon with Sesame Pak Choi & Rice

ingredients.swap: Scatter the spring onions over one plate only.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Whisk the soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, ginger paste, garlic, cornflour and 2 tbsp water for the teriyaki sauce. Halve the pak choi and slice the spring onions. Pat the salmon dry.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice and tip it into a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave it covered for 5 min until fluffy.

steps.title: Sear the salmon
steps.text: Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat. Cook the salmon skin-side down for 4 min until the skin is crisp. Turn and cook for 2 min more.

steps.title: Cook the pak choi
steps.text: While the salmon cooks, heat the sesame oil in a second pan over a medium-high heat. Stir-fry the pak choi with a splash of water for 2 min until wilted but crunchy at the stems. Season with a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Glaze the salmon
steps.text: Pour the teriyaki sauce into the salmon pan and bubble for 1–2 min, spooning it over the fish. Take it off the heat as soon as the sauce is thick and glossy, as the honey can burn. The salmon should flake easily in the middle.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Fluff up the rice with a fork. Serve the salmon on the rice with the pak choi and drizzle over any sauce from the pan. Scatter with the spring onions (optional).

photo.alt: Teriyaki salmon with broccoli in a black bowl

recipes.title: Miso-Glazed Salmon with Rice, Sesame Peas & Pickled Cucumber
recipes.airFryer: Air-fry the glazed salmon at 190°C for 8–9 min until caramelised and just cooked through.

ingredients.swap: Cook and serve the peas for one plate only, and give the other plate extra pickled cucumber.
Scatter the spring onions over one plate only.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Heat the grill to high, line a small tray with foil and put the kettle on. Thinly slice the cucumber and spring onions. Toss the cucumber with 2 tsp of the rice vinegar and a pinch of salt to pickle.

steps.title: Glaze the salmon
steps.text: Mix the miso, honey, soy sauce, ginger paste and the last 1 tsp rice vinegar into a thick paste. Put the salmon on the tray and spread the paste over the tops.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice and tip it into a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave it covered for 5 min until fluffy.

steps.title: Grill the salmon
steps.text: Grill the salmon about 10cm from the heat for 8–10 min until the glaze is bubbling and the fish flakes easily. Watch it closely in the last few minutes, as miso catches quickly.

steps.title: Cook the peas
steps.text: While the salmon grills, cook the peas in a small pan of boiling water for 2–3 min. Drain and toss with the sesame oil.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Squeeze any excess liquid from the cucumber so it stays crunchy. Serve the salmon on the rice with the sesame peas and pickled cucumber. Scatter with the spring onions (optional).

photo.alt: Broiled glazed salmon with scallions and rice

recipes.title: Oyakodon — Japanese Chicken & Egg Rice Bowl

ingredients.swap: Scatter the spring onions over one bowl only instead of adding them to the pan.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Thinly slice the onion, cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and slice the spring onions. Dissolve the half stock cube in 200ml boiling water and stir in the soy sauce and honey. This sweet-salty broth stands in for dashi and mirin.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice and tip it into a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave it covered for 5 min until fluffy.

steps.title: Simmer the chicken
steps.text: Pour the broth into a medium frying pan, add the onion and simmer over a medium heat for 3 min until softened. Add the chicken in one layer and simmer for 6–7 min, turning once, until cooked through.

steps.title: Add the eggs
steps.text: Beat the eggs with just a few strokes, so the whites and yolks stay streaky. Pour two thirds over the chicken, cover and cook for 1 min. Pour over the rest, add the spring onions and cover for 30 seconds, until just set but still soft on top.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Spoon the rice into deep bowls. Slide the chicken and egg over the top with any extra broth, so the rice soaks it up. Eat while the egg is still soft.

source.title: Oyakodon — Japanese Chicken & Egg Rice Bowl
source.author: Namiko Hirasawa Chen

recipes.title: Yaki Udon with Crispy Pork, Pak Choi & Mushrooms

ingredients.swap: Stir-fry the mushrooms in a separate small pan with a drop of oil and a splash of soy until golden, then spoon them over one portion only.
Scatter the spring onions over one plate only.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Slice the onion, mushrooms, pak choi and spring onions and cut the carrot into matchsticks. Mix the soy sauce, oyster sauce, Worcestershire sauce and honey. The Worcestershire sauce gives the fruity tang of Japanese noodle sauce.

steps.title: Loosen the noodles
steps.text: Put the udon in a heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water for 1 min. Gently separate the strands with a fork and drain straight away, so they don't go soft.

steps.title: Brown the pork
steps.text: Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over a high heat. Fry the pork mince for 5 min, breaking it up, until browned and crispy in places.

steps.title: Fry the veg
steps.text: Add the onion, carrot and mushrooms and stir-fry for 3 min until the mushrooms are golden. Add the pak choi for 1 min until wilted.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.text: Add the noodles and sauce and toss over a high heat for 2 min until glossy and starting to catch. Serve scattered with the spring onions (optional).

source.title: Yaki Udon with Crispy Pork, Pak Choi & Mushrooms
source.author: Namiko Hirasawa Chen

recipes.title: Gyoza Pork Rice Bowls with Crispy Garlic & Dipping Sauce

ingredients.swap: Fry the chopped mushrooms in a separate small pan with a drop of oil until golden and stir them into one bowl only.
Scatter the last few spring onions over one bowl only.
Stir the chilli flakes into one dipping sauce only.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Thinly slice 2 garlic cloves and crush the other. Finely shred the pak choi, finely chop the mushrooms and slice the spring onions. Mix 1 tbsp soy sauce with the rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil and the chilli flakes (optional) for the dipping sauce.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice and tip it into a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave it covered for 5 min until fluffy.

steps.title: Fry the garlic chips
steps.text: Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium-low heat. Fry the sliced garlic for 2 min until pale golden, then lift onto kitchen paper with a slotted spoon. Keep the garlicky oil in the pan.

steps.title: Cook the filling
steps.text: Turn the heat to high and fry the pork mince for 5 min until browned. Add the mushrooms for 2 min, then the pak choi, crushed garlic, ginger paste and most of the spring onions for 3 min. Stir in the remaining soy sauce and sesame oil.

steps.title: Fry the eggs
steps.text: Push the pork to one side, crack in the eggs and fry for 2–3 min until the whites are set and crispy at the edges. Season with a pinch of salt and black pepper.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Spoon the rice into bowls and top with the pork and a fried egg each. Scatter with the garlic chips and remaining spring onions, then drizzle over the dipping sauce.

source.title: Gyoza Pork Rice Bowls with Crispy Garlic & Dipping Sauce
source.site: Kavey Eats (from Tim Anderson's JapanEasy Bowls & Bento)
source.author: Tim Anderson

recipes.title: Beef Bulgogi Rice Bowls with Pickled Cucumber & Kimchi

ingredients.swap: Sprinkle the chilli flakes over one bowl only.
Put the kimchi on one bowl only and give the other extra pickled cucumber.
Scatter the spring onions over one plate only.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Slice the cucumber into thin rounds, grate the carrot, crush the garlic and slice the spring onions. Toss the cucumber with the rice vinegar, 1 tsp of the honey and a pinch of salt to pickle.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice and tip it into a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave it covered for 5 min until fluffy.

steps.title: Mix the bulgogi sauce
steps.text: Stir together the soy sauce, remaining honey, sesame oil, garlic, ginger paste and chilli flakes (optional). It should taste sweet, savoury and garlicky.

steps.title: Cook the beef
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a high heat. Fry the beef mince for 5–6 min, breaking it up, until well browned and crisp in places. Pour in the sauce and cook for 2 min until sticky and glossy.

steps.title: Build the bowls
steps.text: Divide the rice between bowls. Top with the bulgogi beef, drained pickled cucumber, grated carrot and kimchi. Scatter with the spring onions (optional).

source.title: Beef Bulgogi Rice Bowls with Pickled Cucumber & Kimchi
source.author: Nagi Maehashi

recipes.title: Sticky Gochujang Chicken Thighs with Sesame Greens & Rice
recipes.airFryer: Air-fry the marinated thighs at 200°C for 16–18 min, brushing with the rest of the sauce for the last 4 min, until sticky and cooked through.

ingredients.swap: Scatter the spring onions over one plate only.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan) and line a roasting tin with baking paper. Crush the garlic, cut the broccoli into florets and slice the spring onions. Mix the gochujang, honey, soy sauce, garlic, ginger paste and rice vinegar.

steps.title: Roast the chicken
steps.text: Toss the chicken thighs in half the gochujang sauce and lay them in the tin. Roast for 20 min. Brush with the remaining sauce and roast for 5 min more until sticky, charred at the edges and cooked through.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: When the chicken has 15 min left, boil the kettle. Rinse the rice and tip it into a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave it covered for 5 min until fluffy.

steps.title: Cook the greens
steps.text: When the chicken has 5 min left, heat the oil in a frying pan over a high heat. Stir-fry the broccoli with 3 tbsp water for 3 min until tender. Add the spinach for 1 min until wilted, then season with the sesame oil and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Slice the chicken and serve over the rice with the greens. Spoon over the sticky juices from the tin and scatter with the spring onions (optional).

source.title: Sticky Gochujang Chicken Thighs with Sesame Greens & Rice
source.author: Lucy Parissi

recipes.title: Beef Bibimbap Bowls with Garlic Spinach & Fried Egg

ingredients.swap: Cook the mushrooms in their own pile as normal and add them to one bowl only.
Cook the beansprouts in their own pile as normal and add them to one bowl only.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Cut the carrot into matchsticks, slice the mushrooms and crush the garlic. Mix the gochujang with 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp honey, the rice vinegar and 1 tbsp water for the bibimbap sauce.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice and tip it into a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave it covered for 5 min until fluffy.

steps.title: Cook the veg
steps.text: Heat 2 tsp of the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Cook each veg separately, setting each aside in its own pile. Give the beansprouts 1 min, the carrot 2 min and the mushrooms 3 min, then wilt the spinach with 1 garlic clove for 1 min. Season each pile with a drop of sesame oil and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Cook the beef
steps.text: Add 1 tbsp oil to the pan and fry the beef mince for 5 min until browned. Add the rest of the garlic, the soy sauce and remaining honey and cook for 2 min until sticky. Tip it into its own pile.

steps.title: Fry the eggs
steps.text: Wipe the pan and heat the last 1 tsp oil over a medium heat. Fry the eggs for 2–3 min until the whites are set and crispy but the yolks are still runny.

steps.title: Build the bowls
steps.text: Divide the rice between bowls and arrange the veg and beef on top in sections. Top each with a fried egg and a spoonful of the gochujang sauce. Mix everything together at the table.

source.title: Beef Bibimbap Bowls with Garlic Spinach & Fried Egg
source.author: Nagi Maehashi

photo.alt: Bibimbap with vegetables and a fried egg

recipes.title: Kimchi Fried Rice with Crispy Bacon, Cheddar & Fried Eggs

ingredients.swap: Leave the peas out of the pan. Cook them in a small pan of boiling water for 3 min and stir them into one portion only.
Scatter the spring onions over one plate only.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Chop the bacon, kimchi and onion, saving 2 tbsp of the kimchi juice. Finely chop the garlic, grate the cheddar and slice the spring onions.

steps.title: Cook and cool the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice and tip it into a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 10 min. Spread it out on a plate to steam-dry for 5 min, as wet rice turns gluey when fried.

steps.title: Crisp the bacon
steps.text: Heat a large non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the bacon for 4–5 min until golden and the fat has run out. Add the onion for 3 min until soft, then the garlic for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Fry the kimchi
steps.text: Add the kimchi and gochujang and fry for 2 min until it starts to caramelise. Let it catch a little on the bottom of the pan, as those dark bits add flavour.

steps.title: Fry the rice
steps.text: Add the rice, peas, soy sauce and kimchi juice. Stir-fry over a high heat for 3–4 min until every grain is red and piping hot. Scatter the cheddar over the top, cover and leave for 1 min to melt.

steps.title: Fry the eggs and serve
steps.text: While the cheese melts, fry the eggs in the oil in a second pan until crispy at the edges with runny yolks. Drizzle the rice with the sesame oil and spoon into bowls. Top each with an egg and the spring onions (optional).

source.title: Kimchi Fried Rice with Crispy Bacon, Cheddar & Fried Eggs
source.author: Maangchi

photo.alt: Kimchi fried rice topped with a fried egg

recipes.title: Bun Cha — Vietnamese Pork Patties with Rice Noodles & Herbs
recipes.airFryer: Air-fry the patties at 200°C for 9–10 min, turning halfway, until caramelised and cooked through.

ingredients.swap: Scatter the remaining spring onions over one plate only.
Put the basil on one plate only.
Scatter the coriander over one plate only, or serve it in a little bowl on the side.
Add the chilli to one bowl of dipping sauce only.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Heat the grill to high, line a tray with foil and put the kettle on. Crush the garlic and finely slice the spring onions. Cut the carrot into matchsticks and the cucumber into batons. Separate the lettuce leaves and juice the lime.

steps.title: Shape the patties
steps.text: Mix the pork mince with 2 garlic cloves, half the spring onions, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp honey and the black pepper. Shape into 10 small, flat patties and lay them on the tray.

steps.title: Make the dipping sauce
steps.text: Stir the remaining fish sauce and honey with the lime juice, rice vinegar, last garlic clove and chilli flakes (optional). Add 6 tbsp warm water from the kettle and stir until the honey dissolves. Add the carrot to soak, so it lightly pickles.

steps.title: Grill the patties
steps.text: Grill the patties for 8–10 min, turning halfway, until caramelised at the edges and cooked through. They should look sticky and dark brown from the honey.

steps.title: Soak the noodles
steps.text: While the patties grill, pour boiling water over the rice noodles and soak for 5–6 min until tender. Drain, rinse under cold water and shake well, so they don't water down the sauce.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Divide the dipping sauce between two bowls and drop in the hot patties. Serve with plates of noodles, lettuce, cucumber, the remaining spring onions and the basil and coriander (both optional). Dip everything into the sauce as you eat.

source.title: Bun Cha — Vietnamese Pork Patties with Rice Noodles & Herbs
source.author: Nagi Maehashi

photo.alt: Vietnamese bun cha with noodles, herbs and dipping sauce

recipes.title: Caramelised Chicken Banh Mi Bowls with Sweet Chilli Mayo

ingredients.swap: Leave the chilli out of the mayo and sprinkle it over one bowl only.
Scatter the coriander over one plate only, or serve it in a little bowl on the side.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Slice the chicken, cut the carrot into matchsticks, slice the cucumber and crush the garlic. Zest the lime, then cut it in half. Mix the chicken with the fish sauce, soy sauce, 1 tbsp honey, the garlic, ginger paste and lime zest.

steps.title: Pickle the veg
steps.text: Toss the carrot and cucumber with the rice vinegar, the remaining honey and a big pinch of salt. Leave to pickle while you cook.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice and tip it into a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave it covered for 5 min until fluffy.

steps.title: Fry the chicken
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the chicken in one layer for 3 min without moving until caramelised underneath. Stir-fry for 4–5 min more until sticky and cooked through, then squeeze in the juice of one lime half.

steps.title: Make the spicy mayo
steps.text: Mix the mayonnaise with the sweet chilli sauce, chilli flakes (optional) and a squeeze from the other lime half. Loosen with a splash of water if you want it drizzly. Cut what's left of the lime into wedges.

steps.title: Build the bowls
steps.text: Drain the pickles well so they don't make the rice soggy. Divide the rice between bowls and top with the chicken and pickles. Drizzle with the spicy mayo and finish with the coriander (optional) and lime wedges.

source.title: Caramelised Chicken Banh Mi Bowls with Sweet Chilli Mayo

recipes.title: Quick Chicken Laksa with Coconut, Rice Noodles & Beansprouts

ingredients.swap: Lift the beansprouts out with a slotted spoon and add them to one bowl only.
Scatter the coriander over one plate only, or serve it in a little bowl on the side.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Thinly slice the chicken, halve the pak choi and crush the garlic. Cut the lime in half.

steps.title: Boil the eggs
steps.text: Lower the eggs into a small pan of boiling water and cook for 7 min. Cool them in cold water, then peel and halve.

steps.title: Fry the paste
steps.text: While the eggs cook, heat the oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Fry the red curry paste, curry powder, turmeric (optional), ginger paste and garlic for 2 min, stirring, until fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer the broth
steps.text: Pour in the coconut milk and 400ml boiling water, crumble in the stock cube and bring to a simmer. Add the chicken and simmer for 6–8 min until cooked through.

steps.title: Soak the noodles
steps.text: While the chicken simmers, soak the rice noodles in boiling water from the kettle for 6 min until tender. Drain well.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Add the pak choi to the broth for the final 2 min, and the beansprouts for the last minute so they heat through but keep a little crunch. Season with the fish sauce, honey and juice of half the lime. Divide the noodles between deep bowls and ladle over the broth and veg. Top with the eggs, coriander (optional) and lime wedges.

source.title: Quick Chicken Laksa with Coconut, Rice Noodles & Beansprouts
source.author: Nagi Maehashi

photo.alt: Bowl of Malaysian curry laksa with chopsticks

recipes.title: Nasi Goreng with Chicken, Prawns, Fried Egg & Cucumber

ingredients.swap: Scatter the spring onions over one plate only.

steps.title: Get prepped
steps.text: Put the kettle on. Finely chop the onion, crush the garlic and dice the chicken. Slice the cucumber and spring onions, halve the cherry tomatoes and pat the prawns dry. Mix the soy sauce and honey to make a quick sweet soy sauce.

steps.title: Cook and cool the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice and tip it into a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on a low heat for 10 min. Spread it out on a plate to steam-dry for 5 min.

steps.title: Fry the spice paste
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the onion for 3 min until soft. Add the garlic, red curry paste and tomato purée for 1 min until dark and fragrant.

steps.title: Cook the chicken and prawns
steps.text: Add the chicken and stir-fry for 4–5 min until browned and cooked through. Add the prawns for 2 min until pink. Keep the heat high so they colour rather than stew.

steps.title: Fry the rice
steps.text: Add the rice, sweet soy sauce and fish sauce. Toss over a high heat for 3–4 min until every grain is coated and dark, pressing it against the pan so it toasts in places.

steps.title: Fry the eggs and serve
steps.text: In a second pan, fry the eggs in the remaining oil until crispy at the edges with runny yolks. Pile the rice into bowls and top each with an egg. Serve with the cucumber, cherry tomatoes and spring onions (optional).

source.title: Nasi Goreng with Chicken, Prawns, Fried Egg & Cucumber
source.author: Nagi Maehashi

photo.alt: Seafood nasi goreng with prawns and vegetables

recipes.title: Crispy Panko Cod & Oven Chips with Mushy Peas & Tartare
recipes.airFryer: Air-fry the oiled chips at 200°C for 20–25 min, shaking twice, then cook the crumbed cod at 200°C for 8–10 min until golden and flaking.

ingredients.t: 1: zest, juice of half, rest in wedges

ingredients.swap: Mushy peas are a side: make half the amount (100g) and serve them on one plate only.
Spoon one portion of the lemony yogurt into a separate dish before stirring in the gherkins.

steps.title: Prep the chips
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Cut the potatoes into thick chips (no need to peel), rinse, then pat really dry with a clean tea towel. Zest the lemon, juice one half and cut the other half into wedges. Finely chop the gherkins.

steps.title: Roast the chips
steps.text: Toss the chips on a large baking tray with 1½ tbsp oil and a good pinch of salt. Spread them out in one layer. Roast on the top shelf for 35–40 min, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.

steps.title: Crumb the cod
steps.text: While the chips roast, set out three plates: flour seasoned with salt and pepper, the beaten egg, and panko mixed with the lemon zest. Pat the cod dry, dust in flour, dip in egg and press firmly into the crumbs. Lay on a lined baking tray and drizzle with the remaining ½ tbsp oil.

steps.title: Bake the cod
steps.text: When the chips have 15 min left, put the cod on the shelf below. Bake for 12–15 min until the crumb is golden and the fish flakes easily when pressed with a fork.

steps.title: Make the tartare
steps.text: While the cod bakes, stir the gherkins into the yogurt with a squeeze of lemon juice and a pinch of pepper. Add a splash of the gherkin vinegar if you like it sharper.

steps.title: Make the mushy peas
steps.text: Boil the peas in a small pan of water over a medium heat for 3–4 min until tender. Drain, keeping a splash of the water, and return to the pan. Add the butter, the rest of the lemon juice and a pinch of salt, then crush with a potato masher until thick and chunky.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Pile the chips onto plates, sprinkle with a little salt and set the cod alongside. Add a mound of mushy peas, a spoonful of tartare and the lemon wedges for squeezing.

source.title: Ultimate Fish and Chips with Tartare Sauce and Crushed Minted Peas

photo.alt: Fish and chips on a checkered plate

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken, Leek & Bacon Pie with a Puff Pastry Lid

steps.title: Prep the filling
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and take the pastry out of the fridge. Dissolve the stock cube in 250ml boiling water. Slice the leeks, crush the garlic, chop the bacon and cut the chicken into bite-size pieces. Cut the broccoli into florets.

steps.title: Brown the chicken and bacon
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large, deep frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the bacon and chicken for 6–8 min, stirring now and then, until the bacon is crisp and the chicken golden all over.

steps.title: Soften the leeks
steps.text: Turn the heat down to medium and add the butter, leeks, garlic and mixed herbs (optional). Cook for 5 min until the leeks are soft and glossy. Sprinkle over the flour and stir for 1 min so there are no dry patches.

steps.title: Make the creamy filling
steps.text: Gradually stir in the stock, then the cream and mustard. Bubble gently for 4–5 min until the sauce coats the back of a spoon. Season with pepper (the bacon is salty), tip into a small pie dish (about 1 litre) and leave to cool for 5 min.

steps.title: Top the pie
steps.text: Lay the pastry over the dish, trim the overhang and press the edges down with a fork to seal. Brush with the beaten egg and cut a small slit in the middle for steam.

steps.title: Bake the pie
steps.text: Bake on the middle shelf for 25 min until the pastry is puffed and deep golden. The filling should be bubbling at the edges.

steps.title: Cook the broccoli and serve
steps.text: When the pie has 5 min left, boil the broccoli over a high heat for 4–5 min until just tender, then drain. Cut the pie in half and serve with the broccoli.

recipes.title: Toad in the Hole with Sticky Red Onion Gravy

ingredients.swap: Cook the peas in a separate small pan of boiling water for 2 min and add them to one plate only.

ingredients.t: a pinch, plus extra for the veg water

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Thinly slice the red onions. Peel the carrots and cut them into batons.

steps.title: Make the batter
steps.text: Whisk the flour, eggs and a pinch of salt in a jug. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and about as thick as single cream. Leave to rest while the sausages cook.

steps.title: Roast the sausages
steps.text: Put the oil and sausages in a roasting tin about 20 x 25cm. Roast on the top shelf for 15 min until browned and the oil is sizzling hot. A really hot tin is what makes the batter rise.

steps.title: Bake the toad
steps.text: Working quickly, take the tin out, give the batter a final whisk and pour it around the sausages – it should sizzle. Return to the oven for 25–30 min without opening the door, until puffed, crisp and deep golden.

steps.title: Cook the onions
steps.text: While the batter bakes, melt the butter in a saucepan over a medium-low heat. Cook the onions for 15 min, stirring often, until soft and sticky.

steps.title: Finish the gravy
steps.text: Add 300ml boiling water to the onions, then stir in the gravy granules and mustard. Simmer for 2 min until thick and glossy, then keep warm on the lowest heat.

steps.title: Cook the veg and serve
steps.text: When the toad has 6 min left, boil the carrots in a pan of salted water over a high heat. Add the peas for the final 2 min, then drain. Cut the toad in the hole in half and serve with the veg and plenty of onion gravy.

recipes.title: Sirloin Steak & Chips with Peppercorn Sauce & Mushrooms
recipes.airFryer: Air-fry the oiled chips at 200°C for 20–25 min, shaking twice, until golden; the tomatoes can go in for the last 5 min.

ingredients.swap: The mushrooms are cooked in their own pan and the sauce is made without them, so spoon them onto one plate only.

ingredients.t: ½ beef cube in 75ml boiling water

steps.title: Prep the chips
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan) and take the steaks out of the fridge. Cut the potatoes into thick chips and pat dry with a clean tea towel. Slice the mushrooms, crush the garlic and coarsely crush the black pepper. Dissolve ½ stock cube in 75ml boiling water.

steps.title: Roast the chips
steps.text: Toss the chips on a large baking tray with 1½ tbsp oil and a pinch of salt. Roast on the top shelf for 35–40 min, turning halfway, until golden. Add the tomatoes to a corner of the tray for the last 10 min.

steps.title: Cook the mushrooms
steps.text: When the chips have 15 min left, melt half the butter in a small frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the mushrooms for 5–6 min until golden and any liquid has gone. Stir in the garlic for 1 min, season with salt and keep warm.

steps.title: Sear the steaks
steps.text: Heat a large frying pan over a high heat until smoking. Rub the steaks with the remaining ½ tbsp oil and season with salt, then cook for 2–3 min each side for medium-rare. Move to a board, top with the remaining butter and rest for 5 min.

steps.title: Make the peppercorn sauce
steps.text: Turn the steak pan down to medium and toast the crushed pepper for 30 seconds. Pour in the stock and Worcestershire and bubble, scraping up the browned bits, until reduced by half. Stir in the cream and simmer for 2–3 min until it coats a spoon, then add the resting juices.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Slice the steaks or leave them whole and plate up with the chips and roast tomatoes. Spoon the mushrooms alongside and pour over the peppercorn sauce.

photo.alt: Sliced steak with fries on a white plate

recipes.title: Roast Chicken for Two with Roasties, Yorkshires & Gravy
recipes.airFryer: To free up the oven, air-fry the parboiled, oiled potatoes at 200°C for 25–30 min, shaking every 10 min, until crisp and golden.

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Peel and halve the potatoes, halve the carrots lengthways and cut the broccoli into florets. Bash the unpeeled garlic cloves and halve the lemon.

steps.title: Make the Yorkshire batter
steps.text: Whisk the flour, egg and a pinch of salt in a jug. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Leave to rest at room temperature until needed.

steps.title: Roast the chicken
steps.text: Rub the chicken legs with 1 tsp oil, the mixed herbs (optional), salt and pepper. Sit them in a roasting tin with the lemon halves and garlic. Roast on the top shelf for 45–50 min until the skin is crisp and the juices run clear.

steps.title: Parboil the potatoes
steps.text: When the chicken has been in for 15 min, boil the potatoes in salted water for 8 min. Meanwhile, heat 2 tbsp oil in a second tray in the oven for 5 min. Drain the potatoes, steam for 2 min, then shake in the colander to rough up the edges.

steps.title: Roast the potatoes and carrots
steps.text: Tip the potatoes into the hot oil, turn to coat and roast on the middle shelf for 40 min, turning once, until crunchy. At the same time, toss the carrots with the honey, 1 tsp oil and a pinch of salt and add them to the chicken tin.

steps.title: Bake the Yorkshires
steps.text: When the chicken is done, lift it and the carrots onto a plate and cover with foil to rest. Put ½ tsp oil in each of 4 holes of a muffin tin and heat in the oven for 5 min. Pour in the batter (it should sizzle) and bake for 18–20 min without opening the door, until risen and crisp.

steps.title: Make the gravy
steps.text: While the Yorkshires bake, squeeze the soft garlic out of its skins into the chicken tin and squeeze in the roasted lemon. Add 300ml boiling water, scrape up the sticky bits, then strain into a small saucepan. Whisk in the gravy granules over a medium heat and simmer for 1–2 min until thick.

steps.title: Cook the broccoli and serve
steps.text: For the last 4 min, boil the broccoli in a pan of salted water until just tender, then drain. Pile everything onto plates and pour over plenty of gravy.

photo.alt: Roast chicken dinner with roast potatoes, carrots, broccoli, Yorkshire pudding and gravy

recipes.title: Hunter's Chicken with BBQ Sauce, Cheddar & Paprika Wedges
recipes.airFryer: Air-fry the wedges at 200°C for 20–22 min, shaking halfway; the bacon-wrapped chicken can then go in at 190°C for 18–20 min before adding the sauce and cheese for a final 3 min.

ingredients.swap: The corn is a side: cook half the amount (75g), toss with half the butter and add it to one plate only.

steps.title: Prep the chicken
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Cut the potatoes into wedges, crush the garlic and grate the cheddar. Wrap each chicken breast in 2 rashers of bacon, tucking the ends underneath.

steps.title: Roast the wedges
steps.text: Toss the wedges on a baking tray with 1 tbsp oil, 1 tsp smoked paprika and a pinch of salt. Roast on the top shelf for 35–40 min, turning halfway, until golden and crisp at the edges.

steps.title: Bake the chicken
steps.text: When the wedges have been in for 15 min, put the chicken in a small ovenproof dish and rub with the remaining 1 tsp oil. Bake on the middle shelf for 20–25 min until the bacon is crisp and the chicken is cooked through with no pink in the middle.

steps.title: Make the BBQ sauce
steps.text: While the chicken bakes, mix the tomato purée, honey, Worcestershire, garlic, the remaining 1 tsp paprika and 4 tbsp water in a small pan. Simmer over a low heat for 3–4 min, stirring, until thick and glossy. Add a splash more water if it gets too stiff to spoon.

steps.title: Add the sauce and cheese
steps.text: Spoon the BBQ sauce over the chicken and scatter with the cheddar. Return to the oven for 5 min until the cheese is melted and bubbling.

steps.title: Cook the corn and serve
steps.text: Meanwhile, boil the sweetcorn in a small pan of water for 3 min, then drain and toss with the butter. Serve the chicken with the wedges and buttery corn.

recipes.title: Crispy Halloumi Burgers with Sweet Chilli & Carrot Slaw
recipes.airFryer: Air-fry the floured halloumi slices at 200°C for 6–8 min, turning once, until golden; the pepper strips can go in alongside.

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Grate the carrot and very thinly slice the red onion. Slice the pepper into strips, grate the garlic and separate the little gem leaves. Cut the halloumi into 4 thick slices and pat dry. Juice the lemon half.

steps.title: Mix the slaw and yogurt
steps.text: Toss the red onion with half the lemon juice and a pinch of salt and leave for 5 min to soften. Mix the yogurt with the garlic and the rest of the lemon juice. Stir the carrot and onion together with 2 tbsp of the garlic yogurt.

steps.title: Char the peppers
steps.text: Heat ½ tbsp oil in a large frying pan over a high heat. Fry the pepper strips for 5–6 min until soft and charred in places, then tip onto a plate.

steps.title: Fry the halloumi
steps.text: Mix the flour with the smoked paprika (optional) and dust the halloumi in it. Add the remaining ½ tbsp oil to the pan over a medium-high heat and fry the slices for 2 min each side until deep golden. Drizzle over half the sweet chilli sauce so it turns sticky, then lift out.

steps.title: Toast the buns
steps.text: Halve the buns and toast them cut-side down in the same pan over a medium heat. They need about 30 seconds, until lightly golden.

steps.title: Build the burgers
steps.text: Spread the bun bases with garlic yogurt and add the little gem leaves, peppers and two slices of halloumi each. Drizzle over the remaining sweet chilli sauce and add the lids. Serve with the slaw on the side.

source.title: Sticky Sweet Chilli Halloumi Burger with Wedges, Pickled Carrot and Baby Gem Salad

photo.alt: Halloumi burger with fries on a plate

recipes.title: Minced Beef & Onion Puff Pie with Mash, Peas & Gravy

ingredients.swap: The peas are a side: cook 75g in their own small pan of boiling water for 3 min and serve them on one plate only.

ingredients.t: a pinch, plus extra for the potato water

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and take the pastry out of the fridge. Dissolve the stock cube in 300ml boiling water. Finely chop the onion, finely dice the carrot, and peel and chop the potatoes.

steps.title: Brown the mince
steps.text: Heat the oil in a frying pan over a high heat. Brown the mince for 5 min, breaking it up, until no pink remains. Add the onion and carrot and cook for 5 min until soft.

steps.title: Simmer the filling
steps.text: Stir in the flour and tomato purée for 1 min, then add the Worcestershire and 200ml of the stock. Simmer over a medium heat for 10 min until rich and thick. Season with pepper, spoon into a small pie dish and leave to cool for 5 min.

steps.title: Top and bake the pie
steps.text: Lay the pastry over the filling and press the edges onto the rim with a fork. Brush with the beaten egg and cut a small steam hole in the middle. Bake on the middle shelf for 25 min until well risen and deep golden.

steps.title: Make the mash
steps.text: While the pie bakes, boil the potatoes in a large pan of salted water for 15 min until a knife slides in easily. Drain, then mash with the butter and milk until smooth. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Make the gravy
steps.text: Bring the remaining 100ml stock to a simmer in a small pan. Whisk in the gravy granules and bubble for 1 min until thick and glossy.

steps.title: Cook the peas and serve
steps.text: Boil the peas in a small pan of water for 3 min, then drain. Serve the pie with the mash, peas and gravy.

source.title: Old School Minced Beef and Onion Pie
source.author: Brian Jones

photo.alt: Golden meat pie on a white plate

recipes.title: Smoked Haddock, Salmon & Prawn Fish Pie with Cheddar Mash

ingredients.swap: The peas are a side: cook 75g in their own small pan of boiling water for 3 min and serve them on one plate only.

ingredients.t: a pinch, plus extra for the potato water

steps.title: Prep the fish and veg
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and boil the kettle. Peel and chop the potatoes, zest the lemon half and grate the cheddar. Put the spinach in a colander, pour over boiling water to wilt it, then squeeze dry. Pat the defrosted prawns dry.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.text: Put the potatoes in a large pan of boiling salted water over a high heat. Cook for 15 min until very tender, then drain and leave to steam dry.

steps.title: Poach the fish
steps.text: While the potatoes boil, lay the haddock and salmon in a frying pan and pour over the milk. Bring to a gentle simmer over a medium heat and cook for 4–5 min until the fish just flakes. Lift onto a plate and pour the milk into a jug.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Melt 25g butter in a saucepan over a medium heat, stir in the flour and cook for 1 min. Gradually whisk in the warm poaching milk, then simmer for 3–4 min, stirring, until it coats a spoon. Stir in the cream, mustard, lemon zest and plenty of pepper.

steps.title: Fill the dish
steps.text: Flake the fish into large chunks into a baking dish (about 1 litre), discarding any skin. Scatter over the prawns and spinach, then pour over the sauce.

steps.title: Top with the mash
steps.text: Mash the potatoes with the remaining 15g butter and a pinch of salt. Spoon over the filling, rough up the top with a fork and sprinkle with the cheddar.

steps.title: Bake the pie
steps.text: Bake on the middle shelf for 25 min until bubbling at the edges and golden on top. Raw prawns will turn pink and cook through in the oven.

steps.title: Cook the peas and serve
steps.text: When the pie has 3 min left, boil the peas in a small pan of water, then drain. Leave the pie to settle for a couple of minutes and serve with the peas.

recipes.title: Cottage Pie with Worcestershire Gravy & a Cheddar Mash Crust

ingredients.swap: The peas are a side: cook 75g in their own small pan of boiling water for 3 min and serve them on one plate only.

ingredients.t: a pinch, plus extra for the potato water

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Peel and chop the potatoes, finely chop the onion, finely dice the carrot and crush the garlic. Dissolve the stock cube in 250ml boiling water and grate the cheddar.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.text: Put the potatoes in a large pan of salted water and bring to the boil. Cook for 15 min until tender, then drain and leave to steam dry.

steps.title: Brown the mince
steps.text: While the potatoes cook, heat the oil in a large frying pan over a high heat. Fry the mince for 5–6 min, breaking it up with a wooden spoon, until well browned and any liquid has cooked off. The browning is where the flavour comes from.

steps.title: Simmer the filling
steps.text: Add the onion, carrot and garlic and cook over a medium heat for 5 min until soft. Stir in the flour, tomato purée and mixed herbs (optional) for 1 min, then pour in the stock and Worcestershire. Simmer for 15 min, stirring now and then, until thick and glossy, then season with pepper.

steps.title: Mash and top
steps.text: Mash the potatoes with the butter, milk and a pinch of salt until smooth. Spoon the mince into a small baking dish and spread the mash over the top. Rake with a fork so it crisps up and scatter with the cheddar.

steps.title: Bake the pie
steps.text: Bake on the middle shelf for 20 min until golden and bubbling at the edges. Leave to settle for a couple of minutes before serving.

steps.title: Cook the peas and serve
steps.text: When the pie has 3 min left, boil the peas in a small pan of water, then drain. Serve the pie with the peas alongside.

recipes.title: Lamb Shepherd's Pie with Peas, Herby Gravy & Crispy Mash

ingredients.t: 1 lamb or beef cube in 250ml boiling water

ingredients.swap: Leave the peas out of the filling. Boil them in a small pan for 3 min and serve them on one plate only.

ingredients.t: a pinch, plus extra for the potato water

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Peel and chop the potatoes, finely chop the onion, dice the carrot and crush the garlic. Dissolve the stock cube in 250ml boiling water and cut the broccoli into florets.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.text: Put the potatoes in a large pan of salted water and bring to the boil. Cook for 15 min until tender, then drain and leave to steam dry.

steps.title: Brown the lamb
steps.text: While the potatoes cook, put the lamb mince in a large dry frying pan over a high heat. It has enough fat of its own. Fry for 6–8 min, breaking it up, until deeply browned. Spoon off any excess fat.

steps.title: Simmer the filling
steps.text: Add the onion, carrot and garlic and cook over a medium heat for 5 min until soft. Stir in the flour, tomato purée and mixed herbs, then the stock and Worcestershire. Simmer for 15 min until thick, then stir in the peas, season with pepper and tip into a small baking dish.

steps.title: Mash and top
steps.text: Mash the potatoes with the butter, milk and a pinch of salt until smooth. Spoon over the lamb and fluff up the surface with a fork so the peaks crisp.

steps.title: Bake the pie
steps.text: Bake on the middle shelf for 20–25 min until the peaks are crisp and golden. Leave to settle for a couple of minutes before serving.

steps.title: Cook the broccoli and serve
steps.text: When the pie has 5 min left, boil the broccoli in a pan of salted water until just tender, then drain. Serve the pie with the broccoli.

photo.alt: Shepherd's pie in a bowl

recipes.title: Bangers & Mustard Mash with Red Onion Gravy & Peas
recipes.airFryer: Air-fry the sausages at 190°C for 12–14 min, shaking halfway, until browned and cooked through.

ingredients.swap: The peas are a side: cook 75g in their own small pan of boiling water for 3 min and serve them on one plate only.

ingredients.t: a pinch, plus extra for the potato water

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and boil the kettle. Peel and chop the potatoes and thinly slice the red onions.

steps.title: Bake the sausages
steps.text: Put the sausages on a lined baking tray and bake on the middle shelf for 25 min, turning halfway. They're done when browned all over with no pink in the middle.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.text: Meanwhile, put the potatoes in a large pan of salted water and bring to the boil. Cook for 15 min until soft, then drain and leave to steam for a minute.

steps.title: Caramelise the onions
steps.text: Heat the oil and half the butter in a saucepan over a medium heat. Add the onions with a pinch of salt and cook for 12–15 min, stirring often, until soft and sticky. Stir in the honey for the last 2 min so they turn jammy.

steps.title: Make the gravy
steps.text: Pour 300ml boiling water into the onions, add the Worcestershire and stir in the gravy granules. Simmer for 2 min until thick and glossy, adding a splash more water if needed.

steps.title: Make the mustard mash
steps.text: Mash the potatoes with the rest of the butter, the milk and mustard until smooth and creamy. Season with salt to taste.

steps.title: Cook the peas and serve
steps.text: Boil the peas in a small pan of water for 3 min, then drain. Pile the mash onto plates, top with the sausages and pour over the onion gravy, with the peas alongside.

source.title: Bangers and Mash (Sausage with Onion Gravy)
source.author: Nagi Maehashi

photo.alt: Sausages and mash on a plate

recipes.title: Smoky Sausage & Butter Bean Casserole with Garlic Baguette

ingredients.t: 3 cloves (2 crushed, 1 grated for the bread)
½ chicken cube in 150ml boiling water

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) for the bread and take the butter out of the fridge. Slice the onion and pepper, crush 2 garlic cloves and grate the third. Dissolve ½ stock cube in 150ml boiling water and drain the butter beans.

steps.title: Brown the sausages
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large deep pan or casserole over a medium-high heat. Brown the sausages for 6–8 min, turning, until golden all over. Lift out and cut each one in half on the diagonal.

steps.title: Soften the veg
steps.text: Add the onion and pepper to the pan and cook for 5 min until soft and lightly charred. Stir in the crushed garlic and smoked paprika for 1 min until fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer the casserole
steps.text: Add the chopped tomatoes, tomato purée, Worcestershire, stock and butter beans, then return the sausages. Bring to a bubble, then simmer over a low-medium heat for 15 min, stirring now and then. It's ready when thick and the sausages are cooked through.

steps.title: Bake the garlic bread
steps.text: While it simmers, mash the softened butter with the grated garlic. Cut deep slashes along the baguette and spread the butter inside. Bake for 8–10 min until crisp and golden.

steps.title: Wilt the spinach and serve
steps.text: Stir the spinach into the casserole for 1 min until just wilted, then taste and add a pinch of salt if needed. Ladle into bowls and serve with the hot garlic bread for dunking.

photo.credit: David de Andrés Martín on Unsplash
photo.alt: Rustic white bean stew with chorizo in tomato broth

recipes.title: Lemon, Garlic & Herb Chicken Traybake with Crispy Potatoes
recipes.airFryer: Cook the seasoned chicken legs skin-side up at 190°C for 25–28 min until the juices run clear; the potatoes can go alongside if they fit in one layer, shaken halfway.

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Cut the potatoes into 3cm chunks, the leek into 3cm lengths and the pepper into chunks. Bash the garlic cloves, then zest the lemon and cut it into quarters.

steps.title: Season the tray
steps.text: In a large roasting tin, toss the potatoes, garlic and lemon quarters with the oil, mixed herbs, smoked paprika (optional), lemon zest, salt and pepper. Push to the sides and sit the chicken legs in the middle, skin-side up. Rub them in the oily seasoning.

steps.title: Roast the chicken
steps.text: Roast on the top shelf for 20 min. Turn the potatoes and tuck the leek and pepper in around the chicken. Roast for 20–25 min more until the skin is crisp and the juices run clear when the thickest part is pierced.

steps.title: Wilt the spinach
steps.text: Take the tin out and squeeze the roasted lemon over everything. Scatter in the spinach and toss it through the hot potatoes and juices until it just wilts.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Season the yogurt (optional) with a pinch of salt. Divide the traybake between plates, spooning over the pan juices, with a dollop of yogurt on the side.

source.title: Lemon and Garlic Chicken Tray Bake
source.author: Sally

recipes.title: Salmon & Spring Onion Fishcakes with Tartare & Lemon Salad
recipes.airFryer: Spray the crumbed fishcakes with oil and air-fry at 200°C for 10–12 min, turning halfway, until golden and hot through.

ingredients.swap: Spoon one portion of the lemony yogurt into a separate dish before stirring in the gherkins.
Toss the defrosted peas through one portion of the salad only.

ingredients.t: a pinch, plus extra for the potato water

steps.title: Prep the salad and tartare
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Peel and chop the potatoes, finely slice the spring onions, chop the gherkins and slice the cucumber. Tear the little gem leaves, then zest the lemon and cut it in half. Cover the peas with boiling water for 2 min, then drain.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.text: Put the potatoes in a pan of boiling salted water over a medium-high heat. Cook for 12 min until soft, then drain well and leave to steam dry for 2 min.

steps.title: Cook the salmon
steps.text: While the potatoes boil, put the salmon on a plate, cover and microwave on high for 3–4 min until it flakes easily. Leave to cool slightly.

steps.title: Shape the fishcakes
