steps.text: Roughly mash the potatoes. Flake in the salmon, add the spring onions, lemon zest, mustard and a pinch of salt and mix gently so you keep some chunks. Shape into 4 thick patties.

steps.title: Crumb the fishcakes
steps.text: Put the flour, beaten egg and panko on three separate plates. Dust each fishcake in flour, dip in egg and press into the panko until evenly coated.

steps.title: Fry the fishcakes
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Fry the fishcakes for 3–4 min each side until deep golden, crisp and piping hot in the middle.

steps.title: Make the tartare and serve
steps.text: While the fishcakes fry, mix the yogurt with the gherkins and a squeeze of lemon. Toss the little gem, cucumber and peas with the rest of the lemon juice. Serve the fishcakes with the salad and tartare.

photo.alt: Golden fish cakes on a white plate

recipes.title: Crispy Jacket Potatoes with Tuna, Sweetcorn & Cheddar
recipes.airFryer: After microwaving, rub the potatoes with oil and salt and air-fry at 200°C for 10–12 min until the skins are crisp.

ingredients.swap: Mix the tuna filling without the sweetcorn, then stir the corn into one portion only.

steps.title: Prep the filling
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan) and boil the kettle. Prick the potatoes all over with a fork. Slice the spring onions, dice the cucumber, halve the tomatoes, shred the little gem and grate the cheddar. Cover the sweetcorn with boiling water for 2 min, then drain.

steps.title: Microwave the potatoes
steps.text: Microwave the potatoes on high for 8–10 min, turning halfway, until a knife slides in easily. Take care, as they'll be very hot.

steps.title: Crisp the skins
steps.text: Rub the hot potatoes with the oil and a pinch of salt and put them straight onto the oven shelf. Bake for 12–15 min until the skins are crisp and crackly.

steps.title: Make the tuna filling
steps.text: While the skins crisp, flake the tuna into a bowl with the sweetcorn, spring onions, yogurt, a squeeze of lemon and plenty of pepper. Mix until creamy but still chunky.

steps.title: Make the side salad
steps.text: Put the little gem, cucumber and tomatoes in a bowl. Toss with the rest of the lemon juice and a pinch of salt just before serving.

steps.title: Fill and serve
steps.text: Split the jackets open with a cross and push the sides to fluff up the middles. Add a knob of butter to each, pile in the tuna mix and scatter over the cheddar. Serve with the salad.

recipes.title: Coronation Chicken Jacket Potatoes with Cucumber Salad
recipes.airFryer: After microwaving, rub the potatoes with oil and salt and air-fry at 200°C for 10–12 min until crisp; the chicken can be air-fried at 190°C for 12–14 min.

ingredients.t: a small handful, chopped, to serve
ingredients.swap: Scatter the coriander over one jacket only, or leave it out.

steps.title: Prep the chicken and salad
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan) and prick the potatoes all over. Slice the chicken into thin strips and toss with half the curry powder and a pinch of salt. Slice the spring onions, dice the cucumber and shred the little gem. Juice the lemon half and chop the coriander (optional).

steps.title: Start the jackets
steps.text: Microwave the potatoes on high for 8–10 min, turning halfway, until just soft. Rub with 1 tsp oil and a pinch of salt. Bake directly on the oven shelf for 15 min until the skins are crisp.

steps.title: Cook the chicken
steps.text: While the jackets bake, heat the remaining 1 tsp oil in a frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the chicken for 6–8 min until golden and cooked through with no pink inside. Tip onto a plate to cool for a few minutes.

steps.title: Make the coronation dressing
steps.text: Take the pan off the heat and add the rest of the curry powder and the turmeric (optional) for 30 seconds to toast. Scrape into a bowl and stir in the yogurt, mango chutney and a squeeze of lemon until smooth and golden.

steps.title: Mix the filling
steps.text: Fold the chicken and most of the spring onions into the dressing. Taste and add a squeeze more lemon if it needs it.

steps.title: Fill and serve
steps.text: Split the jackets and fluff up the insides. Spoon in the coronation chicken and scatter with the remaining spring onions and the coriander (optional). Serve with the little gem and cucumber, dressed with the rest of the lemon juice.

recipes.title: Velvety Leek & Potato Soup with Cheddar & Mustard Toasts

ingredients.swap: Scatter the spring onion over one bowl only.

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Boil the kettle and dissolve the stock cube in 700ml boiling water. Slice the leeks, rinsing out any grit, then dice the potatoes and chop the onion. Crush the garlic, grate the cheddar and slice the spring onion (optional).

steps.title: Sweat the leeks
steps.text: Melt the butter in a large saucepan over a medium-low heat. Add the leeks, onion and garlic, cover with a lid and cook for 8 min, stirring now and then, until very soft but not coloured.

steps.title: Simmer the soup
steps.text: Add the potatoes and stock and bring to the boil. Lower to a simmer and cook for 12–15 min until the potatoes break apart when pressed with a spoon.

steps.title: Make the cheese toasts
steps.text: While the soup simmers, heat the grill to high. Slice the baguette on the diagonal and toast one side under the grill until golden. Turn over, spread thinly with mustard, top with the cheddar and grill for 2–3 min until bubbling.

steps.title: Blend the soup
steps.text: Blitz the soup with a stick blender until silky. Stir in the cream and season with pepper, adding a splash of water if it's too thick.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Ladle the soup into bowls and scatter with the spring onion (optional). Serve with the cheesy toasts for dunking.

recipes.title: Pork Steaks with Apples, Mustard Cream & Crushed Potatoes

ingredients.t: ½ chicken cube in 100ml boiling water
a pinch, plus extra for the potato water

steps.title: Prep the pork and veg
steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chunks and the broccoli into florets. Core the apple and cut it into wedges, thinly slice the onion and slice the spring onions. Dissolve ½ stock cube in 100ml boiling water. Season the pork on both sides with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.text: Put the potatoes in a pan of boiling salted water and cook for 15 min until tender, adding the broccoli for the last 4 min. Drain and keep warm in the pan with the lid on.

steps.title: Fry the pork
steps.text: While the potatoes cook, heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the pork steaks for 4–5 min each side until golden and cooked through, with clear juices. Move to a plate to rest.

steps.title: Caramelise the apples
steps.text: Turn the heat down to medium and add 15g butter, the apple wedges and onion. Cook for 4–5 min, turning, until the apples are golden and just tender. Drizzle with the honey (optional).

steps.title: Make the mustard sauce
steps.text: Pour the stock into the pan and bubble for 1 min, scraping up the sticky bits. Stir in the cream and mustard and simmer for 2 min until it coats the back of a spoon. Return the pork and any resting juices to warm through.

steps.title: Crush and serve
steps.text: Lift the broccoli out of the potato pan. Lightly crush the potatoes with the remaining butter, the spring onions and a pinch of salt. Serve the pork with the apples and sauce spooned over, with the crushed potatoes and broccoli alongside.

source.title: Pork chops with apples and mustard sauce
source.author: Emma Franklin

recipes.title: Slow-Simmered Beef Stew with Fluffy Herb Dumplings

ingredients.t: 1 tsp, plus a pinch for the dumplings

ingredients.swap: The mushrooms are fried in their own pan, so spoon them onto one bowl only.

steps.title: Prep the beef and veg
steps.text: Chop the onion, cut the carrots into chunks and crush the garlic. Dissolve the stock cube in 500ml boiling water and quarter the mushrooms. Toss the beef in the plain flour with a pinch of salt and pepper.

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large lidded casserole or deep pan over a high heat. Brown the beef in two batches for 4–5 min each, until well coloured on all sides. Lift out onto a plate.

steps.title: Build the stew
steps.text: Turn the heat to medium and add the remaining ½ tbsp oil, the onion and carrots. Cook for 5 min until starting to soften, then stir in the garlic and tomato purée for 1 min. Return the beef with the stock, Worcestershire and 1 tsp mixed herbs and bring to the boil.

steps.title: Simmer the stew
steps.text: Turn the heat right down, cover and simmer very gently for 2 hr, stirring now and then, until the beef breaks apart with a spoon. Add a splash of water if it gets too thick. In a slow cooker, cook on low for 7–8 hr instead.

steps.title: Make the dumplings
steps.text: About 30 min before the end, grate 50g cold butter into the self-raising flour. Rub together with a pinch of salt and the remaining herbs, then stir in 4–5 tbsp cold water to make a soft, slightly sticky dough. Shape into 6 balls.

steps.title: Steam the dumplings
steps.text: Sit the dumplings on top of the bubbling stew, cover and cook for 20–25 min until doubled in size and fluffy all the way through. Don't lift the lid early or they won't rise. In a slow cooker, turn to high and allow 30–40 min.

steps.title: Fry the mushrooms and serve
steps.text: While the dumplings steam, melt the remaining butter in a small frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the mushrooms for 5 min until golden. Ladle the stew and dumplings into bowls and spoon the mushrooms on top.

photo.alt: Bowl of hearty beef stew with sourdough bread

recipes.title: Ploughman's Supper with Warm Baguette, Cheddar & Pickle

ingredients.swap: Serve the pickle in a little dish on the side so it only goes on one plate.
Keep the gherkins in a small dish on the side so they only go on one plate.

steps.title: Prep the board
steps.text: Heat the oven according to the baguette pack (usually 200°C, 180°C fan). Thinly slice the red onion, slice the apple and cut the cucumber into sticks. Cut the cheddar into chunks, separate the little gem leaves and juice the lemon half.

steps.title: Bake the bread
steps.text: Bake the baguettes for 8–10 min until crisp and golden. Wrap them in a clean tea towel so they stay warm.

steps.title: Boil the eggs
steps.text: Meanwhile, lower the eggs into a pan of boiling water over a medium-high heat and cook for 8 min for firm-but-fudgy yolks. Drain and cool under cold water until you can peel them, then halve.

steps.title: Quick-pickle the onion
steps.text: Toss the red onion with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt and leave for 5 min until it turns pink and softens. Toss the apple slices in any leftover juice so they don't brown.

steps.title: Build the board and serve
steps.text: Arrange the cheddar, eggs, pickle, gherkins (optional), apple, tomatoes, little gem, cucumber and pickled onion on a board or two plates. Put the butter and mustard in little dishes. Slice the warm baguettes and let everyone butter and pile up their own.

recipes.title: Smoked Haddock Kedgeree with Jammy Eggs, Spinach & Lemon

ingredients.swap: Leave the peas out of the rice. Boil them in a small pan for 3 min and stir them into one bowl only.

ingredients.t: a small handful, chopped, to serve
ingredients.swap: Scatter over one bowl only, or leave it out.
Sprinkle the chilli over one bowl only.

steps.title: Prep the rice and garnishes
steps.text: Finely chop the onion and rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs clear. Juice half the lemon and cut the other half into wedges. Chop the coriander and slice the green chilli (both optional).

steps.title: Poach the haddock
steps.text: Put the haddock in a frying pan, pour over the milk and 200ml water and bring to a gentle simmer over a medium heat. Cook for 5 min until it flakes, then lift out onto a plate. Pour 300ml of the poaching liquid into a jug.

steps.title: Boil the eggs
steps.text: At the same time, lower the eggs into a small pan of boiling water and cook for 7 min for jammy yolks. Cool in cold water, then peel and halve.

steps.title: Soften the onion
steps.text: Melt the butter in a lidded saucepan over a medium heat and cook the onion for 5 min until soft and golden. Stir in the curry powder and turmeric (optional) for 1 min until fragrant.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Add the rice and stir to coat in the spiced butter, then pour in the reserved poaching liquid. Bring to the boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 10 min until the liquid is absorbed. Scatter the peas on top for the last 3 min and put the lid back on.

steps.title: Fold it together
steps.text: Stir the spinach through the hot rice until it wilts. Flake in the haddock in big pieces, discarding any skin. Add the lemon juice and fold gently so the fish stays chunky.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Spoon into bowls and top with the halved eggs. Scatter over the coriander and green chilli (both optional) and serve with the lemon wedges.

source.title: Kedgeree – English curried rice and fish
source.author: Nagi Maehashi

recipes.title: Leek & Mustard Welsh Rarebit with Tomatoes & Spinach Salad

ingredients.t: 1 tbsp (2 tsp for the rarebit, the rest to serve)

steps.title: Prep the bread and veg
steps.text: Heat the grill to high. Cut the baguette into four pieces and split each one lengthways. Finely slice the leek, thinly slice the red onion, halve the tomatoes and grate the cheddar. Juice the lemon half and separate the egg, keeping the yolk.

steps.title: Grill the tomatoes
steps.text: Toss the tomatoes with 1 tsp oil and a pinch of pepper on the grill tray. Grill for 5–6 min until blistered, then tip into a dish and keep warm.

steps.title: Soften the leek
steps.text: Melt the butter in a saucepan over a medium heat and cook the leek for 5 min until soft and silky, without browning. Stir often so it doesn't catch.

steps.title: Make the rarebit
steps.text: Stir the flour into the leek for 1 min, then add the milk and stir until thick. Take off the heat and beat in the cheddar, mustard, 2 tsp Worcestershire and the egg yolk to make a thick, spreadable paste.

steps.title: Toast and grill
steps.text: Toast the baguette pieces cut-side up under the grill until lightly golden. Spread the rarebit thickly right to the edges. Grill for 3–4 min until bubbling and speckled dark brown.

steps.title: Make the salad and serve
steps.text: Toss the spinach and red onion with the lemon juice, the remaining 1 tsp oil and a pinch of salt. Serve the rarebit straight from the grill with a splash of the remaining Worcestershire, the tomatoes and the salad.

recipes.title: Bubble & Squeak Cakes with Crispy Bacon & Fried Eggs

ingredients.swap: Boil the peas in a separate small pan for 3 min. Shape 2 cakes from the mash first, then fold the peas into the rest for the other 2.

ingredients.t: a pinch, plus extra for the potato water

steps.title: Prep the veg and relish
steps.text: Peel and chop the potatoes, finely slice the leek and finely chop the broccoli. Grate the cheddar. In a small bowl, stir the tomato purée, Worcestershire and honey with 1 tbsp water to make a quick tangy relish.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 12–15 min until tender, adding the broccoli and peas for the last 3 min. Drain well and leave to steam dry for a couple of minutes.

steps.title: Soften the leek
steps.text: While the potatoes cook, melt the butter in a large non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Cook the leek for 5 min until soft, then tip into the potato pan.

steps.title: Shape the cakes
steps.text: Roughly mash the potatoes with the veg, leek, cheddar and plenty of pepper, keeping it chunky. Shape into 4 thick cakes and dust lightly in the flour.

steps.title: Fry the cakes
steps.text: Wipe out the frying pan and heat 1 tbsp oil over a medium heat. Fry the cakes for 4–5 min each side without moving them, until a deep golden crust forms.

steps.title: Fry the bacon and eggs
steps.text: While the cakes fry, dry-fry the bacon in a second pan over a medium-high heat for 6–8 min until crisp. Move it to a plate. Add the remaining ½ tbsp oil and fry the eggs for 2–3 min until the whites are set and the yolks still runny.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Put two cakes on each plate and top with the bacon and a fried egg. Serve with the relish on the side.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken, Leek & Mushroom Pan with Crushed Potatoes

ingredients.swap: The mushrooms are cooked in their own pan, so spoon them onto one plate only.

ingredients.t: ½ chicken cube in 150ml boiling water
a pinch, plus extra for the potato water

steps.title: Prep the chicken and veg
steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chunks, slice the leek and mushrooms, and crush the garlic. Dissolve ½ stock cube in 150ml boiling water. Season the chicken with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.text: Put the potatoes in a pan of boiling salted water and cook for 15 min until tender. Drain and keep warm in the pan.

steps.title: Brown the chicken
steps.text: While the potatoes cook, heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the chicken thighs smooth-side down first for 5 min each side, until golden and cooked through with no pink inside. Lift onto a plate.

steps.title: Cook the mushrooms
steps.text: Melt a small knob of the butter in a small frying pan over a high heat. Fry the mushrooms for 5 min until golden, then keep warm in the pan.

steps.title: Make the creamy sauce
steps.text: Turn the chicken pan down to medium and add 15g butter, the leek, garlic and mixed herbs (optional). Cook for 5 min until soft, then pour in the stock and bubble for 2 min. Stir in the cream and mustard and simmer until it coats a spoon. Return the chicken and stir through the spinach until wilted.

steps.title: Crush and serve
steps.text: Lightly crush the potatoes with the remaining butter and a pinch of salt. Serve with the chicken and plenty of sauce, spooning the mushrooms over the top.

photo.alt: Chicken with creamy mushroom sauce and potatoes

recipes.title: Glamorgan Sausages with Tomato Chutney & Crushed Potatoes
recipes.airFryer: Brush the chilled Glamorgan sausages with oil and air-fry at 190°C for 10–12 min, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.

ingredients.t: a pinch, plus extra for the potato water

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Very finely chop the leek and the red onion half, halve the tomatoes and slice the garlic. Grate the cheddar and cut the potatoes into chunks. Separate one of the eggs.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.text: Put the potatoes in a pan of boiling salted water and cook for 15 min until tender. Drain and keep warm in the pan.

steps.title: Soften the leek
steps.text: While the potatoes cook, melt 15g butter in a frying pan over a medium heat. Cook the leek for 4–5 min until soft, then tip into a bowl and wipe out the pan.

steps.title: Shape the sausages
steps.text: Add 60g of the panko, the cheddar, mustard, mixed herbs (optional), the whole egg and the yolk to the leek. Mix until it holds together when squeezed, then shape into 6 small sausages. Beat the egg white, dip in each sausage, then roll in the rest of the panko.

steps.title: Make the tomato chutney
steps.text: In a small pan over a medium heat, cook the tomatoes, red onion and honey with a pinch of salt for 8–10 min. Squash the tomatoes as they soften and stir now and then until thick and jammy.

steps.title: Fry the sausages
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in the frying pan over a medium heat. Fry the sausages for 6–8 min, turning often, until crisp and golden all over and the cheese is just starting to ooze. Lift onto a plate.

steps.title: Wilt the spinach and serve
steps.text: Add the remaining ½ tbsp oil and the garlic to the pan for 30 seconds, then the spinach for 1–2 min until wilted. Lightly crush the potatoes with the remaining butter. Serve the sausages on the potatoes with the spinach and a spoonful of chutney.

source.title: Glamorgan Sausages: Our Traditional Welsh Recipe
source.author: Alex Vines

recipes.title: Crispy-Skin Salmon with Lemon Butter & Leek Crushed Potatoes
recipes.airFryer: Air-fry the oiled, seasoned salmon skin-side up at 200°C for 8–10 min until it flakes easily.

ingredients.swap: Cook the peas in a separate small pan of boiling water for 2–3 min and stir them into one portion of the crushed potatoes only.

ingredients.t: a pinch, plus extra for the potato water

steps.title: Prep the salmon and veg
steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chunks, slice the leek and spring onions and crush the garlic. Zest and juice the lemon. Pat the salmon skin really dry with kitchen paper and season with salt.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.text: Put the potatoes in a pan of boiling salted water and cook for 15 min until tender, adding the peas for the last 2 min. Drain and keep in the pan.

steps.title: Soften the leek
steps.text: While the potatoes cook, melt 15g butter in a small pan over a medium heat. Cook the leek for 5 min until soft and sweet, then stir in the mustard.

steps.title: Fry the salmon
steps.text: When the potatoes have 8 min left, heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat. Lay the salmon in skin-side down and press for 10 seconds so it doesn't curl. Cook for 5–6 min until the skin is crisp and the flesh is opaque two-thirds of the way up, then flip for 1 min.

steps.title: Make the lemon butter
steps.text: Lift the salmon onto a plate and turn the heat to low. Add the remaining butter and the garlic and cook until it foams and smells nutty. Take off the heat and stir in the lemon juice and zest.

steps.title: Crush and serve
steps.text: Roughly crush the potatoes and peas with the leek, spring onions, a pinch of pepper and 1 tbsp of the lemon butter. Serve the salmon on top with the rest of the lemon butter spooned over.

source.title: Pan-fried salmon with smashed potatoes and peas

recipes.title: Sticky Honey & Mustard Chicken Traybake with Sweet Potato
recipes.airFryer: Air-fry the veg at 200°C for 10 min, then add the glazed chicken and cook for 15–18 min more, shaking halfway, until sticky and cooked through.

steps.title: Prep the veg and glaze
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Cut the sweet potato into chunks, the carrots into batons, the red onion into wedges and the broccoli into florets. Crush the garlic and mix it with the honey, mustard and soy sauce in a bowl to make the glaze.

steps.title: Start the veg
steps.text: In a large roasting tin, toss the sweet potato, carrots and red onion with 1 tbsp oil, the mixed herbs (optional) and salt. Spread out in a single layer and roast on the top shelf for 10 min.

steps.title: Add the chicken
steps.text: Toss the chicken in half the glaze, then nestle it among the veg. Roast for 15 min.

steps.title: Glaze and add the broccoli
steps.text: Brush the chicken with the remaining glaze. Toss the broccoli with the remaining ½ tbsp oil and scatter it into the tin. Roast for 10–12 min more, until the chicken is sticky and cooked through with no pink inside and the broccoli is charred at the tips.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Give everything a stir in the sticky pan juices. Divide between plates and spoon over any glaze left in the tin.

recipes.title: Crispy Parmesan Chicken Escalopes with Garlic Potatoes
recipes.airFryer: Spray the crumbed escalopes with oil and air-fry at 200°C for 8–10 min, turning halfway, until golden and cooked through.

ingredients.swap: Cook the peas in a separate small pan of boiling water for 3 min and stir them into one portion of the lettuce only.

ingredients.t: a pinch, plus extra for the potato water

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chunks, crush the garlic and slice the spring onions. Shred the little gem and finely grate the parmesan. Zest the lemon, then cut it into wedges.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.text: Put the potatoes in a pan of boiling salted water and cook for 15–18 min until tender. Drain and keep in the pan.

steps.title: Crumb the chicken
steps.text: While the potatoes cook, put the chicken between two sheets of baking paper and bash with a rolling pin until about 1cm thick. Set out three plates: seasoned flour, the beaten egg, and panko mixed with the parmesan and lemon zest. Dust the chicken in flour, dip in egg, then press firmly into the crumbs.

steps.title: Fry the escalopes
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Fry the escalopes for 3–4 min each side until deep golden and the chicken is white all the way through. Drain on kitchen paper.

steps.title: Cook the peas and lettuce
steps.text: Meanwhile, melt half the butter in a small pan over a medium heat. Add the spring onions, peas and 3 tbsp water and simmer for 3 min. Stir in the little gem for 1 min until just wilted and season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Garlic butter and serve
steps.text: Wipe out the escalope pan and melt the remaining butter with the garlic over a low heat for 30 seconds. Toss half through the potatoes. Serve the escalopes drizzled with the rest, with the potatoes, peas and lettuce, and lemon wedges for squeezing.

photo.alt: Sliced crispy fried chicken fillet with green peas

recipes.title: Smoky Beef Chilli Jacket Potatoes with Cheddar & Yogurt
recipes.airFryer: After microwaving, rub the potatoes with oil and salt and air-fry at 200°C for 10–12 min until the skins are crisp.

ingredients.swap: Leave the chilli flakes out of the pan and sprinkle them over one jacket only.
Scatter the spring onions over one jacket only.

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan) and prick the potatoes all over. Finely chop the onion, dice the pepper and crush the garlic. Drain the kidney beans, grate the cheddar and slice the spring onions (optional).

steps.title: Start the jackets
steps.text: Microwave the potatoes on high for 8–10 min until a knife slides in easily. Rub with 1 tsp oil and a pinch of salt. Bake directly on the oven shelf for 15 min until the skins are crisp.

steps.title: Brown the mince
steps.text: Meanwhile, heat the remaining 1 tsp oil in a frying pan over a high heat. Fry the mince for 5 min, breaking it up, until browned. Add the onion and pepper and cook for 5 min more until soft.

steps.title: Spice the chilli
steps.text: Stir in the garlic, smoked paprika, cumin and chilli flakes (optional) for 1 min until fragrant. Add the chopped tomatoes, tomato purée and kidney beans and crumble in the ½ stock cube.

steps.title: Simmer the chilli
steps.text: Bubble over a medium heat for 10–12 min, stirring now and then, until thick enough to sit on a spoon. Season with salt to taste.

steps.title: Fill and serve
steps.text: Split the jackets with a cross and fluff up the middles. Spoon over the chilli and scatter with the cheddar so it melts. Top with a dollop of yogurt and the spring onions (optional).

recipes.title: Proper Chicken Tikka Masala with Fluffy Basmati Rice
recipes.airFryer: Air-fry the marinated chicken pieces at 200°C for 10–12 min, shaking halfway, until charred at the edges, then add to the sauce.

ingredients.swap: Keep the coriander in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep and marinate
steps.text: Heat the grill to high and boil the kettle. Cut the chicken into chunks, finely chop the onion and grate the garlic. Mix 2 tbsp tikka paste with the yogurt and a pinch of salt, then stir in the chicken. Leave it to marinate while you start the sauce.

steps.title: Start the masala
steps.text: Melt the butter with the oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Add the onion with a pinch of salt and cook for 8–10 min until soft and golden. Stir in the garlic, ginger paste and remaining 2 tbsp tikka paste and fry for 1 min until fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.text: Add the chopped tomatoes, tomato purée, honey and 100ml water. Simmer gently for 10 min, stirring now and then, until thick and jammy. For a smoother sauce, mash the onions in with a potato masher.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: While the sauce simmers, rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Tip it into a small pan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave covered off the heat for 5 min, then fluff with a fork.

steps.title: Grill the tikka
steps.text: While the rice cooks, spread the chicken on a foil-lined tray. Grill for 8–10 min, turning once, until blackened in places and cooked through with no pink inside.

steps.title: Finish the sauce
steps.text: Stir the cream and garam masala into the sauce. Tip in the chicken and any juices and simmer for 2 min so the smoky flavour gets into the sauce. Season to taste.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Divide the rice between bowls. Spoon over the tikka masala and scatter with torn coriander (optional).

photo.alt: Chicken tikka masala served with naan bread

recipes.title: Silky Butter Chicken with Fenugreek & Warm Buttered Naan
recipes.airFryer: Air-fry the marinated thighs at 200°C for 12–14 min, turning halfway, until charred and cooked through.

steps.title: Prep and marinate
steps.text: Heat the grill to high. Cut the chicken into chunks, finely chop the onion and grate the garlic. Mix the yogurt with 1 tsp garam masala, the chilli powder, 1 tsp ginger paste, 1 garlic clove and a good pinch of salt. Stir in the chicken and leave for 10 min.

steps.title: Make the onion base
steps.text: Melt 25g butter in a deep frying pan over a medium heat. Cook the onion for 8 min until soft and golden. Add the remaining garlic and ginger paste, the cumin (optional) and the remaining 1 tsp garam masala and stir for 1 min.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.text: Add the chopped tomatoes, tomato purée, honey and 100ml water. Simmer for 10 min until thickened, then mash or stir hard until fairly smooth.

steps.title: Grill the chicken
steps.text: While the sauce simmers, spread the chicken over a foil-lined tray. Grill for 10–12 min, turning once, until charred in spots and cooked through with no pink inside.

steps.title: Add the cream
steps.text: Pour the cream into the sauce and rub the dried fenugreek (kasoori methi) between your palms over the pan. Bubble for 2 min until the sauce is a rich orange and coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Finish the curry
steps.text: Stir the chicken and its juices into the sauce with the remaining 15g butter. Simmer for 2 min, then season to taste.

steps.title: Warm the naan and serve
steps.text: Warm the naans under the grill for 1 min each side. Serve the butter chicken with the naan for scooping.

photo.alt: Butter chicken in a wooden bowl

recipes.title: Creamy Almond Chicken Korma with Golden Pilau Rice

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Finely chop the onion, grate the garlic and cut the chicken into chunks. Rinse the rice well and leave to drain. Make up 300ml stock with half the stock cube for the rice, and 150ml with the other half for the sauce.

steps.title: Start the pilau
steps.text: Melt 10g butter in a small pan over a medium heat. Add the rice, a pinch of the turmeric and the cinnamon (optional) and stir for 1 min until glossy. Pour in the 300ml stock, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave covered.

steps.title: Cook the onion base
steps.text: While the rice cooks, heat the oil and remaining 10g butter in a frying pan over a medium-low heat. Cook the onion gently for 8–10 min until very soft and pale gold without catching, which keeps the korma sweet. Stir in the garlic, ginger paste, ground coriander, cumin and remaining turmeric for 1 min.

steps.title: Cook the chicken
steps.text: Turn the heat up to medium, add the chicken and stir for 3 min to coat it in the spices. Pour in the 150ml stock and stir in the ground almonds and honey. Simmer for 8–10 min until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.

steps.title: Make it creamy
steps.text: Stir in the cream and garam masala and warm through for 2 min without boiling hard. The sauce should be pale, silky and coat the chicken. Season with salt to taste.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Fluff the pilau with a fork and divide between plates. Spoon the korma alongside.

photo.alt: Creamy chicken curry in a bowl with nuts

recipes.title: Fiery Chicken Madras with Crispy Onion Bhajis & Raita
recipes.airFryer: Spoon the bhaji batter onto baking paper in the basket, spray well with oil and air-fry at 200°C for 12–14 min, turning halfway, until crisp and deep golden.

ingredients.t: 2 (1 chopped for the curry, 1 thinly sliced for bhajis)
1 tbsp for the curry, plus about 150ml for shallow frying

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Finely chop one onion and thinly slice the other. Cut the chicken into chunks, grate the garlic and grate the cucumber.

steps.title: Make the raita
steps.text: Squeeze the grated cucumber in your hands to get rid of the water. Stir it into the yogurt with a pinch of salt, then chill until needed.

steps.title: Start the madras
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a saucepan over a medium heat and fry the chopped onion for 8 min until golden. Add the garlic, ginger paste, curry powder, ground cumin (optional) and all but a pinch of the chilli powder. Stir for 1 min until fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer the curry
steps.text: Add the chicken and cook for 3 min until sealed all over. Tip in the chopped tomatoes, tomato purée and 150ml water. Cover and simmer for 20 min until thick and the chicken is tender.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: While the curry simmers, rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Tip it into a small pan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave covered until needed.

steps.title: Make the bhaji batter
steps.text: Mix the gram flour, turmeric, cumin seeds, the reserved pinch of chilli powder and ½ tsp salt in a bowl. Add the sliced onion and 4–5 tbsp cold water. Mix with your hands until every strand is coated in a thick, sticky batter.

steps.title: Fry the bhajis
steps.text: Heat 1cm oil in a frying pan over a medium-high heat until a drop of batter sizzles straight away. Fry heaped tablespoons of the mixture, flattened slightly, for 3–4 min each side until deep golden and crisp. Drain on kitchen paper and sprinkle with salt. Let the leftover oil cool, then throw it away.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Stir the garam masala and a squeeze of lemon (optional) into the madras and season. Serve with the rice, hot bhajis, raita and the rest of the lemon in wedges (optional).

photo.alt: Bowl of chicken curry next to a bowl of rice

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Naan Pizzas with Mango Chutney & Mozzarella
recipes.airFryer: Cook one topped naan at a time at 190°C for 5–6 min until the cheese is bubbling and the base is crisp.

ingredients.t: 1 large breast (200g), cut into small pieces

ingredients.swap: Scatter the chilli over one pizza only.
Keep the coriander in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Cut the chicken into small pieces, then mix 1 tbsp tikka paste with 1 tbsp yogurt and toss the chicken in it. Thinly slice the red onion, pepper and green chilli (optional).

steps.title: Cook the tikka
steps.text: Heat the oil in a frying pan over a high heat. Fry the chicken for 5–6 min until charred at the edges and cooked through, adding the pepper for the last 2 min. Tip onto a plate.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: In the same pan over a medium heat, fry the remaining 2 tbsp tikka paste for 30 sec. Add the chopped tomatoes and bubble for 3 min until thick enough to spread like pizza sauce.

steps.title: Top the naans
steps.text: Put the naans on a baking tray and spread over the sauce. Top with the chicken, pepper, red onion and torn mozzarella.

steps.title: Bake the pizzas
steps.text: Bake for 8–10 min until the cheese is melted and blistered and the naan edges are crisp. While they bake, loosen the remaining yogurt with a squeeze of lemon and a splash of water.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Drizzle the yogurt over the hot pizzas and dot with the mango chutney. Scatter with the chilli and coriander (both optional), then cut into slices.

recipes.title: Slow-Simmered Lamb Rogan Josh with Cumin Rice

ingredients.swap: Keep the coriander in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle and make up 300ml stock with the cube. Finely slice the onions and grate the garlic. Pat the lamb dry and season with salt. Mix the smoked paprika, chilli powder, ground coriander, cumin, cinnamon (optional) and 1 tsp garam masala in a small bowl.

steps.title: Brown the lamb
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a heavy casserole or saucepan over a high heat. Brown the lamb in one layer for 4–5 min until well coloured, then lift onto a plate.

steps.title: Cook the onions
steps.text: Lower the heat to medium and add the remaining 1 tbsp oil and the onions. Cook for 10–12 min, stirring often, until deep golden and sticky.

steps.title: Build the sauce
steps.text: Stir in the garlic, ginger paste and spice mix and cook for 1 min until fragrant. Take the pan off the heat and stir in the yogurt a spoonful at a time so it doesn't split. Add the chopped tomatoes, tomato purée and stock.

steps.title: Simmer low and slow
steps.text: Return the lamb and its juices and bring to a gentle simmer. Cover and cook on a low heat for 1 hour, stirring now and then. Take the lid off for the last 10 min, until the lamb breaks apart with a spoon and the sauce is deep brick-red.

steps.title: Cook the cumin rice
steps.text: With 20 min to go, rinse the rice. Toast the cumin seeds in a small dry pan over a medium heat for 30 sec. Add the rice, 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt, cover and simmer on the lowest heat for 10 min. Rest off the heat, covered, for 5 min.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Stir the remaining 1 tsp garam masala into the rogan josh and season to taste. Spoon over the rice and scatter with coriander (optional).

photo.alt: Rich red mutton curry on a white plate

recipes.title: Layered Chicken Biryani with Crispy Onions & Cucumber Raita
recipes.airFryer: Toss the sliced onions in 1 tbsp oil and air-fry at 180°C for 12–15 min, shaking every few minutes, until deep golden and crisp.

ingredients.t: 350g thigh fillets, cut into large chunks

ingredients.swap: Leave the coriander out of the layers and keep it in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and boil the kettle. Thinly slice the onions, grate the garlic and cut the chicken into large chunks. Chop the coriander and grate the cucumber.

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.text: Mix 100g yogurt with the garam masala, chilli powder, ½ tsp turmeric, the ginger paste, garlic, lemon juice and 1 tsp salt. Stir in the chicken and leave for 15 min while you fry the onions.

steps.title: Fry the onions
steps.text: Heat the oil in a lidded ovenproof casserole over a medium-high heat. Fry the onions for 12–15 min, stirring often, until deep golden and crisp. Lift out half with a slotted spoon onto kitchen paper and leave the rest in the pan.

steps.title: Par-boil the rice
steps.text: While the onions fry, rinse the rice. Cook it in a pan of salted boiling water with the cinnamon (optional) for 5 min, until softening outside but still firm in the middle. Drain well.

steps.title: Cook the chicken layer
steps.text: Add the chicken and marinade to the onions in the casserole. Cook over a medium heat for 8 min, stirring, until sealed and the sauce has thickened. Meanwhile, stir the remaining ½ tsp turmeric into the milk.

steps.title: Layer and bake
steps.text: Scatter half the coriander (optional) over the chicken, then spread the rice on top. Drizzle over the turmeric milk and dot with the butter. Cover tightly with foil, then the lid, and bake for 25 min until the rice is tender and the chicken is cooked through.

steps.title: Make the raita
steps.text: While it bakes, squeeze the grated cucumber dry. Mix it into the remaining 80g yogurt with a pinch of salt and chill.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Fluff the biryani gently with a fork. Scatter with the crispy onions and the rest of the coriander (optional), and serve with the raita.

photo.credit: Circle Digital Marketing Agency on Unsplash
photo.alt: Chicken biryani on a white plate

recipes.title: Paneer & Mushroom Tikka Skewers with Garlic Naan
recipes.airFryer: Lay the skewers in the basket and air-fry at 200°C for 10–12 min, turning halfway, until charred at the edges.

ingredients.swap: Thread the mushrooms onto their own skewer and give it to one plate only; add extra pepper and onion to the other skewers.
Keep the coriander in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Cut the paneer into 2.5cm cubes, the pepper into chunks and the red onion into wedges. Halve the mushrooms, crush the garlic and grate the cucumber. If using wooden skewers, soak 4–6 in water.

steps.title: Marinate the skewers
steps.text: Mix 80g yogurt with the tikka paste, kasoori methi (optional), the juice of half the lemon and a pinch of salt. Add the paneer, pepper, onion and mushrooms and toss gently until coated. Leave for 15 min, or longer if you have time.

steps.title: Make the raita
steps.text: Squeeze the grated cucumber dry. Stir it into the remaining 70g yogurt with a pinch of salt and chill.

steps.title: Thread the skewers
steps.text: Heat the grill to high. Thread the paneer and veg alternately onto the skewers and lay them on a foil-lined tray. Drizzle with any marinade left in the bowl.

steps.title: Make the garlic butter
steps.text: Melt the butter with the crushed garlic in a small pan over a low heat for 2 min until fragrant. Stir in a few chopped coriander stalks (optional).

steps.title: Grill until charred
steps.text: Grill the skewers for 10–12 min, turning every few minutes, until the paneer is golden and the veg are charred at the edges. Warm the naans under the grill for the last minute and brush with the garlic butter.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Squeeze the rest of the lemon over the skewers and scatter with coriander leaves (optional). Serve with the garlic naans, raita and mango chutney.

source.title: Paneer Tikka Recipe in Oven, Air Fryer, Stovetop
source.author: Swasthi Shreekanth

photo.alt: Grilled paneer tikka on a plate

recipes.title: Indo-Chinese Chilli Chicken with Spring Onion Rice
recipes.airFryer: Spray the coated chicken generously with oil and air-fry at 200°C for 12–14 min, shaking halfway, until crisp, then toss in the sauce.

ingredients.t: 350g thigh fillets, cut into bite-size pieces

ingredients.swap: Fry the chillies separately for a minute and spoon them over one plate only.

ingredients.t: 4, sliced (half for the rice, half to serve)
ingredients.swap: Stir the spring onions through one portion of rice only and scatter the rest over that plate.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and the pepper and onion into squares. Finely chop the garlic, slit the green chillies lengthways and slice the spring onions.

steps.title: Coat the chicken
steps.text: Mix the chicken with the egg, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp ginger paste and a pinch each of salt and black pepper. Sprinkle over 3 tbsp cornflour and mix until each piece has a sticky coating. For the sauce, mix the remaining 2 tbsp soy, the sweet chilli sauce, tomato purée, 1 tsp cornflour and 4 tbsp water in a cup.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Tip it into a small pan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave covered for 5 min, then stir through half the spring onions.

steps.title: Fry the chicken
steps.text: While the rice cooks, heat about 1cm oil in a wok or large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the chicken in two batches for 5–6 min, turning, until deep golden, crisp and cooked through. Drain on kitchen paper. Carefully pour off all but 1 tbsp oil and throw it away once cool.

steps.title: Stir-fry the veg
steps.text: Put the wok back over a high heat. Stir-fry the garlic, remaining 1 tsp ginger paste and green chillies for 30 sec. Add the onion and pepper and toss for 2–3 min until charred at the edges but still crunchy.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Pour in the sauce mix and bubble for 1 min until glossy and thick. Tip the crispy chicken back in and toss quickly so every piece is coated but stays crunchy.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Scatter with the rest of the spring onions and a pinch of black pepper. Serve straight away with the spring onion rice.

photo.alt: Dry chilli chicken served with chapati

recipes.title: Lamb Seekh Kebab Wraps with Pickled Onions & Raita
recipes.airFryer: Air-fry the kebabs at 200°C for 10–12 min, turning halfway, until browned and cooked through.

ingredients.swap: Mix the chilli flakes into the raita for one portion instead of the kebabs.
Leave the coriander out of the kebab mix and keep it in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Heat the grill to high. Cut the red onion in half: thinly slice one half and grate the other. Grate the garlic, chop the coriander and shred the lettuce. Grate half the cucumber and cut the rest into sticks.

steps.title: Pickle the onion
steps.text: Put the sliced red onion in a bowl with the juice of half the lemon and a big pinch of salt. Scrunch with your fingers and set aside to turn pink.

steps.title: Mix the kebabs
steps.text: Squeeze the juice out of the grated onion. Mix it with the lamb, garlic, ginger paste, garam masala, cumin, chilli flakes (optional), half the coriander (optional) and ½ tsp salt. Knead for 1 min until sticky, then shape into 6 long sausage shapes, pressing firmly.

steps.title: Grill the kebabs
steps.text: Lay the kebabs on a foil-lined tray. Grill for 10–12 min, turning every few minutes, until browned, sizzling and cooked through with no pink inside.

steps.title: Make the raita
steps.text: While the kebabs grill, squeeze the grated cucumber dry. Mix it with the yogurt, a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Wrap and serve
steps.text: Warm the wraps under the grill for 20 sec each side. Spread with raita and mango chutney, then add lettuce, cucumber sticks, kebabs, pickled onions and the rest of the coriander (optional). Roll up tightly and serve with the remaining lemon in wedges.

recipes.title: Amritsari Fish Bites with Masala Chips & Coriander Yogurt
recipes.airFryer: Air-fry the chips at 200°C for 18–20 min, shaking halfway; then spray the battered fish with oil and air-fry at 200°C for 8–10 min, turning once, until crisp.

ingredients.t: 2 tbsp for the chips, plus about 100ml for frying

ingredients.swap: Leave the coriander out of the yogurt and keep it in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Cut the potatoes into chips and the fish into chunky strips. Grate the garlic, finely slice the red onion and chop the coriander.

steps.title: Roast the chips
steps.text: Toss the chips with 2 tbsp oil and a pinch of salt on a large baking tray. Roast for 35–40 min, turning halfway, until crisp and golden.

steps.title: Marinate the fish
steps.text: While the chips roast, toss the fish with the ginger paste, garlic, juice of half the lemon and a pinch of salt. Leave for 10 min.

steps.title: Make the coriander yogurt
steps.text: Mix the yogurt with most of the coriander (optional), a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt. Chill until needed.

steps.title: Batter the fish
steps.text: Whisk the gram flour, cornflour, 1 tsp chilli powder, the turmeric, cumin seeds (optional) and ½ tsp salt with about 5 tbsp cold water. It should make a thick batter that clings to a spoon. Add the fish and turn gently to coat.

steps.title: Fry the fish
steps.text: When the chips have 10 min left, heat 1cm oil in a frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the fish in batches for 2–3 min each side until crisp, golden and flaking easily. Drain on kitchen paper, and let the leftover oil cool before throwing it away.

steps.title: Spice the chips and serve
steps.text: Toss the hot chips with the garam masala, remaining ½ tsp chilli powder and a little salt. Pile the fish and chips onto plates with the red onion (optional), lemon wedges, coriander yogurt and the rest of the coriander (optional).

recipes.title: Smoky Chicken Jalfrezi with Charred Peppers & Green Chilli

ingredients.t: 1 (half sliced into petals, half finely chopped)

ingredients.swap: Slice the chilli and scatter it over one plate only instead of cooking it into the dish.
Keep the coriander in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Cut the chicken into chunks and the peppers into chunky squares. Cut half the onion into chunky petals and finely chop the rest. Grate the garlic and slice the green chillies.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Tip it into a small pan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave covered off the heat for 5 min, then fluff with a fork.

steps.title: Char the veg
steps.text: While the rice cooks, heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan or wok over a high heat. Stir-fry the peppers and onion petals for 4–5 min until blackened in patches but still crunchy. Tip onto a plate.

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.text: Toss the chicken with the turmeric (optional), half the curry powder and a pinch of salt. Add the remaining 1 tbsp oil to the pan and fry the chicken for 4–5 min until browned all over.

steps.title: Add the aromatics
steps.text: Push the chicken to one side. Add the cumin seeds, chopped onion, garlic, ginger paste and most of the chilli, and stir for 2 min until the onion softens.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.text: Stir in the rest of the curry powder, then the chopped tomatoes and a splash of water. Simmer for 6–8 min until the sauce is thick and clinging and the chicken is cooked through. Fold the charred veg back in with the garam masala.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Spoon the rice onto plates. Serve the jalfrezi alongside, topped with the remaining chilli and coriander (optional).

photo.alt: Spicy chicken karahi in a black bowl

recipes.title: Garlicky Saag Chicken with Spinach & Warm Naan

ingredients.swap: Slice the chilli and scatter it over one plate only instead of cooking it into the dish.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Cut the chicken into chunks, finely chop the onion and green chilli, and slice the garlic.

steps.title: Wilt the spinach
steps.text: Put the spinach in a colander and pour over the kettle of boiling water until it collapses. Leave to cool for a minute, then squeeze out as much water as you can. Chop finely into a rough purée.

steps.title: Brown the chicken
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the chicken with a pinch of salt for 5 min until golden all over, then lift onto a plate.

steps.title: Build the masala
steps.text: Lower the heat to medium, add the butter and cumin seeds and let them sizzle for 30 sec. Add the onion and cook for 6–7 min until golden. Stir in the garlic, ginger paste, chilli, ground cumin (optional) and ground coriander for 1 min.

steps.title: Simmer the chicken
steps.text: Add the chopped tomatoes and cook for 3 min until jammy. Return the chicken with a splash of water and simmer for 8 min until cooked through with no pink inside.

steps.title: Add the saag
steps.text: Stir in the spinach and garam masala and cook for 2 min until the sauce is thick and deep green. Take off the heat, swirl through the yogurt and season.

steps.title: Warm the naan and serve
steps.text: Warm the naans in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 1 min each side. Serve alongside the saag chicken.

photo.alt: Spinach curry served with flatbread

recipes.title: Keema Matar with Spiced Beef, Peas & Chapati-Style Wraps

ingredients.swap: Cook the peas in a small pan of boiling water for 3 min and stir them into one portion only.
Keep the coriander in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Finely chop the onion and grate the garlic. Take the peas out of the freezer so they start to thaw.

steps.title: Brown the mince
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a high heat. Add the mince and fry for 5–6 min, breaking it up with a wooden spoon, until browned and starting to crisp.

steps.title: Add the aromatics
steps.text: Turn the heat to medium, add the cumin seeds and onion and cook for 5 min until the onion is soft. Stir in the garlic, ginger paste and curry powder and cook for 1 min until it smells toasty.

steps.title: Simmer the keema
steps.text: Add the chopped tomatoes, tomato purée and 100ml water. Simmer for 10 min, stirring now and then, until thick and rich.

steps.title: Add the peas
steps.text: Stir in the peas and garam masala and cook for 3 min until the peas are hot and bright green. Season with salt and a squeeze of lemon (optional).

steps.title: Warm the wraps and serve
steps.text: Warm the wraps one at a time in a hot dry pan for 20 sec each side, until blistered like chapatis. Serve the keema with the wraps, a dollop of yogurt (optional) and coriander (optional).

source.title: Keema Recipe (Mutton Keema Curry), keema matar variation
source.author: Swasthi Shreekanth

recipes.title: Punjabi Chana Masala with Spinach & Lemony Rice

ingredients.swap: Slice the chilli and scatter it over one plate only instead of cooking it into the dish.
Keep the coriander in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Finely chop the onion, grate the garlic and slit the green chilli. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Tip it into a small pan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave covered off the heat for 5 min, then fluff with a fork.

steps.title: Fry the masala
steps.text: While the rice cooks, heat the oil in a saucepan over a medium heat. Sizzle the cumin seeds for 30 sec, then add the onion and cook for 8 min until golden brown. Stir in the garlic, ginger paste, green chilli, ground coriander, turmeric, chilli powder (optional) and 1 tsp garam masala for 1 min.

steps.title: Simmer the chickpeas
steps.text: Add the chopped tomatoes, chickpeas, 100ml water and a good pinch of salt. Simmer for 10 min, crushing a few chickpeas against the side of the pan, until the sauce is rich and glossy.

steps.title: Finish the curry
steps.text: Stir in the spinach until wilted. Add the remaining 1 tsp garam masala and the juice of half the lemon, then season to taste.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Stir a squeeze of lemon through the rice. Spoon the chana masala alongside and top with coriander (optional) and the rest of the lemon in wedges.

photo.alt: Chana masala garnished with cilantro and ginger

recipes.title: Restaurant-Style Tarka Dal with Sizzling Garlic & Jeera Rice

ingredients.swap: Sprinkle the chilli flakes over one bowl at the end instead of adding them to the tarka.
Keep the coriander in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Finely chop the onion, thinly slice the garlic and halve the cherry tomatoes. Rinse the lentils until the water runs clear, then rinse the rice.

steps.title: Cook the lentils
steps.text: Tip the lentils into a saucepan with 700ml water, the turmeric and ginger paste. Bring to the boil and skim off any froth. Simmer for 20–25 min, stirring now and then, until completely soft and porridgey; add a splash more water if it gets too thick.

steps.title: Make the jeera rice
steps.text: Meanwhile, toast 1 tsp cumin seeds in a small dry pan over a medium heat for 30 sec. Add the rice, 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 10 min, then leave covered off the heat.

steps.title: Cook the onion base
steps.text: Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat and cook the onion for 8 min until golden. Add the tomatoes and cook for 3 min until they collapse. Stir everything into the soft lentils with the garam masala and 1 tsp salt, then whisk hard until creamy.

steps.title: Make the tarka
steps.text: For the tarka (a sizzling spiced butter), wipe out the frying pan and melt the butter over a medium-high heat. Add the remaining 1 tsp cumin seeds, the mustard seeds (optional) and the garlic. Fry for 1–2 min until the seeds pop and the garlic is pale golden. Add the chilli flakes (optional) for the last few seconds.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Pour most of the tarka over the dal (it should hiss) and stir once. Squeeze in the lemon (optional). Serve with the jeera rice, the last of the tarka on top and coriander (optional).

photo.alt: Tempered lentil dal with jeera basmati rice

recipes.title: Creamy Coconut Dal with Spinach & Tomato-Chilli Salsa

ingredients.swap: Stir the chilli into half of the salsa only.
Leave the coriander out of the salsa and keep it in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Finely chop the onion, cherry tomatoes, red onion and green chilli. Grate the garlic and rinse the lentils.

steps.title: Make the salsa
steps.text: Mix the cherry tomatoes, red onion, chilli (optional) and half the coriander (optional) with the juice of half the lime and a pinch of salt. Set aside so the flavours mingle.

steps.title: Fry the aromatics
steps.text: Heat the oil in a saucepan over a medium heat. Add the mustard seeds (optional) and, when they start to pop, the onion. Cook for 6–7 min until soft and lightly golden, then stir in the garlic, ginger paste, turmeric and cumin for 1 min.

steps.title: Simmer the dal
steps.text: Add the lentils, coconut milk and 400ml boiling water. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 15–18 min, stirring often so it doesn't catch, until thick and creamy.

steps.title: Add the spinach
steps.text: Stir in the spinach a handful at a time until wilted. Season with salt and the rest of the lime juice.

steps.title: Warm the naan and serve
steps.text: Warm the naans in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 1 min each side. Ladle the dal into bowls and top with the salsa and remaining coriander (optional). Serve with the naan for dunking.

source.title: Quick Coconut Dal with Tomato Sambol
source.author: Meera Sodha

photo.alt: Bowl of yellow dal with garnishes and bread

recipes.title: Mattar Paneer with Golden Paneer, Peas & Tomato Gravy

ingredients.swap: Cook the peas in a small pan of boiling water for 3 min and stir them into one portion only; the paneer and gravy go in as normal.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Cut the paneer into 2cm cubes and pat dry with kitchen paper. Finely chop the onion and grate the garlic.

steps.title: Fry the paneer
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the paneer for 4–5 min, turning, until golden on most sides. Tip into a bowl of warm water to keep it soft.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Meanwhile, rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Tip it into a small pan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave covered for 5 min.

steps.title: Cook the onion base
steps.text: Add the remaining 1 tbsp oil and the cumin seeds to the frying pan over a medium heat, then the onion. Cook for 7 min until golden. Stir in the garlic, ginger paste, ground coriander, turmeric (optional) and chilli powder for 1 min.

steps.title: Simmer the gravy
steps.text: Add the chopped tomatoes and 150ml water. Simmer for 8 min until thick and the oil starts to pool at the edges.

steps.title: Add the peas and paneer
steps.text: Drain the paneer and add it to the pan with the peas. Simmer for 4 min until the peas are tender. Stir in the cream and garam masala, then crumble in the kasoori methi (optional) between your fingers and season.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Fluff the rice with a fork and divide between plates. Spoon the mattar paneer alongside.

photo.alt: Paneer in a rich spiced tomato curry with rice

recipes.title: Saag Paneer with Crispy Paneer, Garlicky Spinach & Naan

ingredients.swap: Slice the chilli and scatter it over one plate only instead of cooking it into the dish.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Cut the paneer into cubes, finely chop the onion and green chilli, and grate the garlic.

steps.title: Blanch the spinach
steps.text: Put the spinach in a large bowl and pour over boiling water to cover. Leave for 1 min until wilted, then drain and rinse under cold water to keep it bright green. Squeeze out the water and blitz in a blender with a splash of water to a coarse purée.

steps.title: Crisp the paneer
steps.text: Toss the paneer with the turmeric and a pinch of salt. Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat and fry for 4–5 min until golden and crisp. Lift onto a plate.

steps.title: Cook the base
steps.text: Melt the butter in the same pan over a medium heat and sizzle the cumin seeds for 30 sec. Add the onion and cook for 7 min until soft and golden. Stir in the garlic, ginger paste, chilli and ground cumin (optional) for 1 min.

steps.title: Bring it together
steps.text: Stir in the spinach purée with a splash of water and simmer for 3–4 min. Add the cream, garam masala and paneer and cook for 2 min until hot through. Season with salt and a squeeze of lemon (optional).

steps.title: Warm the naan and serve
steps.text: Warm the naans in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 1 min each side. Serve with the saag paneer.

photo.alt: Palak paneer, a spinach and paneer curry, in a white bowl

recipes.title: Dhaba-Style Egg Curry with Golden Eggs & Tomato Masala

ingredients.swap: Keep the coriander in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Finely chop the onion and grate the garlic. Rinse the rice until the water runs clear.

steps.title: Boil the eggs
steps.text: Lower the eggs into a pan of boiling water and cook for 8 min. Transfer to cold water. When cool enough to handle, peel and score each egg a few times so the sauce can seep in.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: While the eggs boil, tip the rice into a small pan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave covered for 5 min.

steps.title: Fry the eggs
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a frying pan over a medium heat. Add the eggs with half the turmeric and half the chilli powder. Roll them around for 2 min until golden and blistered, then lift onto a plate.

steps.title: Make the masala
steps.text: Add the remaining 1 tbsp oil and the mustard seeds (optional) to the pan. When they pop, add the onion and cook for 8 min until deep golden. Stir in the garlic, ginger paste, ground coriander and remaining turmeric and chilli powder for 1 min. Add the chopped tomatoes and cook for 5 min until thick and the oil separates.

steps.title: Simmer the curry
steps.text: Stir in the coconut milk and a splash of water and simmer for 3 min. Return the eggs, spoon over the sauce and stir in the garam masala. Season with salt.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Fluff the rice and divide between plates. Halve the eggs and serve with the masala, scattered with coriander (optional).

photo.alt: Eggs in a rich, spicy Indian curry

recipes.title: Tangy Goan Prawn Curry with Coconut & Lime

ingredients.swap: Slice the chilli and scatter it over one plate only instead of cooking it into the dish.
Keep the coriander in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Finely slice the onion, grate the garlic, slit the green chilli and halve the cherry tomatoes. Pat the defrosted prawns dry and toss with a pinch each of turmeric and salt. Mix the chilli powder, smoked paprika, ground coriander, cumin (optional) and remaining turmeric with 2 tbsp water to make a paste.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Tip it into a small pan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave covered off the heat for 5 min, then fluff with a fork.

steps.title: Cook the onion
steps.text: While the rice cooks, heat the oil in a wide pan over a medium heat. Add the mustard seeds (optional) and, once they pop, the onion. Cook for 7 min until soft and golden.

steps.title: Fry the spices
steps.text: Stir in the garlic, ginger paste and green chilli (optional) for 1 min. Add the spice paste and fry for 1 min until it darkens and smells rich.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.text: Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for 2 min, then pour in the coconut milk. Simmer for 6–8 min until slightly thickened and a deep orange-red.

steps.title: Cook the prawns
steps.text: Stir in the prawns and simmer for 2–3 min until pink and curled; don't overcook or they go rubbery. Squeeze in the juice of half the lime and season.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Divide the rice between bowls and ladle over the curry. Serve with the rest of the lime in wedges and coriander (optional).

source.title: Goan Prawn Curry with Coconut (Ambot Tik)
source.author: Richa

photo.alt: Prawn curry in a metal bowl

recipes.title: Keralan Coconut Fish Curry with Mustard Seeds & Lime

ingredients.swap: Slice the chilli and scatter it over one plate only instead of cooking it into the dish.
Keep the coriander in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Thinly slice the onion, slice the garlic, slit the green chillies and halve the cherry tomatoes. Cut the fish into large chunks and toss with ½ tsp turmeric, the juice of half the lime and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Tip it into a small pan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave covered off the heat for 5 min, then fluff with a fork.

steps.title: Fry the aromatics
steps.text: While the rice cooks, heat the oil in a wide shallow pan over a medium heat. Add the mustard seeds and, once they start to pop, stir in the onion, garlic and chillies. Cook for 6–8 min until soft and lightly golden.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Add the ginger paste, remaining ½ tsp turmeric, chilli powder and ground coriander (optional) and stir for 1 min. Add the cherry tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer for 5 min until sunny yellow and slightly thickened.

steps.title: Poach the fish
steps.text: Nestle the fish into the sauce and spoon some over the top. Simmer very gently for 5–6 min, shaking the pan rather than stirring, until the fish is opaque and flakes easily.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Season with salt and a squeeze more lime. Serve in shallow bowls over the rice with coriander (optional).

photo.alt: Kerala fish curry in a steel bowl

recipes.title: Roasted Aloo Gobi with Chickpeas, Cumin & Lemony Yogurt
recipes.airFryer: Air-fry the spiced potatoes and cauliflower at 200°C for 18–20 min, shaking every 5 min, until golden and tender.

ingredients.swap: Keep the coriander in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Cut the cauliflower into florets and the potatoes into 2cm chunks, and drain the chickpeas. Slice the onion, grate the garlic and halve the cherry tomatoes.

steps.title: Roast the veg
steps.text: Toss the cauliflower, potatoes and chickpeas on a large roasting tray with 2 tbsp oil, the turmeric, half the curry powder and 1 tsp salt. Roast for 25 min, turning halfway, until the potatoes are tender and the cauliflower is charred at the edges.

steps.title: Make the masala
steps.text: With 15 min of roasting left, heat the remaining 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Sizzle the cumin seeds for 30 sec, add the onion and cook for 8 min until golden. Stir in the garlic, ginger paste and remaining curry powder for 1 min. Add the tomatoes and a splash of water and cook for 4 min until they collapse into a thick sauce.

steps.title: Make the lemony yogurt
steps.text: Mix the yogurt with a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt. Set aside until serving.

steps.title: Toss together
steps.text: Tip the roasted veg and chickpeas into the masala pan with the garam masala (optional). Toss over the heat for 2 min until coated, then add a squeeze of lemon and season. Meanwhile, warm the naans in the oven for 2 min.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Divide the aloo gobi between plates. Serve with the warm naans, lemony yogurt and coriander (optional).

recipes.title: Tandoori Chicken Traybake with Bombay Potatoes & Kachumber
recipes.airFryer: Air-fry the potatoes at 200°C for 10 min, then add the chicken and cook for a further 14–16 min, shaking halfway, until charred and cooked through.

ingredients.swap: Leave the coriander out of the salad and keep it in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Cut the potatoes into 2cm chunks. Cut half the red onion into wedges and finely chop the rest. Grate the garlic, chop the cherry tomatoes and coriander, and dice the cucumber.

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.text: Mix 80g yogurt with the garam masala, paprika, chilli powder and ½ tsp turmeric. Stir in the ginger paste, garlic, juice of half the lemon and 1 tsp salt. Slash each chicken thigh a couple of times and coat well in the marinade.

steps.title: Start the Bombay potatoes
steps.text: Toss the potatoes on a large roasting tray with the oil, cumin seeds, mustard seeds (optional), remaining ½ tsp turmeric and a pinch of salt. Roast for 15 min until they start to colour.

steps.title: Roast the chicken
steps.text: Push the potatoes to the edges, add the onion wedges and lay the chicken in the middle. Roast for 25 min until the chicken is charred at the edges and the juices run clear, and the potatoes are crisp.

steps.title: Make the kachumber
steps.text: While it roasts, make the kachumber, a fresh chopped salad. Mix the tomatoes, cucumber and chopped red onion with a squeeze of lemon, a pinch of salt and the coriander (optional). Loosen the remaining 40g yogurt with a splash of water and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Pile the chicken and Bombay potatoes onto plates and drizzle with the yogurt. Serve with the kachumber and the rest of the lemon in wedges.

photo.alt: Tray of tandoori chicken with dipping sauce

recipes.title: Chicken Kathi Rolls with Egg-Fried Wraps & Pickled Onion

ingredients.swap: Add the chilli to one person's rolls only.
Leave the coriander out of the yogurt and keep it in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Cut the chicken into strips and mix with the tikka paste, 2 tbsp yogurt and a pinch of salt. Thinly slice the red onion, pepper and green chilli, cut the cucumber into sticks and chop the coriander. Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Make the toppings
steps.text: Toss the red onion with the juice of half the lemon, the chilli powder (optional) and a pinch of salt, and leave to soften. Stir the remaining yogurt with a squeeze of lemon, a pinch of salt and most of the coriander (optional).

steps.title: Cook the chicken
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over a high heat. Fry the chicken and pepper for 6–7 min until the chicken is charred at the edges and cooked through. Tip into a bowl and wipe out the pan.

steps.title: Make the egg-fried wraps
steps.text: Heat a little of the remaining oil in the pan over a medium heat. Pour in a quarter of the egg, swirl, and immediately press a wrap on top. Cook for 1 min until the egg sets and sticks, then flip for 30 sec. Repeat with the rest.

steps.title: Roll and serve
steps.text: Lay each wrap egg-side up and add the chicken and pepper, pickled onion, cucumber, chilli (optional) and a spoonful of yogurt. Roll tightly and wrap the bottom in foil or baking paper like a street-food roll. Serve with the rest of the lemon in wedges.

photo.alt: Indian street-food chicken roll on a wooden board

recipes.title: Spiced Red Lentil & Spinach Soup with Garlic-Butter Naan

ingredients.swap: Sprinkle chilli flakes over one bowl only.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle and make up 900ml stock with the cube. Chop the onion and carrots and rinse the lentils. Grate 2 garlic cloves for the soup and crush the other 2 for the naan.

steps.title: Soften the veg
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Cook the onion and carrots for 6–7 min until starting to soften. Stir in the grated garlic, ginger paste, cumin, curry powder and turmeric (optional) for 1 min until fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer the soup
steps.text: Add the lentils, chopped tomatoes and stock. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 18–20 min until the lentils have collapsed and the carrots are completely tender.

steps.title: Make the garlic naan
steps.text: While the soup simmers, melt the butter with the crushed garlic in a small pan over a low heat. Brush it over the naans, then warm them in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 1–2 min each side until golden.

steps.title: Blend and add spinach
steps.text: Blitz the soup with a stick blender until mostly smooth but with a little texture. Stir in the spinach for 1–2 min until wilted. Season with salt and a squeeze of lemon (optional), adding a splash of water if it's too thick.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Ladle the soup into bowls and swirl in the yogurt (optional). Sprinkle with chilli flakes (optional) and serve with the garlic naan torn into strips.

source.title: Spiced Lentil, Spinach and Cumin Soup

recipes.title: Chicken & Mushroom Balti with Peppers & Naan

ingredients.swap: Fry the mushrooms in a separate small pan and add them to one plate only.
Keep the coriander in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Cut the chicken, pepper and onion into similar-sized chunks. Quarter the mushrooms and grate the garlic. Toss the chicken with 1 tsp curry powder and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Fry the mushrooms
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a small frying pan over a high heat. Fry the mushrooms for 5 min until golden and any liquid has evaporated. Season and set aside.

steps.title: Brown the chicken
steps.text: Heat the remaining 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over a high heat. Add the cumin seeds, then the chicken, and fry for 4 min until browned. Add the onion and pepper and stir-fry for 3 min until starting to soften and char.

steps.title: Make the balti sauce
steps.text: Stir in the garlic, ginger paste and remaining 3 tsp curry powder for 1 min. Add the chopped tomatoes and tomato purée. Bubble over a medium-high heat for 8–10 min, stirring, until the sauce clings and the chicken is cooked through.

steps.title: Add the spinach
steps.text: Stir in the spinach and garam masala until wilted, then season. Spoon the fried mushrooms over the top.

steps.title: Warm the naan and serve
steps.text: Warm the naans in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 1 min each side. Serve the balti scattered with coriander (optional), with the naan alongside.

photo.alt: Chicken curry in a white bowl with sauce

recipes.title: Kadai Paneer with Mushrooms, Peppers & Roasted Spices

ingredients.swap: Fry the mushrooms in a separate small pan and add them to one plate only.
Leave the chilli flakes out and sprinkle them over one plate at the end.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Cube the paneer, halve the mushrooms and cut the peppers into squares. Finely chop half the onion and cut the other half into petals. Grate the garlic.

steps.title: Toast the spice mix
steps.text: Toast the cumin seeds and chilli flakes (optional) in a dry wok over a medium heat for 1 min until fragrant. Tip into a bowl and roughly crush with the ground coriander using the end of a rolling pin. This is your kadai masala.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Tip it into a small pan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave covered off the heat for 5 min, then fluff with a fork.

steps.title: Sear the paneer and veg
steps.text: While the rice cooks, heat 1 tbsp oil in the wok over a high heat. Fry the paneer for 3–4 min until golden, then lift out. Add the peppers and onion petals and stir-fry for 3 min until charred at the edges, then lift out.

steps.title: Fry the mushrooms
steps.text: Heat a drop of oil in a small frying pan over a high heat. Fry the mushrooms for 5 min until golden, then season and keep warm.

steps.title: Make the gravy
steps.text: Add the remaining oil and chopped onion to the wok over a medium heat and cook for 5 min until soft. Stir in the garlic, ginger paste and half the kadai masala for 1 min. Add the chopped tomatoes and a splash of water and cook for 5 min until thick.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.text: Return the paneer and veg with the rest of the kadai masala, the garam masala and the kasoori methi (optional), and toss for 2 min. Serve over the rice with the mushrooms spooned on top.

source.title: Kadai Paneer Recipe | Karahi Paneer Restaurant Style

recipes.title: Masala-Crusted Salmon with Bombay Potatoes & Spinach
recipes.airFryer: Air-fry the coated salmon at 190°C for 8–9 min until it flakes; crisp the parboiled potatoes at 200°C for 12 min, shaking halfway.

ingredients.swap: Keep the coriander in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Cut the potatoes into 2cm cubes, slice the garlic and halve the cherry tomatoes. Mix the tikka paste with 1 tbsp yogurt and spread over the top of the salmon.

steps.title: Par-cook the potatoes
