steps.text: Put the potatoes in a microwaveable bowl with a splash of water. Cover and microwave on high for 6–7 min until just tender, then drain well.

steps.title: Crisp the Bombay potatoes
steps.text: Heat 1½ tbsp oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Add the cumin seeds and mustard seeds (optional) and, when they pop, the potatoes, turmeric, chilli powder and a pinch of salt. Fry for 10 min, turning, until golden and crisp at the edges.

steps.title: Cook the salmon
steps.text: Meanwhile, heat the remaining ½ tbsp oil in a second frying pan over a medium heat. Cook the salmon skin-side down for 4 min until crisp, then turn and cook for 3–4 min more. It's ready when the crust is charred and the salmon flakes easily.

steps.title: Add the spinach
steps.text: Push the potatoes to one side, add the garlic and tomatoes and cook for 2 min until softening. Stir in the spinach until just wilted, then season with salt and a squeeze of lemon.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Loosen the rest of the yogurt with a little lemon juice and a pinch of salt. Serve the salmon on the potatoes and spinach with the yogurt, the rest of the lemon in wedges and coriander (optional).

recipes.title: Sweet Potato, Chickpea & Spinach Coconut Curry

ingredients.swap: Keep the coriander in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Peel the sweet potato and cut into 2cm chunks. Chop the onion, grate the garlic and drain the chickpeas.

steps.title: Fry the base
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Sizzle the cumin seeds for 30 sec, then add the onion and cook for 6 min until soft. Stir in the garlic, ginger paste and curry powder and cook for 1 min until fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer the curry
steps.text: Add the sweet potato, chickpeas, chopped tomatoes, coconut milk, 100ml water and a good pinch of salt. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook for 15 min until the sweet potato is tender when pierced with a knife.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: While the curry simmers, rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Tip it into a small pan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave covered off the heat for 5 min, then fluff with a fork.

steps.title: Finish the curry
steps.text: Stir in the spinach and garam masala and cook for 2 min until wilted and the sauce is thick and creamy. Squeeze in the juice of half the lime and season.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Divide the rice between bowls and spoon over the curry. Serve with the rest of the lime in wedges and coriander (optional).

recipes.title: Sweet & Sour Chicken Dhansak with Lentils & Pilau Rice

ingredients.swap: Keep the coriander in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle and make up 500ml stock with the cube. Rinse the lentils and the rice separately. Chop the onion, grate the garlic and cut the chicken into chunks.

steps.title: Start the curry
steps.text: Heat the oil in a saucepan over a medium heat and fry the onion for 7 min until golden. Add the chicken and cook for 3 min until sealed. Stir in the garlic, ginger paste, curry powder and chilli powder for 1 min.

steps.title: Simmer with lentils
steps.text: Add the lentils, chopped tomatoes and 400ml of the stock. Bring to the boil, then simmer gently, partly covered, for 25 min, stirring often. It's ready when the lentils have melted into a thick sauce and the chicken is tender; add more stock if it gets too thick.

steps.title: Make the pilau
steps.text: With 15 min to go, toast the cumin seeds in a small pan over a medium heat for 30 sec. Add the rice, turmeric (optional), 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 10 min, then rest off the heat.

steps.title: Balance the flavours
steps.text: Stir the mango chutney, garam masala and lemon juice into the dhansak. It should taste hot, sweet and sour all at once, so add more chutney or lemon to taste. Season with salt.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Fluff the pilau with a fork and divide between plates. Spoon the dhansak alongside and scatter with coriander (optional).

recipes.title: One-Pot Prawn & Pea Pilau with Cucumber Raita

ingredients.swap: Cook the peas in a small pan of boiling water for 3 min and stir them into one portion only.
Keep the coriander in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle and make up 350ml stock with the cube. Thinly slice the onion, grate the garlic and grate the cucumber. Rinse the rice until the water runs clear.

steps.title: Make the raita
steps.text: Squeeze the grated cucumber dry. Mix it into the yogurt with a pinch of salt and chill until needed.

steps.title: Fry the onion
steps.text: Heat the oil and butter in a wide lidded pan over a medium heat. Fry the onion for 7–8 min until golden. Add the cumin seeds, garlic and ginger paste and stir for 1 min.

steps.title: Cook the pilau
steps.text: Add the rice, turmeric, cinnamon (optional) and garam masala and stir for 1 min until every grain is glossy. Pour in the stock and bring to the boil. Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 10 min.

steps.title: Add the prawns and peas
steps.text: Scatter the prawns and peas over the rice, cover again and cook for 4–5 min until the prawns are pink and the liquid is absorbed. Leave to steam off the heat for 2 min.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Squeeze over half the lemon and fork through gently. Serve with the raita, the rest of the lemon in wedges and coriander (optional).

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Rice Bowls with Kachumber & Mango Chutney

ingredients.swap: Leave the coriander out of the salad and keep it in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Boil the kettle. Cut the chicken into chunks and mix with the tikka paste, 2 tbsp yogurt and a pinch of salt. Dice the cucumber, quarter the tomatoes, finely chop the red onion and coriander, and shred the lettuce. Rinse the rice.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Tip the rice into a small pan with the turmeric (optional), 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave covered for 5 min.

steps.title: Make the kachumber
steps.text: While the rice cooks, mix the cucumber, tomatoes and red onion in a bowl. Stir in the juice of half the lemon, a pinch of salt and half the coriander (optional). Stir the rest of the yogurt with a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Cook the tikka
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a high heat. Fry the chicken for 7–8 min, turning, until charred at the edges and cooked through with no pink inside.

steps.title: Build the bowls
steps.text: Divide the rice between bowls and add the lettuce, kachumber and hot tikka chicken. Spoon over the yogurt and mango chutney, then finish with the rest of the coriander (optional) and lemon wedges.

photo.alt: Spicy chicken and rice bowl with cucumber and onion

recipes.title: Lamb Kofta Curry with Spinach & Cumin-Buttered Naan

ingredients.t: 1, finely chopped (2 tbsp kept for the koftas)

ingredients.swap: Leave the coriander out of the kofta mix and keep it in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Finely chop the onion and set aside 2 tbsp for the koftas. Grate the garlic and chop the coriander.

steps.title: Make the koftas
steps.text: Put the lamb in a bowl with the 2 tbsp onion, a third of the garlic and ½ tsp salt. Add 1 tsp garam masala, the ground cumin and half the coriander (optional). Knead for 1 min, then roll into 12 walnut-sized balls.

steps.title: Brown the koftas
steps.text: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the koftas for 5–6 min, turning, until browned all over. Lift onto a plate, leaving the fat in the pan.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Lower the heat to medium, add the remaining onion and cook for 7 min until golden. Stir in the rest of the garlic, the ginger paste, ground coriander, turmeric (optional) and chilli powder for 1 min. Add the chopped tomatoes and 100ml water.

steps.title: Simmer the koftas
steps.text: Return the koftas to the pan, cover and simmer gently for 12–15 min until cooked through and the sauce is thick. Stir in the spinach and remaining 1 tsp garam masala until wilted. Take off the heat, swirl through the yogurt (optional) and season.

steps.title: Make the cumin naan
steps.text: While the koftas simmer, melt the butter with the cumin seeds in a small pan until they sizzle. Brush over the naans and warm them in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 1 min each side.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Spoon the kofta curry into bowls and scatter with the rest of the coriander (optional). Serve with the cumin naan.

photo.alt: Bowl of meatball curry in tomato sauce with parsley

recipes.title: Tandoori Cauliflower & Chickpea Traybake with Garlic Yogurt
recipes.airFryer: Air-fry the coated cauliflower, chickpeas and onion at 200°C for 18–20 min, shaking every 5 min, until charred at the edges.

ingredients.swap: Keep the coriander in a little bowl on the table so it only goes on the plates that want it.

steps.title: Prep the ingredients
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Cut the cauliflower into florets, the red onion into wedges and the pepper into chunks. Drain the chickpeas and pat them dry. Grate the garlic.

steps.title: Coat the veg
steps.text: Mix 3 tbsp yogurt with the tikka paste, smoked paprika (optional), 1 tbsp oil and the juice of half the lemon. Put the veg and chickpeas on a large roasting tray, pour over the tandoori yogurt and toss until coated. Drizzle with the remaining 1 tbsp oil and season.

steps.title: Roast the tray
steps.text: Roast for 25 min, turning halfway. It's ready when the cauliflower is tender and blackened at the edges and the chickpeas are crisp.

steps.title: Make the garlic yogurt
steps.text: While it roasts, mix the remaining yogurt with the garlic, a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt. Set aside until serving.

steps.title: Wilt the spinach
steps.text: Warm the pittas in the oven for the last 2 min of roasting. Take out the tray and toss the spinach through so it just wilts in the heat.

steps.title: Plate up
steps.text: Pile the traybake onto plates with the warm pittas. Drizzle with the garlic yogurt and finish with coriander (optional) and the rest of the lemon in wedges.

source.title: Tikka roast cauliflower and chickpea wraps with minted yoghurt

recipes.title: Slow-Simmered Ragù Bolognese with Spaghetti & Parmesan

steps.title: Prep the soffritto
steps.text: Finely dice the onion and carrot as small as you can, so they melt into the sauce. Finely chop the bacon and garlic. Crumble the stock cube into 200ml just-boiled water and stir to dissolve.

steps.title: Soften the base
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large heavy pan or casserole over a medium-low heat. Add the bacon and cook for 3 min until its fat runs. Add the onion, carrot and a pinch of salt and cook gently for 10 min until soft and sweet. Stir in the garlic for the last minute.

steps.title: Brown the mince
steps.text: Turn the heat up to medium-high and add the mince, breaking it up with a wooden spoon. Fry for 6–8 min until no pink is left and it's browning in places – that colour is the flavour. Stir in the tomato purée and cook for 1 min.

steps.title: Simmer the ragù
steps.text: Pour in the milk and bubble for 3 min until almost absorbed – it keeps the meat tender. Add the chopped tomatoes and stock, bring to a bubble, then turn the heat right down. Simmer with the lid ajar for at least 45 min (up to 1½ hr), stirring every 15 min. Add a splash of water if it gets thick; it's ready when glossy with a little oil pooling on top.

steps.title: Cook the spaghetti
steps.text: About 15 min before you want to eat, bring a large pan of salted water to the boil. Cook the pasta according to the pack. Scoop out a mugful of the cooking water, then drain.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.text: Tip the pasta into the ragù with a splash of the cooking water. Toss over the heat for 1 min until every strand is coated. Season with salt and pepper and serve with the parmesan grated over.

photo.alt: Spaghetti bolognese with cherry tomatoes on a white plate

recipes.title: Proper Spaghetti Carbonara with Crispy Pancetta & Pecorino

ingredients.t: a small pinch for the pasta water

steps.title: Prep the egg mix
steps.text: Put a large pan of water on to boil with just a small pinch of salt – the pancetta and cheese are salty. Finely grate the pecorino and parmesan into a bowl. Beat in the whole egg, the 2 yolks and the black pepper to make a thick paste. Bash the garlic clove (optional) with the flat of a knife.

steps.title: Crisp the pancetta
steps.text: Put the pancetta and garlic into a large cold frying pan, then set it over a medium heat. Cook for 6–8 min, stirring, until the fat has melted out and the cubes are golden and crisp. Remove the garlic and take the pan off the heat, keeping all the fat.

steps.title: Cook the spaghetti
steps.text: While the pancetta crisps, cook the spaghetti for 1 min less than the pack says. Just before draining, scoop out a mugful of the starchy cooking water – it makes the sauce.

steps.title: Coat in the fat
steps.text: Tip the drained spaghetti into the pancetta pan with a splash of pasta water. Toss over a low heat for 30 seconds until coated in the fat. Take the pan off the heat and leave it for 30 seconds so the eggs won't scramble.

steps.title: Make it silky
steps.text: Loosen the egg mix with 2 tbsp of the hot pasta water, pour it over the spaghetti and toss constantly with tongs for 1–2 min. Add more pasta water a splash at a time until glossy and clinging to every strand. Serve straight away with extra black pepper.

photo.alt: Spaghetti carbonara with bacon on a white plate

recipes.title: Cacio e Pepe Spaghetti with Toasted Pepper & Lemony Rocket

ingredients.swap: Serve the rocket salad in a separate bowl and add it to one plate only.

steps.title: Prep the cheese
steps.text: Bring about 2 litres of water to the boil in a large pan with a small pinch of salt – less water makes it starchier. Grate the pecorino and parmesan as finely as you can into a bowl. Coarsely crack the black pepper.

steps.title: Cook the spaghetti
steps.text: Cook the spaghetti for 2 min less than the pack says – it finishes cooking in the frying pan. Don't drain it.

steps.title: Toast the pepper
steps.text: While the spaghetti cooks, toast the pepper in a large dry frying pan over a medium heat for 1 min until fragrant. Add the butter and a ladle of the pasta water and let it bubble.

steps.title: Make the cheese paste
steps.text: Stir 3–4 tbsp of hot (not boiling) pasta water into the grated cheese. Mix to a smooth, thick paste. Making it off the heat is what stops the sauce going stringy.

steps.title: Toss in the pan
steps.text: Lift the spaghetti into the pepper pan with tongs and toss over a medium heat for 1–2 min. Take the pan off the heat and add the cheese paste. Toss hard for 1 min, adding splashes of pasta water until creamy and coating the pasta.

steps.title: Dress rocket and serve
steps.text: Toss the rocket with a squeeze of lemon, the oil and a pinch of salt. Twirl the pasta into warm bowls, crack over a little more pepper and serve the rocket on the side.

recipes.title: Genovese-Style Pesto Pasta with Potatoes & Broccoli

ingredients.t: 1 medium, peeled and cut into 1cm cubes

ingredients.swap: Scatter the basil over one plate only.

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Boil a full kettle. Peel the potato and cut it into 1cm cubes. Cut the broccoli into small florets and thinly slice the stalk. Grate the parmesan and zest the lemon.

steps.title: Cook potato and pasta
steps.text: Pour the boiled water into a large pan, salt it well and bring back to the boil over a high heat. Add the potato and pasta together and cook for the pasta's pack time.

steps.title: Add the broccoli
steps.text: 4 min before the end of the cooking time, drop the broccoli into the same pan. Everything should be ready together: pasta just tender, broccoli soft and potato starting to break up.

steps.title: Toss with the pesto
steps.text: Scoop out a mugful of the cooking water, then drain. Return everything to the pan off the heat with the pesto, lemon zest, half the parmesan and a good splash of the water. Toss hard for 1 min – the potato starch makes the pesto creamy. Add more water if it looks dry.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Season with black pepper and divide between bowls. Finish with the rest of the parmesan, the torn basil (optional) and a drizzle of oil (optional).

source.title: Trofie with Potatoes, Green Beans and Pesto (from The Food of Italy)
source.author: Claudia Roden

photo.alt: Basil pesto pasta with broccoli and parmesan

recipes.title: Spaghetti Puttanesca with Tuna, Olives, Capers & Chilli

ingredients.swap: Leave the olives out of the sauce and scatter them over one plate only when you serve.
Leave the capers out of the sauce and scatter them over one plate only when you serve.
Leave the chilli out of the pan and sprinkle it over one plate only at the end.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Put a large pan of salted water on to boil. Thinly slice the garlic, halve the olives and roughly chop the anchovies. Drain the capers and the tuna.

steps.title: Melt the anchovies
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-low heat. Add the garlic, anchovies and chilli (optional) and cook for 2 min. Mash the anchovies with a wooden spoon until they melt into the oil and the garlic is just turning golden.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.text: Stir in the tomato purée for 30 seconds, then add the chopped tomatoes, olives and capers. Bubble over a medium heat for 10 min, stirring now and then, until thick and jammy.

steps.title: Cook the spaghetti
steps.text: While the sauce simmers, cook the spaghetti according to the pack. Scoop out a mugful of the cooking water before draining.

steps.title: Add tuna and toss
steps.text: Flake the tuna into the sauce in big chunks and warm through for 1 min. Toss in the drained spaghetti with a splash of pasta water until glossy. Taste before adding salt – the anchovies, olives and capers are already salty.

recipes.title: Fiery Penne all'Arrabbiata with Torn Mozzarella & Basil

ingredients.swap: Cook the sauce with just a pinch of chilli, spoon out one portion, then stir the rest of the chilli into the pan for the hotter plate.
Leave the basil out of the sauce and scatter it over one plate only.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Put a large pan of salted water on to boil. Thinly slice the garlic and grate the parmesan. Tear the mozzarella into bite-sized pieces and pat dry on kitchen paper. Pick the basil leaves.

steps.title: Fry garlic and chilli
steps.text: Heat 1½ tbsp of the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-low heat. Add the garlic and chilli and cook gently for 2 min until the garlic is pale golden. Don't let it brown or it turns bitter.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.text: Stir in the tomato purée for 30 seconds, then add the chopped tomatoes, a splash of water and a pinch of salt. Simmer briskly over a medium heat for 12–15 min until thick and the oil shines on top. Tear in half the basil.

steps.title: Cook the penne
steps.text: While the sauce simmers, cook the penne for 1 min less than the pack says. Scoop out a mugful of the cooking water, then drain.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.text: Toss the penne into the sauce with a splash of pasta water and cook for 1 min until every tube is coated. Divide between bowls and top with the mozzarella, remaining basil, parmesan and the last ½ tbsp oil. The heat of the pasta softens the cheese.

photo.alt: Penne arrabbiata in tomato sauce with fresh basil

recipes.title: Sausage & Fennel Ragù with Rigatoni, Chilli & Parmesan

ingredients.swap: Leave the chilli out of the pan and sprinkle it over one plate only at the end.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Finely chop the onion and garlic and squeeze the sausagemeat out of the skins into a bowl. Crush the fennel seeds with a pestle and mortar or the flat of a knife. Dissolve the half stock cube in 100ml just-boiled water. Grate the parmesan.

steps.title: Brown the sausagemeat
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large deep frying pan over a medium-high heat. Add the sausagemeat and fennel seeds and fry for 8 min, breaking it into small nuggets, until golden and crisp in places. Lift out with a slotted spoon, leaving the fat behind.

steps.title: Soften the onion
steps.text: Turn the heat down to medium-low and cook the onion in the sausage fat for 6–8 min until soft and golden. Add the garlic and chilli (optional) for 1 min, then the tomato purée for 1 min more.

steps.title: Simmer the ragù
steps.text: Return the sausage to the pan with the chopped tomatoes and stock. Simmer uncovered for 15 min, stirring now and then, until thick and rich.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: While the ragù simmers, cook the pasta in a large pan of salted boiling water according to the pack. Scoop out a mugful of the cooking water, then drain.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Stir the cream into the ragù – it will turn a rosy orange. Toss in the pasta with half the parmesan and a splash of pasta water until glossy. Serve with the rest of the parmesan on top.

source.title: Rick Stein's Fennel and Sausage Ragù with Tagliatelle
source.author: Rick Stein

photo.alt: Rigatoni with meat ragu and cheese

recipes.title: One-Pan Lemon & Garlic Chicken Orzo with Spinach & Parmesan

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Dissolve the stock cube in 500ml just-boiled water. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with salt, pepper and the dried herbs (optional). Finely chop the onion and garlic. Zest the lemon and cut it in half.

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large deep frying pan with a lid over a medium-high heat. Fry the chicken in a single layer for 5–6 min, turning once, until golden. It doesn't need to be cooked through yet, so transfer it to a plate.

steps.title: Toast the orzo
steps.text: Turn the heat to medium and add the butter and onion. Cook for 3 min until soft, then add the garlic for 1 min. Tip in the orzo and stir for 1–2 min until lightly toasted and smelling nutty.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Pour in the stock with the lemon zest, scraping up any browned bits. Return the chicken and its juices, bring to a simmer, cover and cook for 10–12 min. Stir every few minutes until the orzo is tender and the chicken is cooked through with no pink.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Take off the heat and stir in the spinach until wilted, then the parmesan and lemon juice to taste. It should be loose and creamy like a risotto – add a splash of hot water if it's too thick. Serve with plenty of black pepper.

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciatore with Peppers, Mushrooms & Olives

ingredients.swap: Fry the mushrooms in a separate small pan with a little oil until golden, leave them out of the stew and add them to one plate only.
Leave the olives out of the sauce and scatter them over one plate only when you serve.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Pat the chicken dry, season with salt and pepper and dust all over with the flour. Slice the onion, pepper and garlic and quarter the mushrooms. Dissolve the half stock cube in 150ml just-boiled water.

steps.title: Brown the chicken
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large deep pan or casserole with a lid over a medium-high heat. Fry the chicken for 3 min each side until deep golden. Lift onto a plate – it finishes cooking in the sauce.

steps.title: Fry the veg
steps.text: Add the remaining 1 tbsp oil, the onion and pepper and cook for 5 min until softening. Add the mushrooms and fry for 3 min until golden. Stir in the garlic and herbs for 1 min.

steps.title: Simmer the cacciatore
steps.text: Stir in the tomato purée, then the chopped tomatoes and stock, scraping up the browned bits. Nestle the chicken and its juices back in, cover and simmer over a low heat for 25 min. About 15 min in, heat the oven to 180°C fan for the bread.

steps.title: Add the olives
steps.text: Take the lid off, stir in the olives and simmer for 10 min more. It's ready when the chicken is tender and cooked through and the sauce clings to it. Season to taste.

steps.title: Bake bread and serve
steps.text: While the olives simmer, bake the baguette for 8–10 min (check the pack) until crisp and golden. Spoon the cacciatore into shallow bowls and tear the bread for mopping up the sauce.

recipes.title: Creamy Tuscan Chicken with Garlicky Crushed Potatoes

ingredients.t: 6 pieces, sliced, plus 1 tbsp of their oil
ingredients.swap: Leave the sun-dried tomatoes out of the sauce; warm them in a small pan with a little of their oil and spoon over one plate only.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Boil a full kettle. Cut the potatoes into 3cm chunks, skins on. Halve each chicken breast horizontally into 2 thin fillets and season with salt, pepper, the herbs (optional) and paprika (optional). Slice 3 garlic cloves and the sun-dried tomatoes, crush the last clove, and dissolve the half stock cube in 100ml just-boiled water.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.text: Tip the potatoes into a pan, cover with boiling water from the kettle and add a pinch of salt. Cook over a medium-high heat for 15–18 min until a knife slides in easily.

steps.title: Fry the chicken
steps.text: While the potatoes cook, heat the oil and 1 tbsp oil from the sun-dried tomato jar in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the chicken for 3–4 min each side until golden and cooked through with no pink. Rest on a plate.

steps.title: Make the Tuscan sauce
steps.text: Turn the heat to medium and fry the sliced garlic and sun-dried tomatoes for 1 min. Pour in the stock and scrape up the browned bits. Add the cream and simmer for 3 min until it coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Add spinach and chicken
steps.text: Stir in the parmesan and spinach until the spinach wilts. Return the chicken and its juices and spoon the sauce over for 2 min to warm through.

steps.title: Crush potatoes and serve
steps.text: Drain the potatoes and return them to the pan with the butter, the crushed garlic and a pinch of salt. Roughly crush with a fork. Plate up with the chicken and plenty of the creamy sauce.

source.title: Chicken with Creamy Sun Dried Tomato Sauce
source.author: Nagi Maehashi

photo.alt: Chicken with sun-dried tomatoes and vegetables

recipes.title: Sausage, Pesto & Cherry Tomato Gnocchi Traybake
recipes.airFryer: Air-fry the gnocchi, sausage pieces, onion and pepper at 200°C for 12 min, shaking halfway, then add the tomatoes for 6 min more until the sausages are cooked through. Toss with the pesto, top with the mozzarella and air-fry for 3 min until melted. Cook in two batches if your basket is small.

ingredients.swap: Scatter the basil over one portion only.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C fan. Cut each sausage into 3 chunky pieces, the red onion into wedges and the pepper into bite-sized chunks. Tear the mozzarella into pieces.

steps.title: Roast gnocchi and sausages
steps.text: Tip the gnocchi straight from the pack into a large roasting tray, breaking up any that are stuck. Add the sausages, onion and pepper and toss with the oil, salt and pepper. Spread out in a single layer and roast for 15 min.

steps.title: Add the tomatoes
steps.text: Give everything a good toss, add the cherry tomatoes and roast for 10 min more. The gnocchi should be golden at the edges, the tomatoes starting to burst and the sausages cooked through.

steps.title: Add pesto and mozzarella
steps.text: Take the tray out, dollop over the pesto and toss so everything is coated. Scatter the mozzarella over the top and return to the oven for 5–7 min until melted and bubbling.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Scatter with the basil leaves (optional) and a crack of black pepper. Serve straight from the tray.

photo.alt: Baked gnocchi with tomato, mozzarella and basil in a casserole dish

recipes.title: Creamy Mushroom Risotto with Spinach & Parmesan

ingredients.swap: Keep all the fried mushrooms on their plate and spoon them onto one bowl only instead of stirring them through.

ingredients.t: ½ tsp (thyme if you have it)

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Dissolve the stock cubes in 900ml boiling water and keep it hot in a pan on the lowest heat. Finely chop the onion and garlic, slice the mushrooms and grate the parmesan.

steps.title: Fry the mushrooms
steps.text: Heat half the oil and half the butter in a large frying pan over a high heat. Add the mushrooms in a single layer and leave for 2–3 min until golden underneath. Stir, add half the garlic and the herbs (optional) and cook for 3 min more. Season with salt and pepper and tip onto a plate.

steps.title: Start the risotto
steps.text: Heat the remaining oil in a wide, deep pan over a medium-low heat. Cook the onion for 5 min until soft but not coloured, then add the rest of the garlic for 1 min. Stir in the rice for 2 min until the edges of the grains turn see-through.

steps.title: Add the stock
steps.text: Add a ladle of hot stock and stir until almost absorbed, then keep adding a ladle at a time, stirring often. After 18–20 min the rice should be tender with a slight bite. It should flow slowly when you tilt the pan – you may not need all the stock.

steps.title: Finish the risotto
steps.text: Take off the heat and beat in the remaining butter, the parmesan, the spinach and a squeeze of lemon (optional). Cover and rest for 2 min.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Stir half the mushrooms through the risotto and spoon into warm bowls. Pile the rest of the mushrooms on top and finish with black pepper.

photo.alt: Bowl of creamy mushroom risotto on a wooden table

recipes.title: Pea, Crispy Bacon & Lemon Risotto with Parmesan

ingredients.swap: Cook the peas in a small pan of boiling water for 3 min and stir them into one portion only.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Dissolve the stock cubes in 900ml boiling water and keep hot in a pan on the lowest heat. Finely chop the onion and garlic, chop the bacon and zest the lemon. Grate the parmesan.

steps.title: Crisp the bacon
steps.text: Heat the oil in a wide, deep pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the bacon for 5 min until golden and crisp. Lift half onto kitchen paper for the topping, leaving the rest in the pan.

steps.title: Start the risotto
steps.text: Turn the heat down to medium-low, add the onion to the bacon fat and cook for 5 min until soft. Stir in the garlic for 1 min, then the rice for 2 min until the edges of the grains turn see-through.

steps.title: Add stock and peas
steps.text: Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring often and letting each one be almost absorbed before adding the next. After about 15 min, stir in the peas with the next ladle. Cook for 3–5 min more until the rice is tender with a slight bite.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Take off the heat and beat in the butter, parmesan, lemon zest and a squeeze of lemon juice. Cover and rest for 2 min. Spoon into bowls and top with the reserved crispy bacon and black pepper.

recipes.title: Hearty Minestrone with Cannellini Beans & Pasta

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Dissolve the stock cubes in 1 litre of boiling water. Dice the onion, carrot and courgette into roughly 1cm pieces and chop the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans and grate the parmesan.

steps.title: Sweat the veg
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Cook the onion and carrot with a pinch of salt for 8 min until softened. Add the courgette, garlic and herbs (optional) for 2 min.

steps.title: Simmer the soup
steps.text: Stir in the tomato purée for 1 min, then add the chopped tomatoes, stock and beans. Bring to the boil, then simmer partly covered for 15 min until the carrots are tender. Heat the oven for the baguette now, following the pack.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Stir in the pasta, snapping spaghetti into short lengths, and simmer for 10 min until tender. Stir often so it doesn't stick, and add a splash of water if the soup gets too thick. Stir in the spinach for the final minute.

steps.title: Bake the bread
steps.text: While the pasta cooks, bake the baguette for 8–10 min (check the pack) until crisp and golden. Slice it just before serving.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Season the soup with salt and pepper and ladle into deep bowls. Swirl a spoonful of pesto into each (optional), scatter over the parmesan and serve with the warm bread.

recipes.title: Beef Lasagne with Silky Béchamel & a Golden Cheese Crust

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Finely dice the onion and carrot and finely chop the garlic. Grate the parmesan and tear the mozzarella. Dissolve the half stock cube in 150ml just-boiled water.

steps.title: Soften the veg
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large pan over a medium heat. Cook the onion and carrot for 8 min until soft, adding the garlic for the last minute.

steps.title: Brown the mince
steps.text: Turn the heat up to medium-high, add the mince and fry for 6–8 min, breaking it up, until browned all over. Stir in the tomato purée for 1 min.

steps.title: Simmer the ragù
steps.text: Add the chopped tomatoes, stock and herbs (optional) and bring to a bubble. Simmer over a low heat with the lid ajar for 30 min until thick. A spoon dragged through should leave a clear trail.

steps.title: Make the béchamel
steps.text: While the ragù simmers, melt the butter in a saucepan over a medium heat and stir in the flour for 1 min. Whisk in the milk a splash at a time until smooth, then simmer for 5 min, stirring, until it coats a spoon. Off the heat, stir in half the parmesan and season with salt and pepper. Heat the oven to 170°C fan.

steps.title: Layer up
steps.text: Spread a thin layer of béchamel in a small ovenproof dish (about 20 x 15cm), then add lasagne sheets, snapping them to fit. Spoon over a third of the ragù and a little béchamel, and repeat to make 3 layers. Finish with sheets covered in the remaining béchamel, then the mozzarella and the rest of the parmesan.

steps.title: Bake and rest
steps.text: Bake for 35–40 min until deep golden, bubbling at the edges and a knife slides easily through the pasta. Rest for 10 min before cutting so the layers hold together.

photo.alt: Classic beef lasagne with meat sauce and fresh basil on a white plate

recipes.title: Melting Aubergine Parmigiana with Garlic Bread
recipes.airFryer: Brush the aubergine slices lightly with oil and air-fry at 200°C for 10–12 min in batches, turning halfway, until soft and golden – it uses far less oil.

ingredients.swap: Leave the basil out of the sauce and layers, then scatter it over one half of the dish only.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C fan and line 2 baking trays. Slice the aubergines lengthways about 8mm thick, brush both sides with 3 tbsp of the oil and season with salt. Slice 2 garlic cloves and crush the third into the softened butter. Tear the mozzarella and grate the parmesan.

steps.title: Roast the aubergine
steps.text: Lay the slices on the trays in a single layer. Roast for 30–35 min, turning halfway, until soft, collapsing and golden brown. Turn the oven down to 180°C fan.

steps.title: Make the tomato sauce
steps.text: While the aubergine roasts, warm the remaining 1 tbsp oil in a saucepan over a medium-low heat. Cook the sliced garlic for 1 min until fragrant. Add the passata, a pinch of salt and half the basil, torn, and simmer for 15 min until thick.

steps.title: Layer the parmigiana
steps.text: Spoon a thin layer of sauce into a small ovenproof dish, then add a layer of aubergine, some mozzarella, parmesan and a few basil leaves. Repeat until everything is used, finishing with sauce, mozzarella and parmesan. Keep a few basil leaves back to serve.

steps.title: Bake the parmigiana
steps.text: Bake for 25 min until bubbling and golden on top. Meanwhile, split the baguette and spread the cut sides with the garlic butter.

steps.title: Garlic bread and serve
steps.text: For the last 10 min, bake the garlic bread on the shelf below until crisp. Rest the parmigiana for 5 min, scatter with the remaining basil and serve with the bread.

photo.alt: Italian aubergine parmigiana in a dish on a wooden table

recipes.title: Crispy Chicken Parmigiana with Spaghetti al Pomodoro
recipes.airFryer: Spray the crumbed chicken with oil and air-fry at 200°C for 10 min, turning halfway, then top with the sauce and mozzarella and air-fry for 3–4 min more until melted.

ingredients.swap: Leave the basil out of the sauce and scatter it over one plate only.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C fan. Put the chicken breasts between two sheets of baking paper and bash with a rolling pin to an even 1cm. Set out three plates: flour seasoned with salt and pepper, beaten egg, and the panko mixed with half the parmesan. Slice the garlic and tear the mozzarella.

steps.title: Make the tomato sauce
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a saucepan over a medium-low heat and cook the garlic for 1 min. Add the passata, a pinch of salt and a few torn basil leaves (optional). Simmer for 10 min until thickened, then keep warm on the lowest heat.

steps.title: Crumb the chicken
steps.text: While the sauce simmers, dust each breast in flour, dip in the egg, then press firmly into the panko on both sides. Put a large pan of salted water on to boil for the pasta.

steps.title: Fry the chicken
steps.text: Heat the remaining 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the chicken for 3 min each side until deep golden, then transfer to a baking tray.

steps.title: Top and bake
steps.text: Spoon 2 tbsp of sauce over each piece, keeping the crispy edges clear. Top with the mozzarella and the rest of the parmesan. Bake for 10–12 min until bubbling and the chicken is cooked through with no pink when cut.

steps.title: Cook the spaghetti
steps.text: While the chicken bakes, cook the spaghetti according to the pack. Drain, saving a splash of the cooking water.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.text: Toss the spaghetti with the remaining sauce and the splash of water until glossy. Plate up with the chicken parmigiana and scatter over the rest of the basil (optional).

recipes.title: Beef & Parmesan Meatballs in Tomato Sauce with Spaghetti

ingredients.swap: Tear the basil over one plate only instead of into the sauce.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Finely chop the onion and 2 garlic cloves, and finely grate the third clove. Grate the parmesan. Soak the panko in the milk in a large bowl for 2 min.

steps.title: Shape the meatballs
steps.text: Add the mince, egg yolk, 20g parmesan, grated garlic, herbs (optional) and a good pinch of salt and pepper to the panko. Mix gently with your hands – overworking makes them tough. Roll into 12 walnut-sized balls.

steps.title: Brown the meatballs
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large deep frying pan with a lid over a medium-high heat. Fry the meatballs for 5–6 min, turning, until browned all over. Lift onto a plate – they finish cooking in the sauce.

steps.title: Simmer in the sauce
steps.text: Turn the heat to medium-low and cook the onion in the same pan for 5 min until soft. Add the chopped garlic and tomato purée for 1 min, then the chopped tomatoes and a splash of water, scraping up the browned bits. Return the meatballs, cover and simmer for 12–15 min, turning once. They're ready when cooked through and the sauce has thickened.

steps.title: Cook the spaghetti
steps.text: While the meatballs simmer, cook the spaghetti in a large pan of salted boiling water according to the pack. Drain, saving a splash of the cooking water.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Toss the spaghetti with a few spoonfuls of sauce and the splash of pasta water. Top with the meatballs and remaining sauce, the rest of the parmesan and the torn basil (optional).

photo.alt: Spaghetti with meatballs in a white bowl

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken, Bacon & Mushroom Pasta Bake

ingredients.swap: Fry the mushrooms in a separate small pan with a little oil and make the sauce without them, then scatter them over one half of the dish only before the cheese goes on.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C fan and put a large pan of salted water on to boil. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces, chop the bacon and slice the mushrooms and garlic. Grate the parmesan and cheddar and crumble the half stock cube.

steps.title: Part-cook the pasta
steps.text: Cook the penne for 3 min less than the pack says – it finishes cooking in the oven. Scoop out a mugful of the water, then drain.

steps.title: Fry chicken and bacon
steps.text: While the pasta cooks, heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the chicken and bacon for 6–7 min until golden and the chicken is cooked through.

steps.title: Add the mushrooms
steps.text: Add the mushrooms and cook for 4 min until golden and any liquid has evaporated. Stir in the garlic for 1 min.

steps.title: Make it creamy
steps.text: Turn the heat to medium-low and stir in the cream, milk, crumbled stock cube and mustard (optional). Simmer for 2 min until slightly thickened, then stir in the spinach to wilt. Stir in half the parmesan, the pasta and a splash of pasta water – it should look saucier than you'd think. Season with black pepper.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Tip into an ovenproof dish and scatter over the cheddar and remaining parmesan. Bake for 15 min until bubbling and golden brown on top. Rest for 5 min before serving.

source.title: Creamy Pasta Bake "formula" – make with anything!
source.author: Nagi Maehashi

recipes.title: Garlic, Chilli & Lemon Prawn Linguine with Rocket

ingredients.swap: Leave the chilli out of the pan and sprinkle it over one plate only at the end.
Don't toss the rocket through the pasta; pile it onto one plate only.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: If the prawns are frozen, defrost them in a bowl of cold water for 15 min, then pat dry. Put a large pan of salted water on to boil. Thinly slice the garlic and halve the tomatoes. Zest the lemon and cut it in half.

steps.title: Cook the linguine
steps.text: Cook the pasta according to the pack. Scoop out a mugful of the cooking water before draining.

steps.title: Start the sauce
steps.text: About 5 min before the pasta is ready, heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Add the garlic and chilli (optional) for 1 min until pale golden. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 min until they start to burst.

steps.title: Cook the prawns
steps.text: Add the prawns and cook for 2–3 min, turning, until pink all over and opaque – overcooking makes them rubbery. Stir in the butter, lemon zest and the juice of one lemon half.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.text: Lift the linguine into the pan with tongs, add a splash of pasta water and toss over the heat for 1 min until silky. Take off the heat, toss through the rocket and season with salt and pepper. Serve with the other lemon half cut into wedges.

photo.alt: Prawn pasta with tomatoes in a pan

recipes.title: Creamy Lemon & Garlic Salmon Penne with Spinach & Peas

ingredients.swap: Cook the peas in a small pan of boiling water for 3 min and stir them into one portion only.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Put a large pan of salted water on to boil. Season the salmon with salt and pepper. Finely chop the garlic and grate the parmesan. Zest the lemon and cut it in half.

steps.title: Cook the salmon
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat. Cook the salmon skin-side down for 4 min until the skin is crisp, then flip and cook for 2–3 min more until it flakes easily. Lift out, remove the skin and break into big flakes.

steps.title: Cook pasta and peas
steps.text: While the salmon cooks, cook the penne according to the pack, adding the peas for the last 2 min. Save a mugful of the cooking water, then drain.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Wipe out most of the fat from the salmon pan and set it over a medium-low heat. Add the garlic for 1 min, then the cream and lemon zest and bubble for 2 min until slightly thickened. Stir in the spinach until wilted.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.text: Add the pasta and peas, the parmesan, a squeeze of lemon juice and a splash of pasta water and toss until glossy. Gently fold through the salmon so it stays in chunks. Season with black pepper and serve.

photo.alt: Salmon and spinach pasta on a white plate

recipes.title: Potato, Spinach & Feta Frittata with Tomato & Rocket Salad

ingredients.swap: Crumble the feta over one half of the frittata only before it goes under the grill.
Dress the tomatoes on their own and add the rocket to one plate only.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Slice the potatoes about 3mm thick, leaving the skins on. Slice the spring onions and halve the tomatoes. Beat the eggs in a jug with the parmesan and a good pinch of salt and pepper.

steps.title: Cook the potatoes
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil and the butter in a 20–24cm ovenproof non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Add the potatoes, cover and cook for 10–12 min, turning now and then, until tender and golden at the edges.

steps.title: Wilt the spinach
steps.text: Add the spring onions for 1 min, then the spinach a handful at a time until wilted. Spread everything out evenly across the pan.

steps.title: Set the frittata
steps.text: Heat the grill to high. Pour the eggs into the pan, tilting it to fill any gaps, then crumble over the feta. Cook over a low heat for 6–8 min without stirring until the edges are set but the top is still wobbly.

steps.title: Finish under the grill
steps.text: Slide the pan under the grill for 3–4 min until puffed, golden and just set in the middle. The handle will be very hot, so use an oven glove.

steps.title: Make salad and serve
steps.text: While it grills, toss the tomatoes and rocket with a squeeze of lemon, the remaining ½ tbsp oil and a pinch of salt. Rest the frittata for 2 min, then cut into wedges and serve with the salad.

photo.alt: Homemade frittata in a cast iron pan

recipes.title: Spinach & Ricotta Cannelloni with Golden Mozzarella

ingredients.swap: Leave the basil out of the sauce and scatter it over one half of the dish only.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C fan and boil a full kettle. Put the spinach in a colander in the sink. Crush 1 garlic clove and slice the other 2, zest the lemon, grate the parmesan and tear the mozzarella.

steps.title: Make the filling
steps.text: Pour boiling water over the spinach to wilt it, then cool under the cold tap and squeeze out as much water as you can. Chop it and mix in a bowl with the ricotta, half the parmesan, the lemon zest (optional), crushed garlic, salt and pepper. Re-boil the kettle.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Heat the oil in a saucepan over a medium-low heat and cook the sliced garlic for 1 min. Add the passata, a pinch of salt and half the basil, torn, and simmer for 10 min.

steps.title: Soften the sheets
steps.text: While the sauce simmers, lay the lasagne sheets in a roasting tin and cover with just-boiled water. Leave for 5 min until bendy, then lift out onto a clean tea towel.

steps.title: Roll the cannelloni
steps.text: Spread half the sauce over the base of a small ovenproof dish. Spoon a line of filling along the short edge of each sheet. Roll it into a tube and lay it seam-side down, packing them in snugly. Spoon over the remaining sauce so all the pasta is covered – exposed edges go hard.

steps.title: Bake and serve
steps.text: Top with the mozzarella and the rest of the parmesan, then cover with foil and bake for 15 min. Uncover and bake for 15–20 min more until bubbling and golden and the pasta is tender when poked with a knife. Rest for 5 min and scatter with the remaining basil.

source.title: Spinach and Ricotta Rotolo (Italian Lasagna Roll Ups)
source.author: Nagi Maehashi

recipes.title: Crispy Chicken Milanese with Lemon-Parmesan Spaghetti
recipes.airFryer: Spray the crumbed chicken with oil on both sides and air-fry at 200°C for 8–10 min, turning halfway, until golden and cooked through.

ingredients.t: 3 tbsp for frying, plus a drizzle for the salad

ingredients.swap: Keep the rocket out of the tomato salad and add it to one plate only.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Put a large pan of salted water on to boil. Put the chicken between two sheets of baking paper and bash with a rolling pin to about 5mm thick. Set out three plates: flour seasoned with salt and pepper, beaten egg, and the panko mixed with 10g parmesan and the herbs (optional). Zest the lemon, cut it in half and halve the tomatoes.

steps.title: Crumb the chicken
steps.text: Dust each piece of chicken in flour, dip it in the egg, then press firmly into the crumbs so both sides are well coated. Lay on a clean plate.

steps.title: Cook the spaghetti
steps.text: Cook the spaghetti according to the pack. Scoop out a mugful of the cooking water before draining.

steps.title: Fry the chicken
steps.text: While the spaghetti cooks, heat 3 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat until a crumb sizzles straight away. Fry the chicken for 3 min each side until deep golden and cooked through with no pink. Drain on kitchen paper and sprinkle with salt.

steps.title: Make the lemon spaghetti
steps.text: Return the drained spaghetti to its pan off the heat. Add the butter, lemon zest, the juice of one lemon half, the remaining parmesan and a splash of pasta water. Toss until creamy and glossy.

steps.title: Dress salad and serve
steps.text: Toss the rocket and tomatoes with a squeeze from the other lemon half and a drizzle of oil. Plate the chicken with the spaghetti and the salad alongside. Cut what's left of the lemon into wedges to serve.

source.title: Chicken Milanese and Garlic Butter with Spinach and Peas (from John and Lisa's Kitchen)
source.author: John Torode and Lisa Faulkner

recipes.title: Tuscan Sausage & Bean Stew with Garlic Toasts

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C fan (or as the baguette pack says). Cut the sausages into chunks, chop the onion, slice 2 garlic cloves and halve the third. Drain the beans and dissolve the half stock cube in 150ml just-boiled water. Grate the parmesan.

steps.title: Brown the sausages
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large deep frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the sausages for 6–8 min, turning, until golden all over.

steps.title: Soften the onion
steps.text: Push the sausages to one side, add the onion and cook for 5 min until soft. Stir in the sliced garlic and herbs for 1 min.

steps.title: Simmer the stew
steps.text: Add the tomatoes, beans and stock and bring to a bubble. Simmer over a medium-low heat for 12–15 min until the sausages are cooked through and the sauce is thick. Crush a few beans against the side of the pan to thicken it.

steps.title: Make the garlic toasts
steps.text: While the stew simmers, bake the baguette for about 8 min until crisp. Slice it, drizzle with the remaining ½ tbsp oil and rub the cut sides with the halved garlic clove.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Stir the spinach into the stew for 1–2 min until wilted and season with salt and pepper. Ladle into bowls, scatter over the parmesan and serve with the garlic toasts for dunking.

recipes.title: Pasta alla Norma with Golden Aubergine, Basil & Pecorino
recipes.airFryer: Toss the aubergine cubes in 1 tbsp oil and air-fry at 200°C for 12–15 min, shaking twice, until golden and soft.

ingredients.swap: Leave the chilli out of the pan and sprinkle it over one plate only at the end.
Leave the basil out of the sauce and scatter it all over one plate only.

ingredients.t: for the aubergine and pasta water

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Put a large pan of salted water on to boil. Cut the aubergine into 2cm cubes and toss with a pinch of salt. Slice the garlic and grate the pecorino.

steps.title: Fry the aubergine
steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp of the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the aubergine in a single layer for 10–12 min, turning now and then, until deep golden and soft all the way through. Tip onto kitchen paper.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Turn the heat down to medium-low and add the remaining 1 tbsp oil, the garlic and chilli (optional) for 1 min. Stir in the tomato purée for 30 seconds, then the chopped tomatoes. Simmer for 10 min until thick.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: While the sauce simmers, cook the pasta according to the pack. Scoop out a mugful of the cooking water, then drain.

steps.title: Bring it together
steps.text: Return two-thirds of the aubergine to the sauce with half the basil, torn. Add the drained pasta and a splash of cooking water and toss until coated.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Divide between bowls. Top with the remaining aubergine, the pecorino and the rest of the basil leaves.

recipes.title: Crispy Gnocchi with Creamy Garlic Mushrooms & Spinach

ingredients.swap: Fry the mushrooms in a small separate pan with a little butter and garlic. Make the creamy sauce without them and spoon them onto one plate only.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Slice the mushrooms and garlic and grate the parmesan. Separate the gnocchi so none are stuck together – there's no need to boil them.

steps.title: Crisp the gnocchi
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the gnocchi in a single layer for 6–8 min, turning now and then, until golden and crisp. Tip into a bowl.

steps.title: Fry the mushrooms
steps.text: Add the butter and mushrooms to the same pan and cook over a high heat for 5 min until golden and dry. Add the garlic and herbs (optional) for 1 min.

steps.title: Make it creamy
steps.text: Turn the heat down to medium and pour in the cream with 3 tbsp water. Bubble for 1–2 min until it coats the back of a spoon. Stir in the spinach until wilted, then half the parmesan and a squeeze of lemon (optional).

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.text: Return the gnocchi to the pan and toss for 1 min to coat – they'll stay crisp at the edges. Season with salt, then serve topped with the rest of the parmesan and plenty of black pepper.

recipes.title: Roast Salmon with Basil Salsa Verde & Crushed Potatoes
recipes.airFryer: Air-fry the oiled, seasoned salmon at 190°C for 9–11 min until it flakes easily, with the tomatoes alongside for the last 5 min.

ingredients.swap: Keep the salsa verde out of the potatoes and spoon it over one plate only; dress the other with lemon juice and oil.
Leave the capers out of the salsa verde, then chop them and stir into one portion only.

ingredients.t: 1 (zest all, juice half, wedges from the rest)

ingredients.swap: Serve the rocket on the side and add it to one plate only.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C fan, line a baking tray and boil a full kettle. Cut the potatoes into bite-sized chunks. Zest the lemon, squeeze the juice from one half and cut the other half into wedges.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.text: Put the potatoes in a pan, cover with boiling water from the kettle and add a pinch of salt. Simmer over a medium-high heat for 15 min until tender.

steps.title: Roast the salmon
steps.text: When the potatoes have about 12 min left, season the salmon and drizzle with 1 tbsp of the oil. Lay it skin-side down on the tray with the cherry tomatoes. Roast for 10–12 min until it flakes easily and is just opaque in the centre.

steps.title: Make the salsa verde
steps.text: While the salmon roasts, finely chop the basil, capers, anchovy (optional) and garlic together until almost a paste. Scrape into a bowl and stir in the remaining 2 tbsp oil, the lemon zest and juice. Season – it should be loose and spoonable.

steps.title: Crush the potatoes
steps.text: Drain the potatoes and return them to the pan with the butter, a pinch of salt and pepper and a spoonful of salsa verde. Crush lightly with a fork so they stay chunky.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Plate the crushed potatoes with the salmon, roasted tomatoes and the rocket. Spoon over the rest of the salsa verde and serve with the lemon wedges.

source.title: Salmon with salsa verde and asparagus
source.author: Dean Edwards

photo.alt: Basil salmon with potatoes on a plate

recipes.title: Pasta e Ceci – Roman Chickpea & Pasta Stew with Parmesan

ingredients.t: ½ tsp (or a sprig of rosemary)

ingredients.swap: Leave the chilli out of the pan and sprinkle it over one plate only at the end.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Dissolve the stock cube in 750ml boiling water. Finely chop the onion, carrot and garlic. Drain the chickpeas and grate the parmesan.

steps.title: Cook the soffritto
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Cook the onion and carrot for 8 min until soft and sweet – this gentle veg base is called a soffritto. Add the garlic, herbs and chilli (optional) for 1 min, then the tomato purée for 1 min.

steps.title: Simmer and thicken
steps.text: Add the chickpeas, chopped tomatoes and stock and simmer for 10 min. Scoop a ladle of chickpeas and liquid into a bowl and mash until smooth with a fork or potato masher. Stir it back in – this gives the stew its creamy body.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Add the pasta to the pot and simmer for 10–12 min, stirring often so it doesn't stick, until tender. The stew should be thick enough to hold a spoon upright for a second. Add a splash of hot water if it gets too stiff.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Season with salt and rest for 2 min, then ladle into bowls. Finish each with a drizzle of the remaining 1 tbsp oil, plenty of parmesan and black pepper.

source.title: Quick Pasta and Chickpeas (Pasta e Ceci)
source.author: Deb Perelman

photo.alt: Bowl of pasta and chickpeas

recipes.title: Sausage & Broccoli Orecchiette with Garlic, Chilli & Lemon

ingredients.swap: Leave the chilli out of the pan and sprinkle it over one plate only at the end.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Put a large pan of salted water on to boil. Squeeze the sausagemeat out of the skins. Cut the broccoli into small florets and thinly slice the stalk. Slice the garlic, grate the parmesan and zest the lemon.

steps.title: Fry the sausage
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Add the sausagemeat and fennel seeds (optional) and fry for 6–8 min, breaking it up with a wooden spoon, until golden and crisp.

steps.title: Cook pasta and broccoli
steps.text: While the sausage fries, cook the pasta according to the pack. Add the broccoli for the last 4 min so it's very tender.

steps.title: Bring it together
steps.text: Add the garlic and chilli (optional) to the sausage for 1 min. Scoop the pasta and broccoli into the frying pan with a ladle of the cooking water. Toss hard over a medium heat for 2 min, crushing some broccoli into a green sauce.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Take off the heat and add the parmesan, lemon zest and a squeeze of lemon juice. Toss until glossy and serve straight away.

photo.alt: Bowl of pasta with broccoli

recipes.title: Chipotle Chilli Con Carne with Lime Rice & Soured Cream

ingredients.swap: For a milder portion, halve the chipotle paste and serve extra on the side for whoever likes it hot.
Chop the coriander and scatter it over one portion only at the table.

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Finely chop the onion, dice the pepper and crush the garlic. Crumble the stock cube into 200ml just-boiled water and stir to dissolve. Zest the lime, then cut it into wedges. Rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs clear.

steps.title: Brown the mince
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large deep frying pan or casserole over a high heat. Fry the mince for 5–6 min, breaking it up with a wooden spoon, until well browned. Scoop it into a bowl, leaving the fat in the pan.

steps.title: Soften the veg
steps.text: Turn the heat down to medium and add the onion and pepper. Cook for 6–8 min, stirring now and then, until soft and just starting to colour.

steps.title: Simmer the chilli
steps.text: Stir in the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika and cinnamon (optional) and cook for 1 min until fragrant. Add the tomato purée and chipotle paste and fry for 1 min more. Return the mince with the chopped tomatoes, stock and drained kidney beans. Cover and simmer gently for 25 min until thick, adding a splash of water if it catches.

steps.title: Cook the lime rice
steps.text: About 15 min before the chilli is ready, put the rice in a small saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and cook on a low heat for 10 min. Take off the heat and leave to steam, lid on, for 5 min. Fluff with a fork and stir through the lime zest.

steps.title: Season and serve
steps.text: Taste the chilli and season with salt, pepper and a squeeze from a lime wedge. Spoon the rice into bowls and ladle the chilli alongside. Top with the soured cream and coriander (optional), with the remaining lime wedges for squeezing.

photo.alt: Plate of chilli with rice, radish and a tortilla chip

recipes.title: Sizzling Chicken Fajitas with Guacamole & Soured Cream

ingredients.swap: Leave the chilli flakes out while cooking and sprinkle them over one portion at the end.
Leave the coriander out of the guacamole and scatter it over one portion only at the table.

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Cut the chicken into finger-width strips. Thinly slice the peppers and red onion, and crush the garlic. Grate the cheddar, chop the coriander and halve the lime.

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.text: In a bowl, toss the chicken with the smoked paprika, cumin, ground coriander (optional), garlic and half the oil. Add the chilli flakes (optional), the juice of half the lime and a good pinch of salt. Leave to sit while you make the guacamole.

steps.title: Smash the guacamole
steps.text: Halve and stone the avocado and scoop the flesh into a bowl. Mash with a fork, leaving it a little chunky. Stir in the rest of the lime juice, a pinch of salt and half the coriander.

steps.title: Char the veg
steps.text: Heat the remaining oil in a large frying pan over a high heat until just smoking. Add the peppers and red onion and cook for 5–6 min, tossing now and then, until soft and blackened at the edges. Tip onto a plate.

steps.title: Fry the chicken
steps.text: Lay the chicken in the same hot pan in a single layer. Cook for 5–7 min, turning once, until charred in places and no longer pink in the middle. Return the veg, toss for 1 min, then tip into a warm dish and wipe out the pan.

steps.title: Warm the wraps and serve
steps.text: Warm the wraps one at a time in the dry pan over a medium heat for 20 sec each side. Build your fajitas at the table with the chicken and veg, guacamole, soured cream and cheddar. Scatter over the rest of the coriander (optional).

photo.alt: Top-down view of a grilled chicken fajita dinner

recipes.title: Chipotle Chicken Burrito Bowls with Coriander-Lime Rice
recipes.airFryer: Air-fry the marinated thighs at 200°C for 14–16 min, turning halfway, until charred at the edges and cooked through.

ingredients.swap: For a milder portion, halve the chipotle paste and serve extra on the side for whoever likes it hot.
Stir the coriander into one portion of rice only and keep the other plain.
Char the sweetcorn on its own and spoon it onto one bowl only, then warm the beans separately.

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs clear. Crush the garlic, chop the coriander and zest the lime. Shred the little gem, quarter the tomatoes and drain the beans.

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.text: In a bowl, mix the chipotle paste, honey, cumin, garlic, half the oil and a pinch of salt. Add the chicken thighs and turn to coat. Leave to sit while the rice goes on.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Put the rice in a saucepan with 300ml boiling water and a pinch of salt. Cover and cook on a low heat for 10 min. Turn off the heat and leave to steam, lid on, for 5 min.

steps.title: Griddle the chicken
steps.text: While the rice cooks, heat the remaining oil in a griddle or large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Cook the thighs for 6–7 min each side until charred and the juices run clear. Rest on a board for 5 min, then slice.

steps.title: Char the corn and beans
steps.text: While the chicken rests, wipe out the pan and put it back over a high heat. Cook the sweetcorn from frozen for 4–5 min, stirring now and then, until blackened in spots. Add the beans and a pinch of salt and toss for 2 min until hot.

steps.title: Build the bowls
steps.text: Fluff the rice and stir through the lime zest, the juice of half the lime and most of the coriander. Divide between bowls and top with the little gem, tomatoes, corn and beans, chicken and sliced avocado. Finish with soured cream, the last of the coriander and the rest of the lime in wedges.

photo.alt: Chipotle chicken burrito bowl

recipes.title: Cheesy Chicken & Black Bean Enchiladas in Smoky Sauce

ingredients.swap: For a milder portion, halve the chipotle paste and serve extra on the side for whoever likes it hot.
Slice the spring onions and scatter them over one portion only at the table.
Chop the coriander and scatter it over one portion only at the table.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C fan. Chop the onion, dice the pepper and crush the garlic. Cut the chicken into small bite-sized chunks. Grate the cheddar, slice the spring onions and chop the coriander.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Heat half the oil in a saucepan over a medium heat and cook half the onion for 5 min until soft. Stir in half the garlic, half the cumin, half the smoked paprika and the chipotle paste for 1 min. Add the chopped tomatoes and a pinch of salt and simmer for 10 min until slightly thickened.

steps.title: Cook the filling
steps.text: While the sauce simmers, heat the remaining oil in a frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the chicken for 4–5 min until golden. Add the pepper with the rest of the onion, garlic and spices and cook for 4 min until the chicken is cooked through. Stir in the drained beans and 4 tbsp of the sauce, then season.

steps.title: Roll the enchiladas
steps.text: Spread a few spoonfuls of sauce over the base of a small ovenproof dish. Divide the filling between the wraps and sprinkle each with a little cheddar. Roll up tightly and lay them seam-side down in the dish.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Pour over the remaining sauce and scatter with the rest of the cheddar. Bake for 15–20 min until bubbling and golden at the edges. Leave to settle for 2 min so they hold together when you lift them out.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Scatter with the spring onions (optional) and coriander (optional). Serve with a spoonful of soured cream on top.

recipes.title: Crispy Black Bean, Sweetcorn & Jalapeño Quesadillas

ingredients.swap: Leave the sweetcorn out of the filling and scatter it over one quesadilla only before you put the top wrap on.
Scatter the jalapeños over one quesadilla only, or serve them in a small bowl on the side.
Leave the coriander out of the salsa and scatter it over one portion only at the table.

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Defrost the sweetcorn in a sieve under the hot tap and shake dry. Finely dice the cherry tomatoes and red onion. Slice the spring onions, grate the cheddar and chop the jalapeños and coriander. Separate the little gem leaves.

steps.title: Make the tomato salsa
steps.text: Mix the tomatoes and red onion with half the coriander, the juice of half the lime and a pinch of salt. Set aside so the flavours mingle; this fresh salsa is called pico de gallo.

steps.title: Mix the filling
steps.text: Tip the drained beans into a bowl and roughly mash about half with a fork. Stir in the sweetcorn, spring onions, smoked paprika, cumin, cheddar and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Fill the quesadillas
steps.text: Spread the filling over two of the wraps, right to the edges. Scatter the jalapeños over the top. Lay the other two wraps on top and press down firmly.

steps.title: Fry until crisp
steps.text: Heat half the oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Cook one quesadilla for 2–3 min until golden underneath. Slide it onto a plate, flip it back into the pan and cook for 2–3 min more until the cheese melts. Repeat with the remaining oil and quesadilla.

steps.title: Slice and serve
steps.text: Cut each quesadilla into wedges. Dress the little gem leaves with a squeeze of lime. Serve with the salsa, soured cream and the rest of the coriander (optional).

source.title: Smoky, Cheesy Sweetcorn and Black Bean Quesadillas
source.author: Mob Kitchen

photo.alt: Quesadilla cut in half on a plate

recipes.title: Chicken Tinga Tacos with Avocado Crema & Pickled Onions

ingredients.swap: For a milder portion, halve the chipotle paste and serve extra on the side for whoever likes it hot.
Chop the coriander and scatter it over one portion only at the table.

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Very thinly slice the red onion and thinly slice the brown onion. Crush the garlic, shred the little gem and chop the coriander. Crumble the half stock cube into 100ml just-boiled water.

steps.title: Pickle the red onion
steps.text: Put the red onion in a small bowl with the juice of half the lime and a big pinch of salt. Scrunch it with your fingers and leave for 20 min while you cook. It'll turn bright pink and soften.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over a medium heat. Cook the brown onion for 6–8 min until soft and golden. Stir in the garlic, cumin and mixed herbs (optional) for 1 min. Add the chipotle paste, chopped tomatoes and stock and bring to a simmer.

steps.title: Simmer and shred the chicken
steps.text: Nestle the whole thighs into the sauce, cover and simmer gently for 20 min until cooked through. Lift onto a board and shred with two forks. Return to the pan and bubble uncovered for 3–4 min until the sauce clings to the chicken.

steps.title: Make the avocado crema
steps.text: While the chicken simmers, mash the avocado with the yogurt, the remaining lime juice and a pinch of salt. Keep mashing until smooth; this is your creamy avocado sauce.

steps.title: Build the tacos
steps.text: Warm the wraps in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 20 sec each side. Top with the little gem, a generous pile of chicken and a spoonful of avocado crema. Finish with the pickled onion and coriander (optional).

photo.alt: Two tacos on a plate with a lime wedge

recipes.title: Crispy Pork Carnitas Tacos with Lime Slaw & Jalapeños
recipes.airFryer: Instead of grilling, air-fry the shredded, glazed pork at 200°C for 6–8 min, shaking once, until crisp and caramelised at the edges.

ingredients.swap: Leave the coriander out of the slaw and scatter it over one portion only at the table.
Serve the jalapeños in a small bowl on the side so they can be added to one portion only.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Cut the pork steaks into large 5cm chunks. Quarter the onion and bash the garlic cloves with the flat of a knife. Make up 400ml stock with the cube. Finely shred the red cabbage and chop the coriander.

steps.title: Brown the pork
steps.text: Toss the pork with the cumin, mixed herbs (optional), cinnamon (optional) and most of the salt. Heat the oil in a casserole or deep lidded pan over a medium-high heat. Brown the pork for 5 min until golden all over.

steps.title: Braise until tender
steps.text: Add the onion, garlic, stock and the juice of half the lime and bring to a simmer. Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 1 hr 15 min. It's ready when the pork falls apart when prodded with a fork.

steps.title: Make the lime slaw
steps.text: While the pork braises, toss the red cabbage with the juice of the remaining half lime, half the coriander and a pinch of salt. Leave it to soften slightly.

steps.title: Shred and glaze the pork
steps.text: Heat the grill to high and line a baking tray with foil. Lift the pork out with a slotted spoon, shred with two forks and discard the onion. Boil the pan liquid hard for 5 min until reduced to about 4 tbsp. Stir in the honey and toss through the pork.

steps.title: Crisp under the grill
steps.text: Spread the pork over the lined tray. Grill for 5–7 min, turning once, until the edges are crisp and caramelised.

steps.title: Load the tacos
steps.text: Warm the wraps in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 20 sec each side. Pile with slaw and crispy pork. Finish with soured cream, jalapeños and the rest of the coriander (optional).

photo.alt: Three street tacos with lime on a wooden plate

recipes.title: Crispy Panko Fish Tacos with Lime Slaw & Chipotle Yogurt
recipes.airFryer: Spray the crumbed fish with oil and air-fry at 200°C for 8–10 min, turning halfway, until golden and the fish flakes easily.

ingredients.swap: Leave the coriander out of the slaw and scatter it over one portion only at the table.
Stir the chipotle into half the yogurt only and serve the other half plain.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C fan and brush a baking tray with half the oil. Finely shred the red cabbage, slice the spring onions and chop the coriander. Pat the fish dry with kitchen paper and cut into 8 chunky fingers.

steps.title: Set up the crumbing station
steps.text: Set out three shallow bowls. Mix the flour with the smoked paprika and a pinch of salt in the first. Beat the egg in the second and tip the panko into the third.

steps.title: Crumb the fish
steps.text: Dust each piece of fish in the flour, dip in the egg, then press firmly into the panko. Lay on the oiled tray and drizzle with the remaining oil.

steps.title: Bake the fish
steps.text: Bake for 12–15 min, turning halfway, until the crumb is golden and the fish flakes easily. Wrap the wraps in foil and put them in the oven for the last 5 min to warm through.

steps.title: Make the slaw and sauce
steps.text: While the fish bakes, toss the cabbage and spring onions with the juice of half the lime, half the coriander and a pinch of salt. Mix the yogurt with the chipotle paste and a squeeze of lime. Slice the avocado and cut the rest of the lime into wedges.

steps.title: Assemble the tacos
steps.text: Fill each warm wrap with slaw, two crispy fish fingers and a few slices of avocado. Spoon over the chipotle yogurt. Finish with the rest of the coriander (optional) and the lime wedges.

photo.alt: Battered fish tacos on a tray

recipes.title: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Tacos with Feta & Lime Yogurt
recipes.airFryer: Air-fry the seasoned sweet potato and onion at 200°C for 15–18 min, shaking halfway, then add the beans and garlic for the final 3 min.

ingredients.swap: Leave the chilli flakes off the tray and sprinkle them over one portion at the end.
Crumble the feta over one portion only, or serve it in a little bowl on the side.
Chop the coriander and scatter it over one portion only at the table.

steps.title: Prep the veg
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C fan. Cut the sweet potato into 2cm cubes and the red onion into wedges. Crush the garlic, drain the beans and shred the little gem. Chop the coriander and crumble the feta.

steps.title: Roast the sweet potato
steps.text: Toss the sweet potato and onion on a roasting tray with the oil, cumin, smoked paprika, chilli flakes (optional) and a good pinch of salt. Roast for 25 min, turning halfway, until tender and caramelised at the edges.

steps.title: Add the beans
steps.text: After 17 min, stir the black beans and garlic into the tray and roast for the final 8 min. The beans should warm through and crisp slightly. Wrap the wraps in foil and pop them in the oven for the last 5 min.

steps.title: Make the lime yogurt
steps.text: While the veg roasts, mix the yogurt with the zest and juice of half the lime and a pinch of salt. Cut the rest of the lime into wedges.

steps.title: Build the tacos
steps.text: Fill the warm wraps with little gem, the roasted sweet potato and beans and the feta. Add a spoonful of lime yogurt and the coriander (optional). Serve with lime wedges for squeezing.

source.title: Sweet Potato, Black Bean & Feta Tacos

recipes.title: Huevos Rancheros with Smoky Chipotle Beans & Crispy Eggs

ingredients.swap: For a milder portion, halve the chipotle paste and serve extra on the side for whoever likes it hot.
Crumble the feta over one portion only, or serve it in a little bowl on the side.
Chop the coriander and scatter it over one portion only at the table.
Slice the spring onions and scatter them over one portion only at the table.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Chop the onion, slice the pepper and crush the garlic. Slice the spring onions, chop the coriander and crumble the feta. Slice the avocado and squeeze over a little lime juice to stop it browning. Cut the rest of the lime into wedges.

steps.title: Make the ranchero sauce
steps.text: Heat half the oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Cook the onion and pepper for 6–7 min until soft. Stir in the garlic, cumin and chipotle paste for 1 min.

steps.title: Simmer the beans
steps.text: Add the chopped tomatoes and drained beans and simmer for 8–10 min. It's ready when a spoon drawn through leaves a trail. Season with salt, then turn the heat to low to keep warm.

steps.title: Toast the tortillas
steps.text: While the sauce simmers, heat a second frying pan over a medium-high heat. Toast the wraps one at a time for about 1 min each side until blistered and crisp at the edges. Put one on each plate.

steps.title: Fry the eggs
steps.text: Add the remaining oil to the second pan over a medium-high heat. Crack in the eggs and fry for 2–3 min, spooning the hot oil over the whites. Stop when the whites are set with crisp edges but the yolks are still runny.

steps.title: Pile it up
steps.text: Spoon the smoky beans over the tortillas and top each with two eggs. Finish with the avocado, feta (optional), spring onions (optional), coriander (optional) and lime wedges.

recipes.title: One-Pot Cheesy Mexican Chicken & Rice Bake

ingredients.swap: For a milder portion, halve the chipotle paste and serve extra on the side for whoever likes it hot.
Leave the sweetcorn out of the bake; microwave it for 2 min and stir it into one portion when serving.
Slice the spring onions and scatter them over one portion only at the table.
Chop the coriander and scatter it over one portion only at the table.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C fan. Dice the chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with salt. Chop the onion, dice the pepper, crush the garlic and make up 250ml stock. Rinse the rice, grate the cheddar and slice the spring onions.

steps.title: Brown the chicken
steps.text: Heat the oil in a lidded ovenproof casserole over a medium-high heat. Fry the chicken for 5 min until golden all over. Add the onion and pepper and cook for 4 min until softening.

steps.title: Add the rice and spices
