steps.text: Pack the lettuce leaves and wrap separately. At lunch, lay the lettuce on the wrap, spoon in the chicken and roll — or use the leaves as cups.

recipes.title: Cajun Chicken, Sweet Potato & Broccoli Box
recipes.batch: Roast 3 portions on one big tray; keeps 3 days in the fridge.

steps.title: Start the sweet potato
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Toss the sweet potato with half the oil and a pinch of salt and roast for 10 min.

steps.title: Add the chicken and broccoli
steps.text: Toss the chicken with the spices, herbs, garlic and remaining oil. Add to the tray with the broccoli and roast for 18–20 min until the chicken is cooked through and the potato is tender and caramelised.

steps.title: Make the dip and pack
steps.text: Stir the hot sauce into the skyr and pack in a small pot. Cool everything quickly and pack into a box.

steps.title: Reheat at lunch
steps.text: Microwave for 2–3 min, stirring halfway, until piping hot, then dunk everything in the spicy dip.

recipes.title: Smoky Loaded Beans on Toast with a Poached Egg

steps.title: Warm the beans
steps.text: Heat the beans with the smoked paprika in a small pan over a medium heat. Stir in the spinach until it wilts.

steps.title: Poach the egg
steps.text: Crack the egg into a pan of barely simmering water and cook for 3 min until the white is set but the yolk is still runny. Lift out with a slotted spoon.

steps.title: Toast and stack
steps.text: Toast the bread, spoon over the beans, top with the egg and scatter over the cheddar and pepper.

recipes.title: Tomato, Spinach & Mozzarella Frittata

steps.title: Heat the grill
steps.text: Turn the grill to high. Beat the eggs with the parmesan and season.

steps.title: Start on the hob
steps.text: Heat the oil in a small ovenproof frying pan over a medium heat. Wilt the spinach for 30 sec, then pour in the eggs and scatter over the tomatoes and mozzarella. Cook for 3–4 min until the bottom is set.

steps.title: Finish under the grill
steps.text: Slide the pan under the grill for 2–3 min until puffed, golden and just set in the middle. Scatter over the basil and serve with the leaves.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon & Scrambled Egg Bagel Thin

steps.title: Scramble the eggs
steps.text: Beat the eggs with the milk and pepper. Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over a low heat and stir the eggs slowly for 2–3 min until just set and still soft — take them off a little early, they keep cooking.

steps.title: Toast and top
steps.text: Toast the bagel thin, pile on the rocket and eggs, then drape over the smoked salmon. Finish with spring onion, a squeeze of lemon and more black pepper.

source.title: Scrambled egg and smoked salmon bagel

recipes.title: Tuna Melt Jacket Potato

steps.title: Microwave the potato
steps.text: Prick the potato all over with a fork and microwave on high for 8–10 min, turning halfway, until soft all the way through.

steps.title: Mix the filling
steps.text: Mix the tuna, sweetcorn, mayo and spring onion with plenty of black pepper. Heat the grill to high.

steps.title: Melt and serve
steps.text: Split the potato, fluff the inside with a fork and pile in the tuna. Top with the cheddar and grill for 3–4 min until bubbling and golden. Serve with the leaves.

recipes.title: Griddled Halloumi & Pepper Pitta with Houmous

steps.title: Char the veg
steps.text: Heat the oil in a griddle or frying pan over a high heat and cook the pepper and onion for 5–6 min until soft and charred.

steps.title: Griddle the halloumi
steps.text: Push the veg aside and cook the halloumi for 1–2 min each side until golden. Squeeze over the lemon and sprinkle with chilli.

steps.title: Stuff the pitta
steps.text: Warm the pitta in the toaster, split it open and spread with houmous. Stuff with the leaves, veg and halloumi and eat straight away.

recipes.title: Chicken Fajita Quesadilla

steps.title: Cook the fajita veg
steps.text: Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium-high heat and cook the pepper and onion for 5 min until soft and charred. Stir in the spices and chicken for 1 min, then tip onto a plate.

steps.title: Fill and fold
steps.text: Wipe the pan. Lay the wrap in it, scatter half of it with cheese, then the chicken mix and jalapeños, and fold over.

steps.title: Crisp it up
steps.text: Cook over a medium heat for 2–3 min each side, pressing down with a spatula, until golden and the cheese has melted. Cut into wedges and serve with the skyr and a squeeze of lime.
